chapters.title: Chapter 2730 Unprecedented Glory! I
paragraphs: The battlefield in the region where Projectiles of Helios clashed with gorgeous blood red Crimson Hyperversal Havenly Extremity Rune Scriptures of Perdition now became highlighted as another isolated battlefield where Tier 4 Hyperversal Extremities were opposing each other.

The surroundings were extremely tense as the deadliest areas in the endless light years that the forces of Vacuous and Vitalis Hyperversal Legions were fighting in were those that had Tier 4 Hyperversal Extremities fighting!

One of the more prominent ones was where Emperor Shao clashed against multiple Tier 4 combatants, but the area that. Just had over 1,000 Tier 1 Vacuous Extremities butchered now became the deadliest one.
Roars and bellows of battle rose as many wills watched and wondered.
How would the hidden Esteemed Havely Emperor react against the appearance and action of the Esteemed Infernal Emperor?
The means of Tier 4 Hyperversal Extremities were unique and Unfathomable as they were touching of a Gradation of Extremity that made it possible for them to entirely suppress those below them!
Their souls had undergone a level of change that all three prior Gradations combined could not achieve.
So many wills moved across the battlefield and watched with bated breaths.

The Tier 4 Vacuous Extremity gazed out as her eyes swirled with dense bloody red Rune Scriptures of Perdition, her appearance stopping the deaths of all nearby Tier 1 Vacuous Extremities as her power was displayed loud and clear!
Now...what about her enemy? What would his next move be?
In the Infinite Hyperversal Haven.
Noah's hands brought down the Hyperversal Bow of Helios briefly.
HUUM!

His body continued to buzz with change and elevation as his Extremity Soul dipped its majesty on all parts of him, with thousands of Prompts constantly flowing down his eyes as the achievement of decimating over 1,000 Tier 1 Vacuous Extremities was a Quintessential one.
The Loot obtained would be enough to make tremendous progress for the Sporos IV of Extremity- if not cause it to completely mature after Ruination multiplied all of this Loot!
But he wouldn't yet know until he began.
And this issue...was currently not the most pressing one.
His eyes swirled with the authority of Oraculum as the scene and action of the Tier 4 Hyperversal Extremity replayed over his mind again and again.
He, before even attaining Extremity, had forced a Tier 4 existence to make a move and counter him.
Such a thing may make others proud or inflate their egos, but Noah remained unfettered as Quintessence seemed to say in his mind that the reality should of course be like this.
Of course, the True Emperor of Quintessence should shine with such unprecedented glory!
So after halting his bow ever so briefly, it rose up and aimed high once more.
How would he go against the means of a Tier 4 Hyperversal Extremity? Many were asking themselves this question, but they didn't understand a crucial thing about Noah at this moment.
Vacuous Malignancies were not his only enemies that were moving within these chaotic battlefields.

His eyes pulsed with profound glory as with another set of targets in mind, his body billowed as tides of power rose from him and surged into the Hyperversal Bow of Helios within his hands as he called out!
{Deadeye}.
His Extremity Soul buzzed as nearly everything it had was taken away.

100 Quintessential Hyperversal Extremity Soul Values instantly surged into the crimson gold bow within his hands as it instantly shone with a light that bathed the nearby millions of light years- a light that momentarily blinded his Vassals that had been watching from below!
Deadeye.
The only feature he could currently utilize as its cost was 10,000 Extremity Soul Values.
As for its details?
They were rather drastic!

{Deadeye}:: Among the Arsenal of the Hyperversal Bow of Helios, Deadeye serves as the bridge from ordinary to exceptional. Coming with a high cost of 10,000 Extremity Values and 100 Million Extremity Mana Values, this feature allows you to rain Helios Havenfire- a concentrated form of flames made from flames that have coursed through the Extremity Vein of Helios for eons, onto a group of targeted enemies. Deadeye will release a total of 2,500 Tendrils of Helios Havenfire, with each tendril being equivalent to 2 Hyperversal Projectiles of Helios. If a group of 500 targets is chosen, each one will face 5 Tendrils of Helios Havenfire. If 100 targets are chosen, each one will face 25 Tendrils of Helios Havenfire...and so forth. The minimum number of targeted enemies for this area of attack ability is 50. Depending on how this feature is used, a deadly result can be brought to fruition as the Hyperversal Bow of Helios seeks to cleanse all its enemies in a baptism of Havenfire!
A deadly attack.

It released Tendrils of Helios Havenfire as a single one was equivalent to 2 Hyperversal Projectiles of Helios! This meant that a single Tendril of Helios Havenfire held 18 Illusory Attack Extremity Rune Scriptures of Helios.

Now, what if he were to attack 100 Extremities, and each one was faced with 25 Tendrils of Helios Havenfire that represented a total of 450 Illusory Attack Extremity Rune Scriptures attacking a single being all at once?
Mind you, each Illusory Attack Extremity Rune Scripture was equivalent to an Obsidian Rune Scripture!
The Advent of this ability...meant that his targets no longer had to be Tier 1 Hyperversal Extremities.

This was because the upper tier of power of Tier 2 Hyperversal Extremities was 333 Obsidian or 2,997 Golden Hyperversal Havenly Extremity Rune Scriptures before they could try entering the Third Gradation of Extremity.
And so, his next move unfolded from all of this information.
BOOM!
The Hyperversal Bow of Helios seethed as it released the blinding ball of Havenfire that had scorched the surrounding reality, causing it to disappear into the space before it.
It was a feature that would alter the landscape of the vast battlefield ever so slightly.
An action that would truly introduce the Tyrannical Emperor as he showed he wasn't bound to any sides- but instead bound to enemies and benefits.
Vacuous or Vitalis...did it truly matter at the end?
This question buzzed in Noah's mind as he understood the sheer gravity of his actions, and yet his reigning will of Quintessence took it regardless!

chapters.title: Chapter 2731 Unprecedented Glory! II
paragraphs: The moment he released the blinding {Deadeye}, Noah's eyes pulsed as he spoke out lightly.
{Let the conclusion of the War of Annihilation commence.}
The conclusion of the War of Annihilation.
He allowed this to commence with a single shot!
As his records buzzed with his grand achievements, a shocking scene bloomed in the battlefield of Vacuous and Vitalis Hyperversal Legions.

As the Tier 4 Vacuous Extremity waited to see how the hidden enemy would react, her eyes fluttered and spun like blazing singularities as she blinked in confusion, her head turning entirely opposite to where her will was clustered as she stared at the depths of the Vitalis Hyperversal Legions.

From confusion, her eyes then showed incredulousness and disbelief as she sensed the blazing signature of the Havenly Authority of Helios bloom once more...but it was in the Vitalis Hyperversal Legions!
In a massive Bastion of Vitalis!

More specifically, the records above the heads of Tier 2 Avernus Extremities stationed within and near a Bastion of Vitalis suddenly split open as tendrils of crimson gold flames instantly rained down on exactly 100 of them.
A large percentage of the forces of Tier 2 Hyperversal Extremities stationed here!
Their souls instantly felt the indescribable sensation of True Death.
Far in front of them, the gazes of a few dozen Tier 3 Avernus Extremity changed rapidly as even further away, the Tier 4 Hyperversal Extremity turned around while he roared out in shock!
All beings paid attention to the prominent powerhouses and movements of the current battlefield.
The decimation of over 1,000 Tier 1 Vacuous Extremities within seconds was noteworthy as it had fallen under the eyes of many while they battled.
They knew the flashes of crimson gold light as the culprits that had decimated a portion of the Vacuous Malignancies as they cheered at the expert from their side!
So why...were even grander versions of these terrifying flames of crimson gold raining down on their own people?!
BLAZE!
A scorching storm blew in one hundred areas within the depths of the Vitalis Hyperversal Legions.
The Tier 3 and 4 Vitalis Extremities did not react in time as the targets of these flames were in an even worse state.

The over 400 Illusory Attack Extremity Rune Scriptures of Helios within the Tendrils of Helios Havenfire instantly decimated their less than 300 Obsidian Hyperversal Havenly Extremity Rune Scriptures or their equivalency in terms of Golden Scriptures!
Instant eradication of their Rune Scriptures, and it was followed by the instant eradication of their Records right after.
By the time the Tier 4 Avernus Extremity reacted, his Authority only encapsulated nothing but ashes and flames.
He blinked with a blank gaze as all other eyes observed this situation in disbelief.
The Tier 4 Vacuous Extremity who was waiting to see how Noah would counter his move was dumbfounded.
This...
Just what exactly was this?!
Did the enemy not care whether he killed Vacuous Malignancies or Vitalis Malignancies?
Was he simply killing for the sake of killing?!
The reality of 100 Tier 2 Avernus Extremities instantly perishing settled in at this moment as such a loss was entirely devastating to the Avernus Clan.
How many Tier 2s could they produce over the years? How many more Tier 3s would stem from them?
All of them were powerhouses they had cultivated for an untold number of years as for them to be scorched and burned by the Havenly Authority of HELIOS from their very own Seven Vitalis Havens...
It caused such untold rage and anger to burn with the Tier 4 Avernus Extremity as he roared out while turning into a blazing inferno of purple flames.
{No loyalty to home or country...who are you?!}
The Tier 4 Hyperversal Extremity bellowed out.
{Moved by bloodlust and malice...which Demon are you?!}
He bellowed out again.
{Not even daring to rise up and claim your actions? Worse than even a dog! A lowly Demon!}
The roars were resonant.
And yet there was no answer.
Why did this happen?

Why did it happen to their Avernus Clan alone and not others? Why would a prominent expert from their Vitalis Havens attack Vacuous Malignancies, but then turn his attacks towards only Avernus Extremities?
Such buzzing questions rose as this single phenomenon caused a startling change within the battlefield!
In a far corner of the battlefield, the gaze of Emperor Shao and other Tier 4 Hyperversal Extremities became stern as they continued to repulse their enemies.
And opposite to them, within the depths of the obscured Vacuous Hyperversal Legions.
Far, far back within the dense armies of Vacuous Malignancies that had yet to even join the battle.
A domain of Pure Vacuous Hyperversal Authority that could only be set up by an existence that had undergone their Fifth Vacuous Awakening could be seen.
It obscured anything to be seen by others as within this domain, massive entities radiating Tier 4 Hyperversal Extremities were gazing at each other!
{That wasn't one of ours...}
A man shrouded in Vacuous Hyperversal Authority spoke.
{No...no it was not.}
Another one nodded in a chilling light as thereafter, they all gazed towards an Entity that was grander than all of them.
This entity far exceeded the bounds of the Fourth Gradation of Extremity as seeing their gazes, he could see what they were thinking as he nodded.
{Very well. Activate your sleeper cells and let us have the war fully begin.}
A single action.
And yet its effects were unprecedentedly profound.
The moment the entity exceeding the stage of Tier 4 Hyperversal Extremity spoke, the Tier 4s around him buzzed as their faces each turned towards the same direction.
One Tier 4 Entity in particular had a chilling light cross through his eyes as his thoughts were vibrant.
'Svetlana, my sweet child...the time has come for you and the others to show your worth.'
BOOM!
With a thought, the authorities of the Tier 4 Hyperversal Extremities moved and tangled in a unique manner.
They were sending forth a signal for something grand to begin.
Something that would alter the current state of the war and usher forth much, much more brutality!

chapters.title: Chapter 2732 An Unchangeable Destiny! I
paragraphs: The landscape of the war was entirely about to be altered by a single decision that was brought forward in time.
It was all because of an action done by a single being against 100 Tier 2 Hyperversal Extremities!
This single action had great significance as it expressed many truths for those paying attention.
One of these major truths remained what was happening around and within the Avernus Clan as at this moment, the woes of the Avernus Clan once more rose to the surface.
The Advent of the Unrecorded Havenly Quintessential Hyperversal Extremity Soul was bathing and transforming all parts of Noah's existence.
And this...included his lineage.
His Havenly Quintessential Hyperversal Emperor Lineage that nearly all forces of the Nether Havens of Extremity were trying to get their hands on in abundance.

The changes that the Havenly Quintessential Hyperversal Emperor Lineage brought were stupendous in nature as all those with this bloodline would feel it...but its sheer brilliance was actually expressed within the domains of the one Clan that was banned from attaining this Bloodline.
The clan whose Tier 2 Extremities were just decimated!
In the Nether Haven of Oceanus, within a Branch of the Avernus Clan that held connected Minor Havens.
Inside a Minor Haven towards the very center of this Avernus Domain that was known as the Iridescent Purple Peak.
On the base of a high mountain that had swathes of purple lilac trees waving in the wind.

Two Tier 3 Hyperversal Extremities accompanied by 9 Tier 2s had faces full of rage as they circled dozens of Apex Aeonic Lifeforms who were led by four Tier 2s and a single Tier 1 Hyperversal Extremity.
But uniquely, those surrounded by currently giving off a scintillating glow of Havenly light as their new lineage was churning and causing their auras to rise evermore!
Those circling them became even more enraged at this as one of the two Tier 3 Extremities bellowed out.
{You all...deserve death for betraying the Avernus Clan!}

These words still contained a sense of disbelief and rage as the ones being circled were members of the Avernus Clan that had sworn an oath to renounce these very lands and home that had helped them get where they were today, and they were silently departing these domains when the sudden bursting glow of Havenly light from their bodies gave away their position.
This...was all due to Noah's new Extremity Soul beginning to affect and elevate his Lineage as well. But they had no idea of this as the current reality came to be.

It also showed that a Tier 3 Avernus Extremity had fallen to the temptation of the Blood Sources as he now stood with an expression of conflicting emotions and distress as he did not want this situation!

But he just...could not give up the path the Blood Source offered. And as his Blood seemed to transform even more with the shocking boosts he had received information of being elevated, he further confirmed his path was right as now...he simply wanted to make an exit from the Avernus Clan without coming into conflict with those he knew as friends.
{You all...let us not do this. We each have our own destinies, we simply chose another path that-}
{Rubbish!}
The aura of the two Tier 3s circling them blazed along with the 9 Tier 2s surrounding them.
{We've already sent word of your treachery. If you dare to move, your whole Purple Sun Family will be executed here!}
Purple Sun Family.

This was a prominent family within the Avernus Clan that had powerful a few Tier 3s leading them, and yet one of these powerful Family Heads had actually renounced the Avernus Clan and planned to leave with a portion of the beings to rock the Purple Sun Family.
{Who dares to destroy the foundation and livelihood of my Purple Sun Lineage?}
BOOM!
A booming voice rang out from above as the aura of a Tier 3 Hyperversal Extremity descended.
It was an Ancestor of the Purple Sun Family!
The faces of those encircled became lighter while the gazes of those encircling them became stern.

They gazed up to see the visage of the only Zenith Tier 3 Extremity of the Purple Sun Family descend from above and stand protectively around his people, gazing down and quickly understanding the situation occurring as his eyes flickered with an intense light.
The rage within the encircling Extremities did not die down as the foremost Tier 3 spoke towards the Ancestor of the Purple Sun Family.

{The Regent Avernus Extremity Overlord has already heard of their treachery and sent back the command for them to be crippled of their Foundation as a warning to any others who may take the same path as then. If they allow this to occur peacefully, their lives will be spared. If they fight back...they are to be executed on sight!}
The Regent Avernus Extremity Overlord.
The one residing above the matters of the Clan while the true Avernus Extremity Overlord was in the Supernal Havens of Extremity.
His command was actually so swift as hearing it, the eyes of the Zenith Tier 3 Ancestor of the Purple Sun Family flashed as he sighed and gazed at his people.
{They...they are my family. Their lives can not be decided on by a mere command...}
{They are not part of your lineage if they have tainted themselves with the blood of the enemy!}
WAA!
Emotions were high.
The encircling Extremities knew that their Clan was at a cricket juncture.
If more beings like these appeared, the disruption would be too great! They had to make an example of these treacherous individuals first to warn off all others who may do the same thing.

{The will of the Regent Avernus Extremity Overlord must be followed. Ancestor Purple Sun...even you cannot change this. For the greater good of our Clan, please step aside and let us abolish the foundations of these traitors.}
A stark silence descended.
This silence was extremely foreboding as the encircling Extremities didn't like what it foretold!
Onward!

And as his Blood seemed to transform even more with the shocking boosts he had received information of being elevated, he further confirmed his path was right as now...he simply wanted to make an exit from the Avernus Clan without coming into conflict with those he knew as friends.
{You all...let us not do this.
We each have our own destinies, we simply chose another path that-}
{Rubbish!}
The aura of the two Tier 3s circling them blazed along with the 9 Tier 2s surrounding them.
{We've already sent word of your treachery.
If you dare to move, your whole Purple Sun Family will be executed here!}
Purple Sun Family.

This was a prominent family within the Avernus Clan that had powerful a few Tier 3s leading them, and yet one of these powerful Family Heads had actually renounced the Avernus Clan and planned to leave with a portion of the beings to rock the Purple Sun Family.
{Who dares to destroy the foundation and livelihood of my Purple Sun Lineage?}
BOOM!
A booming voice rang out from above as the aura of a Tier 3 Hyperversal Extremity descended.
It was an Ancestor of the Purple Sun Family!
The faces of those encircled became lighter while the gazes of those encircling them became stern.

They gazed up to see the visage of the only Zenith Tier 3 Extremity of the Purple Sun Family descend from above and stand protectively around his people, gazing down and quickly understanding the situation occurring as his eyes flickered with an intense light.
The rage within the encircling Extremities did not die down as the foremost Tier 3 spoke towards the Ancestor of the Purple Sun Family.

{The Regent Avernus Extremity Overlord has already heard of their treachery and sent back the command for them to be crippled of their Foundation as a warning to any others who may take the same path as then.
If they allow this to occur peacefully, their lives will be spared.
If they fight back...they are to be executed on sight!}
The Regent Avernus Extremity Overlord.
The one residing above the matters of the Clan while the true Avernus Extremity Overlord was in the Supernal Havens of Extremity.
His command was actually so swift as hearing it, the eyes of the Zenith Tier 3 Ancestor of the Purple Sun Family flashed as he sighed and gazed at his people.
{They...they are my family.
Their lives can not be decided on by a mere command...}
{They are not part of your lineage if they have tainted themselves with the blood of the enemy!}
WAA!
Emotions were high.
The encircling Extremities knew that their Clan was at a cricket juncture.
If more beings like these appeared, the disruption would be too great!
They had to make an example of these treacherous individuals first to warn off all others who may do the same thing.
{The will of the Regent Avernus Extremity Overlord must be followed.
Ancestor Purple Sun...even you cannot change this.
For the greater good of our Clan, please step aside and let us abolish the foundations of these traitors.}
A stark silence descended.
This silence was extremely foreboding as the encircling Extremities didn't like what it foretold!
Onward!

chapters.title: Chapter 2733 An Unchangeable Destiny! II
paragraphs: The expression on the face of the Ancestor of the Purple Sun Family hardened.
His fists tightened as he seemingly came to a resolve, looking at those who sought to cut off his own lineage!
{I will not abolish the foundation of my own lineage, nor will I stand by as they are killed...so it seems I shall also become your enemy.}
A shocking progression.
The faces of the encircling Extremities became somber as they moved back while blazing with Rune Scriptures.

The body of the Ancestor of the Purple Sun Family glimmered as from his hands, a Blood Source that his own Family had given to him that he had never taken appeared- his gaze full of conflict and shame as he looked at it. He did not want to.
His loyalty to the Avernus Clan was high as he had close relationships with many of the major powerhouses within.
And yet...events had progressed to the state they were currently in.
And yet...what had to be done had to be done.
With a flash, a vow was made.
The Blood Source in his hands was flicked into his mouth as the Avernus Clan was renounced.
And a Blood Source was swallowed!
The scene shocked all beings here as this...was a Zenith Tier 3 Hyperversal Extremity!
One of the pillars of the Avernus Clan.
BZZT!
And now, his aura began to soar with even grander power as he gazed around coldly.
{My Purple Sun Family shall make an exit from the Avernus Clan today...I do not wish to shed any Blood as I ask you to not stand in our way!}
A blazing aura more powerful than anyone here erupted from him as he spoke, a blinding purple light blooming here and spreading out for many light years.

This glorious light...was currently being seen in another location entirely as far from this Nether Haven, across great distances into the Supernal Haven of Dissolution- this scene was observed playing out on an illusory screen.

It wasn't the only illusory screen as there were multiple other illusory screens that showed Branches of the Avernus Clan in all Seven Havens, and each scene showed varying levels of conflict as from among their Clan, those who had taken Blood Sources and renounced the Avernus Clan were leaving en masse or fighting against those stopping their departure!
It was heartbreaking as it was the full onset of a civil war and blooming chaos.
In addition to this, there was a screen that showed the scene of 100 Tier 2 Hyperversal Extremities which had turned into flames and ash near and within a Bastion of Vitalis.
All of these scenes played out slowly as a feminine voice echoed out.
{This...is what is currently happening all around the Avernus Clan.}

The voice was a cold and somber one as it stemmed from the Seer Amestris who displayed dozens of illusory screens that showed scenes from all branches within the Seven Nether Havens of Extremity...in addition to what had just occurred for their forces fighting the Vacuous Hyperversal Legions!
Beside her, an illusory body of the Avernus Extremity Overlord stood with an exceedingly cold expression as he spoke out.
{All of this...because of a single being?}
Could it truly be?
It was so outlandish that others may find it hard to believe!
And yet the Seer of Avernus nodded her head while replying.

{All signs point to Noah Osmont. The few Records I can discern say Noah Osmont. He may be a part of a terrifying force we do know of, likely connected to the Supernal Havens of Extremity. He may have Tier 3s and even possibly a Tier 4 supporting him. All our current misfortunes...all point towards Noah Osmont as his War of Annihilation with us!}
These shocking words echoed out as the Avernus Extremity Overlord listened to them coldly.

They were currently in an isolated domain as on the side, the figure of a simmering Extremity Blue could be seen, along with Tier 2 and 3 Avernus Extremities who had their Records cleaved by Seer Amestris to save them from the Pathogenic Authority that was destroying them from within.
The gazes of many were blank as they sought to find their past identity and records.
The Avernus Extremity Overlord looked at all of this and came to a decision as he spoke with a stern expression soon after.
{See if you can set up a meeting. Involve the Senatus of Extremity if you have to. Me and Osmont.}

An astonishing and unbelievable set of words rose from him as instantly, the figure of Extremity Blue who was fully stepping into the throngs of Tier 4 Hyperversal Extremity radiated a cerulean light of Lunacy as she bellowed out.
{What?!}
A daring question and opposition to the Avernus Extremity Overlord.
And yet this being....only continued to gaze at the many illusory screens showing the current state of the Avernus Clan as he didn't repeat himself!
Within the Nether Haven of Dissolution.
In an isolated domain where only two beings stood, with both being clones of their originals.
These two beings looked at each other as on the opposing side, a great change occurred with the Adjudicator of Dissolution!
Her veil had fallen off her face.
{Svetlana.}

Noah said the name while radiating a devilish smile as currently, with his Extremity Soul, he could glimpse at the details of Tier 3 Hyperversal Extremities and observe their names along with a few more details.
Her features became visible as her obsidian pupils were glazed with a pristine light of power, her fair skin giving off sparks of stellar light as a sense of otherworldly beauty settled on her face.
With full yet small red lips and tendrils of obsidian hair flowing freely, she seemed regal and untouchable by others as she adorned a frilly black dress inlaid with white gems!

Her eyes showed great power, and yet one could see immense sorrow and darkness within as the threatening Hyperversal Extremity Authority she had released against Noah entirely faded as she looked at him closely.
{If a moment like this has come, then it means what I have dreaded all of these years is coming even closer than I thought.}
She spoke, seeing that Noah's figure was seated while gazing at her as she did the same.
She saw his laid-back smile at her words as he tapped his chin while replying.

{What could the great Adjudicator of Dissolution dread? Since you stem from the Vacuous Hyperversal Lineages, are you dreading the purpose you were sent in the Vitalis Havens for? Have you had a change of heart after all these years? Or was it after joining the Curagulus of Extremity?}
His words were sharp as the eyes of the Adjudicator of Dissolution squinted.

{The way you speak easily arouses anger, you know? You can look at me and assume you know my whole story. You can assume to understand what I have been through and where I am now. But I assure you...it will not come even close.}
A dark light flashed in her eyes as great waves of vicissitude and sorrow leaked from her, with her gaze being unfocused as she gazed up into nothingness while continuing!

{The day I was born, it was etched in my existence that I was absolutely nothing. In the years that followed, I was taught that I was worth nothing. After all these years, after all the twists and turns, what I truly want...}
With a gaze that was seemingly seeking the impossible, her hands rose up to the nothingness above as she continued.
{What I truly was is to-}
BOOOM!
The havens shook before her words could finish.
The explosive sound...actually emanated from her.

Her expression turned drastic as this Zenith Tier 3 Hyperversal Extremity gazed towards her chest where a blinding singularity had bloomed- this singularity radiating extremely pure Vacuous Hyperversal Authority!
{No...not so early, not yet!}
A sense of desolation and shock welled up within her as she spoke, a phenomenon blooming after something activated inside her very existence.
This phenomenon...she wasn't the only one experiencing it as across the Seven Havens, similar phenomena began to bloom at this very moment!

chapters.title: Chapter 2734 An Unchangeable Destiny! III
paragraphs: 2734 An Unchangeable Destiny! III
Not so early.
Not yet!

These were the words she uttered as they could hold any myriad of meanings, but at this moment, the erupting singularity caused her expression to shift from shock to sorrow, to unwillingness, and ultimately indescribable resignation!
The singularity of Vacuous Hyperversal Authority only became more potent and immense as in front of her, Noah rose with a serious expression.
She stared towards him with a gaze of desolation as she clutched her chest and continued.

[I thought and calculated that I had more time. I thought I could alter my fate. I sent my main body into the Supernal Havens of Extremity to seek something to change my fate. To change my destiny...but it seems that for some of us, there always exists an Unchangeable Destiny.]
Around her figure, a blaze of obsidian flames of Vacuous Hyperversal Authority rose as the Singularity on her chest caused it to cave in before it began to split wide open.
The unique Havenly Authority of Dissolution was shockingly then pulled into the Singularity on her chest as an unfathomable resonance bloomed!
Seeing this scene, her gaze became even more forlorn as she shook her head in desolation!

[In life, some Existences are given the opportunity to make their own choices. To choose how they want to live their lives. To pursue what makes them happy. Some of us...never had that option. And it seems that no matter how we try to change it...]
Her last words were left unsaid.

An abstruse phenomenon bloomed around her as in front of her, Noah's eyes that now burned with his Extremity Soul could see many things, and even he was astonished at what he was observing as he saw the Extremity Clone of Svetlana become anchored in space, the Singularity on her chest actually mixing with Dissolution before it began to split open- her very Lifeforce and Extremity Soul Values being used as ingredients for a shocking reaction!
At this scene, Oraculum buzzed in Noah's mind as it actually wasn't able to light up any paths for him to follow regarding this.
There was one possible flickering path that rose and fell as if even after pursuing it, the results would simply be unknown.
[I isolated it to my Extremity Clone in case it was ever activated, but my Main Body will follow soon enough to keep it steady and active.]
Whatever was occurring was becoming more and more irreversible as she spoke, her gaze coming to lock on Noah at this moment as she smiled with despondency and unbound unwillingness.
[You know, your eyes are truly similar to my Master.]
WAA!

[You gaze at me now as I'm sure you are thinking and discerning what you can do, but behind your eyes...I can see a level of apathy. You don't really care what happens to me...so I don't know why I even shared my woes with you. The most I see is you wishing to pay back the karma for the little help I've given you...but at the end of the day, I am nothing to you. Just like the Master had said over and over again, I will never be anything to anyone. Just a tool...
just a tool...]

As she said her last words, obsidian tears fell from her wide eyes that were becoming unfocused, Noah observing an intrusive foreign authority rising and encroaching upon her very soul as the Adjudicator of Dissolution was put in a numb state of existence!
Seeing this development, Noah's gaze became stern as with shining eyes, his figure shot forward at this moment as he stepped on the only observable path whose results remained unknown!
As he moved, his hands reached out as his palm split open, serene and pure waves of his Havenly Quintessential Hyperversal Emperor Lineage Blood flowing out freely.
Not just a contained Blood Source.
But waves of his Blood!
If there was a foreign interference seeking to influence and usher forth something from Svetlana, he would see if his own interference could counter this and what result could be ushered forth.

But even as he did this, the reaction already initiated was unstoppable as after achieving a set level, the Singularity that was splitting her chest open entirely exploded as a brilliant light shot above them.
A light...that formed into a serene illusory bridge.
Yes- a bridge!

Its structure pulsed and was formed with Dissolution layered over Vacuous Hyperversal Authority, its mere appearance causing roaring booms to erupt in the surroundings as the very Haven itself seemed to reject this abomination.

But the mixture of Dissolution held the rejection at bay as thereafter, in the span of nothingness above them...a brilliant white light began to shine as another illusory bridge was seemingly reflected opposite to the obsidian one!
One bridge was anchoring itself within the Nether Haven of Dissolution, while another bridge was anchored elsewhere.

At this moment, these two bridges were brought together as Noah's will buzzed while taking in all of this information, many records being unveiled before his eyes as what he saw was quantified and stated!
[Havenly Bridge of Dissolution]
This was the distinction of the illusory Bridge that stemmed from the split chest of the Adjudicator of Dissolution, and the milky white bridge that was now burning with hellish white flames...
[Infernal Bridge of Anarchos]
Anarchos.
An Infernal Authority from the Vacuous Hyperversal Domains!

Noah had observed Acheron, Perdition, and now he was gazing at the flaming white authority of Anarchos that represented an Infernal Haven within the Vitalis Domains that was bathed in hellish white flames.

The moment it appeared, the Extremity Soul Values and Extremity Vitality Values from the Extremity Clone of Svetlana became drained at a shocking speed as these two bridges pulsed, gradually turning from illusory to becoming real and filled with structure.

And the moment they gained even a semblance of stability...these two bridges actually had tendrils of Vacuous Hyperversal Authority connect them- the Infernal Bridge of Anarchos seemingly in its own spacetime continuum while the Havenly Bridge of Dissolution was within the Haven of Dissolution.
And at that moment...
HOONG!

A resonant horn boomed out as from the ends of the Infernal Bridge of Anarchos bathed in white flames...the aura of Vacuous Hyperversal Extremities rose as on the very end of the bridge, Noah's will saw Legions upon legions of Vacuous Malignancies stepping into the Bridge and making their way over.

paragraphs: 2735 An Unchangeable Destiny! IV
[Well damn...]
Noah gazed at the two dazzling connected bridges of Havenly and Infernal Authorities as he marveled at their brilliance!

It was a glorious and terrifying move on the part of the Vacuous Malignancies as when he looked at the overall situation, he speculated that what was occurring here may also be occurring in other Havens.
But it couldn't be to the extent of what was happening here as unless there were other Existences similar to Svetlana in other Havens, what happened there should only be to a lesser extent.
The focus here remained on Svetlana as currently, her Extremity Clone was transforming into something else entirely.
When Noah gazed at her now, a new identity appeared above her head.
[Anchor of the Havenly and Infernal Extremity Bridges]
An Anchor.
If an anchor was destroyed, naturally whatever it was anchoring would also be destroyed with it.
SHAA!

Noah arrived before her visage that was at the very end of the Havenly Bridge of Dissolution, his gushing waves of blood splattering onto her torn figure as it radiation an extremely potent golden glow!

As Legions of Vacuous Malignancies traversed across an illusory bridge that was quickly becoming very real, Noah's Blood and Will began permeating the very crux of this new terrifying Construct as even he didn't know what result would come from it.
What he did know...was how distinguished his lineage had become after his Extremity Soul bathed over it and everything else within him.
This gave him a level of confidence in this endeavor.
Amidst this shocking unfolding reality, Noah's perception of time barely moved as he took an instant to observe the prompts that had come with the elevation of his Lineage.

[As the Progenitor of the Havenly Quintessential Hyperversal Emperor Lineage, the 100,000% Increased Rate of Progression towards and past Extremity has been elevated by ten times due to your unique Extremity Soul, making this value 1,000,000% currently.]
[The feature of Illuminating Light of Quintessence has been elevated to allow you to take 45 Concepts that have attained Extremity and converge them into a single Dynamis of Extremity.]
A brilliant feature whose words had to be read carefully was elevated.

It only allowed for Noah to take 45 Concepts that had reached Extremity and converge them! It was elevated so much that this upgrade didn't even affect Noah currently, with him truly being able to utilize this feature when his concepts attained Extremity.
At that time...what Indefatigable would be capable of doing...what Thanatos and Oraculum and all the other Dynamis would be able to do...it was heart-
shaking to even imagine!
Then, there was Havenly Quintessential Link- one of the sources of Noah's confidence.

[Havenly Quintessential Link has been elevated to the extent that you can now view the Recorded Histories of the members of your lineage, and you can even obtain or alter their Records, Extremity Authorities, or other forms of Authorities and Concepts of Extremity at the cost of your Extremity Soul Values.]
Havenly Quintessential Link.

With this feature, he was able to share the senses of those in his lineage along with being able to open a Havenly Bloodline Rift and appear anywhere within a thousand light years of the chosen target. Now, its power became even more obscene.
Lastly, there was Obfuscation.

[Havenly Quintessential Obfuscation has been elevated to the extent that as the Progenitor of the Havenly Quintessential Hyperversal Emperor Lineage, you can now erase your records and existence passively and actively even against Tier 4 Hyperversal Extremities. Your very records can be so expertly controlled and veiled to the extent that even if you were standing in front of a Tier 4 Hyperversal Extremity, they would not be able to perceive that you were there.]
Obfuscation gave a middle finger to the pristine authority of Tier 4 Hyperversal Extremities.
He could veil his records and fool their eyes with the distinction of Absolute Inscrutable II Existence, but he could not even stand in front of them...and they wouldn't know he was there.
It was heavy.
It was slightly overpowered!
But this was all just him.

His Lineage itself gained lesser versions of these features, but the most astounding ones was a set of new add ons that could very well alter the very power structure of the Vitalis Hyperversal Domains.
Noah gazed at the set of prompts that showed this.

[Any existence holding the Havenly Quintessential Hyperversal Emperor Lineage can now be granted the authority of Quasi-Primitive Vitalis Manipulation, with a feature of Vitalis Gene Manipulation unlocked in their bloodline as threads of Vitalis Hyperversal Authority will be naturally absorbed in their Aspects of Existence until they undergo the First Vitalis Awakening.]

[Any existence holding the Havenly Quintessential Hyperversal Emperor Lineage can now be granted the authority of Quasi-Primitive Vacuous Manipulation, with a feature of Vacuous Gene Manipulation unlocked in their bloodline as threads of Vacuous Hyperversal Authority will be naturally absorbed in their Aspects of Existence until they undergo the First Vacuous Awakening.]
[In a single entity, either the feature of Vitalis Gene Manipulation or Vacuous Gene Manipulation can be activated- not both.]
Among the many boons his Extremity Soul granted to his Lineage, Noah saw this one being the most impactful on a scale even he hadn't fully calculated.
One of the Main difficulties of the existences within the Vitalis Hyperversal Domains was how difficult it was for them to even undergo Vitalis Awakening.
With his Lineage alone...Noah may just be able to bridge this gap!
This was his Lineage after being bathed by his Extremity Soul.
It gave Noah a sense of confidence for what he was trying to do, his blood splattered on Svetlana's split figure and current existence as an Anchor as his Blood began permeating into her eroded soul.

At the same time, the booming horns became even louder as at this juncture, the Vacuous Hyperversal Legions coming from the Infernal Bridge of Anarchos reached the scaffolding of Vacuous Hyperversal Authority at the center of the bridge, crossing past it and stepping onto the Havenly Bridge of Dissolution as they pierced into the Vitalis Havens!

The authority of Obfuscation and Inscrutable II Existence flashed over Noah's body floating next to Svetlana as he remained right where he was, the fantastical fact that unless a being exceeding Tier 4 came from the Bridges before him- no other Extremities would be able to see that he was right here unless he wished them to.
This was how stupendous his power was becoming.
And as the situation became ever serious with his focus placed on Svetlana...
[Primogenitor, what the hell did you just do?]
The buzzing voice of the Seer of Sima buzzed in Noah's mind even though he had turned it down to the lowest.

[Primogenitor, did you advance another Gradation of Extremity? What your Bloodline can do now...Primogenitor, did you already calculate how massive an effect this is going to have on the Vitalis Havens? Oh, and what conflict is there for you to make guidelines that hurt the Avernus Clan? Are you actually connected to that Osmont waging war against them? Primogenitor? Can you really not hear me? Hello?]
Her will was carried forth as her words expressed a semblance of the profound changes and alterations to the scales of power about to bloom in the Vitalis Hyperversal Domains.
But...how would these very domains fare when for the first time in History, Vacuous Malignancies were arriving into the heart of these Havens?!

chapters.title: Chapter 2736 You can’t even see me! I
paragraphs: In the Nether Haven of Helios.
Above a distinguished domain known as The Chambers of the Senatus.

A single Minor Haven stretching for millions of light years stood tall as it was surrounded by hundreds of Planes of Existence, this whole Domain holding an innumerable number of quintillions of beings as it was a core area within the Haven of Helios!
Here, forces of all Seven Clans were stationed permanently as it was one of the areas where the ruling force of the whole Havens resided.
A core area where members of the Senatus of Extremity would at times meet.

Yet on this day, above this domain- the stellar space split apart as an illusory bridge burning with Helios and Vacuous Hyperversal Authority appeared, a scaffolding connecting it to a fiery obsidian illusory bridge of the Infernal Authority of Perdition also coming to fruition!
Others may not know, but the size and scale of this bridge was much, much smaller than the one that had already appeared in the Nether Haven of Dissolution.

And yet it formed quickly as by the time that dozens of Tier 3 Vitalis Hyperversal Extremities and three Tier 4 Entities rose from the Chambers of the Senatus, a blinding Obsidian light had already crossed the bridge from one end to another as they appeared protectively in front of the {Anchor of the Havenly and Infernal Extremity Bridges} that had initiated this shocking construct.

This obsidian light materialized to radiate a shocking aura of a Tier 4 Vacuous Extremity, an Entity who held the form of a Titanic octopus with thousands of massive tendrils of tentacles that burned with Perdition!

It stared at the incoming Tier 4s and Tier 3 Vitalis Extremities and roared out with malice and power, and on the illusory bridge that was gradually becoming more and more real...Legions of Vacuous Malignancies began to tumble forth.

The scene was unreal to observe as behind the Vacuous Legions, numerous Hyperversal Savior's Arks could be seen as the surrounding region had already become permeated by a field of Vacuous Hyperversal Authority.

A scene like this...was not isolated just to the Nether Haven of Helios. In the Nether Haven of Genesis, an illusory bridge also appeared in the space above another major important landmark as within moments, tendrils of Vacuous Hyperversal Authority began to spread out across the region- followed by the roars of Vacuous Malignancies surging in.

In the Nether Havens of Oceanus, Andromeda, Elera, and Penumbra...similar scenes such as these repeated as a move of immense power and might was played, existences that had been entrenched in the Vitalis Havens of Extremity being activated and making a move at this moment.
A move that was bound to be recorded in History and alter the landscape of what was to come!
In the billowing waves of Vacuous Hyperversal Legions outside of the Vitalis Havens of Extremity.

In the far, far back of these waves of Legions, within an isolated domain filled with potent Vacuous Hyperversal Authority- the voice of an existence who had managed to step on the Fifth Gradation of Extremity spoke as he received waved of feedback and records.
{Everything is flowing smoothly?}
His voice was booming and calming at the same time as around him, the voices of Tier 4 Vacuous Extremities rose in affirmation one after another.
{Yes, the Extremity Bridges are forming and stabilizing within all Seven Havens of Vitalis. Seeing them in action now...just how did he come up with this? Its crux is still a mystery even to me.}
A Tier 4 replied while seeing the scene of a glorious Extremity Bridge that connected their forces into the Vitalis Hyperversal Domains.
At his words, the existence of the Fifth Gradation of Extremity nodded with a smile as he nodded.

{Yes...it is a rudimentary application of the Records left behind by the Hero of Vacuous on his brief observation of the Ones Above Extremity, but it works wonders regardless. Now...the question remaining is what their response will be. The core lands of Vitalis were closed off until recently as this War...it cannot even be considered started until their so called Supernal Havens get involved. Until from them, others like me get involved. All of those that are entrenched and hidden from the current Records will gradually be drawn out as at that time...}
His visage was shrouded in waves of obsidian light as he could barely be discerned.
He didn't finish his last words as he seemed to gaze upwards at something even he didn't know.
He held a gaze longing and despondency.
Despondency!
On a Tier 5 Hyperversal Extremity!
It was a wonder what could make such an extinguished being despondent as he continued.
{...at that time, maybe a path will open up for us. We have to end this endless cycle of war and death by making this the very last War. When the dust settles, we can finally rest.}
His words were filled with mystery as when hearing them, those around him felt their eyes shimmer with brilliance as they moved forward with their plans.
Far away from them, in the Nether Haven of Dissolution.

Tendrils of Anarchos and Vacuous Hyperversal Authority had spread out from the area where the Extremity Bridge was established as at this point, the auras of four Tier 4 Vacuous Extremities had appeared in front of the massive and many waves of Legions as throngs of Tier 3, 2, and 1 Vacuous Extremities came behind them.
At the end of the bridge, Noah placed his hands on the ruptured visage of Svetlana who had become an Anchor as he watched these beings appear with a cold gaze.

And then, the scene that occurred next expressed the glory of his own power as two of the Four Tier 4 Vacuous Extremities came towards his position, one having the figure that closely resembled a Four Armed Minotaur while the other held a bestial visage of a Four Winged Tiger whose wings were an Aurora of Vacuous Hyperversal Authority.
The aura of the Four Winged Tiger was the most potent as his thunderous voice echoed out while coming close to the Anchor and gazing at it while nodding!
{Spread out in this region and establish an impenetrable stronghold. Do not let a single Vitalis Malignancy step foot even a thousand light years within this region.}

chapters.title: Chapter 2737 You can’t even see me! II
paragraphs: His words were undeniable as his whole figure pulsed with tendrils of Vacuous Hyperversal Authority, the flames of Anarchos pulsing on his body and falling off like molten lava as this being and four others radiated terror.
Floating next to the ruptured body of Svetlana, Noah watched this powerful Entity and the others who took up different positions in this region.
They were beings he couldn't even touch right now as just this one before him held a dense number of Crimson Hyperversal Havenly Extremity Rune Scriptures- and these were just those visible.
He couldn't yet fight them.
And yet...he still held a power that even they couldn't see through as even at this moment, none of them knew or realized that he was floating right in their midst!
This was now.
In a day or two as he processed the immense gains from utilizing the Bow of Helios to decimate over a thousand Tier 1s and a hundred Tier 2s- how much closer would he be to them?
This question buzzed in his mind and caused him to look forward to the future as next, his rousing will of Tyranny rose as his voice began to ring out in the surroundings fearlessly!
{Not even a single Vitalis Malignancy can come close to the Extremity Bridge?}
His voice rang out in the surroundings.
The Tier 4 Four Winged Tiger dripping with white molten Anarchos heard it as he began to reply.
{Yes. Our goal-}
His voice stopped an instant after.
His authority then blazed as a terrific Haki instantly descended on every nook and cranny for nearby light years!
This was because the Four Winged Tiger very quickly realized this voice did not stem from any of the Vacuous Extremities, and nor could he find its source.
This was an appalling discovery as it laid out the possibility of a powerful enemy they couldn't even locate yet.
{Cover all areas, encircle the Anchor!}

His voice thundered out as the pristine powerhouses who were closing off space in the distance retreated back into this region, their wills waving around madly as their powerful Souls searched for the unknown enemy!
And yet...they couldn't find anyone.
They could not sense anything.

And such a phenomenon only caused them to become more stern as only Tier 3 Extremities and below continued to move along with the continued flow of Hyperversal Savior's Arks that came out from the Extremity Bridge behind them.
The Tier 4s were ready to take action as the most powerful one spoke out coldly soon after.
{I was expecting a grand welcome and battle for finally arriving in the Vitalis Havens. I didn't expect my first host to be one who wouldn't even dare to show themselves and stand before me!}
WAA!
Imperceptible tendrils of terrifying Dynamis of Extremity rose up as these...were Dynamis formed from multiple Concepts that had attained Extremity.
Their power was Unfathomable as they could alter records and reality at will!
And yet even they couldn't overcome the absolute quality that was granted by Noah's Awakenings, Lineage, and Extremity Soul.
Such a grand accomplishment caused Noah to reply grandly as his voice seemed like it was coming from all around.
{It is not that I do not even dare to show myself...it is that you cannot even see me!}
{You cannot even see me, and you expect to win this coming war?}
Stellar words that caused the Tier 4 Vacuous Extremities to turn somber while the Legions around them got ready for battle rang out.
The pride of the powerful Tier 4 Vacuous Extremities was struck at as Noah didn't stop, his voice echoing out with a sigh!

{It truly is a pity for you guys. When fighting for any cause or initiating any wars, you all should have done it years ago before I appeared. You were just unlucky to do all of this during my reign as now...your history and eons of accomplishments can only be a backdrop to my Quintessential destiny.}
DUM!
The surroundings of the nearby Haven boomed at these words!
Mere backdrops to a Quintessential destiny.
Quintessential!
This word caused the eyes of the Vacuous Hyperversal Extremities to flicker with brilliance as whether by coincidence or truly just pure chance, another heavy vibration echoed out at such a moment.
DUM!
This time, it had a source.
Eyes and Wills turned over to a certain direction.

In the distant skies of Dissolution, light years away from the position where the Havenly Bridge of Dissolution and Infernal Bridge of Anarchos had bloomed...there was the ever radiant obsidian Extremity Vein that stretched out endlessly into other Havens.
At this moment, the Extremity Vein pulsed and radiated a light of glory- a light that actually stretched out towards the shining Bridges in the distant space!
And a moment later...
RIIP!
Vein Rifts bloomed close to the dazzling Bridges and the Legions of the Vacuous Malignancies that were crossing through.
Vein Rifts!
The very same one that sparked off the Culmination Step of Extremity Sanctification of Dissolution!
They appeared one after another as they were massive in stature, vibrant auras beginning to rise from within these rifts.

And an instant later, from these Vein Rifts...an archaic air of life and abundance erupted as gigantic and pristine plants the size of Minor Worlds floated out, and in their midst, humanoid figures that seemed to contain features of plants could be seen.
Each of them shone with a powerful verdant light of Havenly power as they...were from the Four Hyperversal Havenly Extremity Lineages- the Hyperversal Havenly Plantae Extremity Lineage!

In the lead, a towering ancient Oak Tree with dense Crimson Hyperversal Havenly Extremity Rune Scriptures of {LIFE} moved, millions of roots anchoring themselves onto the space around this region as it will at the Fourth Gradation of Extremity seemed to exceed any others on this stage.
Noah gazed at the appearance of these existences as at this time, the forces of the Supernal Havens of Extremity...finally began to join the War.
And in the midst of all this Noah's eyes flashed as a myriad of prompts appeared before him- having finally made some progress after he drenched Svetlana's existence with his Blood.
{Your Lineage has entrenched itself into a portion of the Aspects of Existence of the target.}
{A foreign will of an indeterminate level of power comparative to yours is also pervading the soul of the target!}

His voice stopped an instant after.
His authority then blazed as a terrific Haki instantly descended on every nook and cranny for nearby light years!
This was because the Four Winged Tiger very quickly realized this voice did not stem from any of the Vacuous Extremities, and nor could he find its source.
This was an appalling discovery as it laid out the possibility of a powerful enemy they couldn't even locate yet.
{Cover all areas, encircle the Anchor!}

His voice thundered out as the pristine powerhouses who were closing off space in the distance retreated back into this region, their wills waving around madly as their powerful Souls searched for the unknown enemy!
And yet...they couldn't find anyone.
They could not sense anything.

And such a phenomenon only caused them to become more stern as only Tier 3 Extremities and below continued to move along with the continued flow of Hyperversal Savior's Arks that came out from the Extremity Bridge behind them.
The Tier 4s were ready to take action as the most powerful one spoke out coldly soon after.
{I was expecting a grand welcome and battle for finally arriving in the Vitalis Havens.
I didn't expect my first host to be one who wouldn't even dare to show themselves and stand before me!}
WAA!
Imperceptible tendrils of terrifying Dynamis of Extremity rose up as these...were Dynamis formed from multiple Concepts that had attained Extremity.
Their power was Unfathomable as they could alter records and reality at will!
And yet even they couldn't overcome the absolute quality that was granted by Noah's Awakenings, Lineage, and Extremity Soul.
Such a grand accomplishment caused Noah to reply grandly as his voice seemed like it was coming from all around.
{It is not that I do not even dare to show myself...it is that you cannot even see me!}
{You cannot even see me, and you expect to win this coming war?}
Stellar words that caused the Tier 4 Vacuous Extremities to turn somber while the Legions around them got ready for battle rang out.
The pride of the powerful Tier 4 Vacuous Extremities was struck at as Noah didn't stop, his voice echoing out with a sigh!
{It truly is a pity for you guys.
When fighting for any cause or initiating any wars, you all should have done it years ago before I appeared.
You were just unlucky to do all of this during my reign as now...your history and eons of accomplishments can only be a backdrop to my Quintessential destiny.}
DUM!
The surroundings of the nearby Haven boomed at these words!
Mere backdrops to a Quintessential destiny.
Quintessential!
This word caused the eyes of the Vacuous Hyperversal Extremities to flicker with brilliance as whether by coincidence or truly just pure chance, another heavy vibration echoed out at such a moment.
DUM!
This time, it had a source.
Eyes and Wills turned over to a certain direction.

In the distant skies of Dissolution, light years away from the position where the Havenly Bridge of Dissolution and Infernal Bridge of Anarchos had bloomed...there was the ever radiant obsidian Extremity Vein that stretched out endlessly into other Havens.
At this moment, the Extremity Vein pulsed and radiated a light of glory- a light that actually stretched out towards the shining Bridges in the distant space!
And a moment later...
RIIP!
Vein Rifts bloomed close to the dazzling Bridges and the Legions of the Vacuous Malignancies that were crossing through.
Vein Rifts!
The very same one that sparked off the Culmination Step of Extremity Sanctification of Dissolution!
They appeared one after another as they were massive in stature, vibrant auras beginning to rise from within these rifts.

And an instant later, from these Vein Rifts...an archaic air of life and abundance erupted as gigantic and pristine plants the size of Minor Worlds floated out, and in their midst, humanoid figures that seemed to contain features of plants could be seen.
Each of them shone with a powerful verdant light of Havenly power as they...were from the Four Hyperversal Havenly Extremity Lineages- the Hyperversal Havenly Plantae Extremity Lineage!

In the lead, a towering ancient Oak Tree with dense Crimson Hyperversal Havenly Extremity Rune Scriptures of {LIFE} moved, millions of roots anchoring themselves onto the space around this region as it will at the Fourth Gradation of Extremity seemed to exceed any others on this stage.
Noah gazed at the appearance of these existences as at this time, the forces of the Supernal Havens of Extremity...finally began to join the War.
And in the midst of all this Noah's eyes flashed as a myriad of prompts appeared before him- having finally made some progress after he drenched Svetlana's existence with his Blood.
{Your Lineage has entrenched itself into a portion of the Aspects of Existence of the target.}
{A foreign will of an indeterminate level of power comparative to yours is also pervading the soul of the target!}

chapters.title: Chapter 2738 Their Rise Tips the Scales! I
paragraphs: 2738 Their Rise Tips the Scales! I
He finally made headway into the Soul of a Zenith Tier 3 Hyperversal Extremity.

This action held great importance as the Adjudicator of Dissolution currently acted as the Anchor for the biggest Extremity Bridge established within the Vitalis Havens, and if Noah could gain control of the Anchor...
[The autonomy of the Soul will be required if there is a chance of altering the records of the target.]
The prompts continued to come as his Will felt like it was traversing light years of Records of the one known as Svetlana.

[Your Havenly Quintessential Hyperversal Emperor Lineage has latched onto the Source Records of this existence as your will spreads across their Records and towards their Main Body. Regaining Autonomy of her Soul in conjunction with your own power may allow the successful alteration and transformation of their Soul.]
The prompts showed the uncertain path that Noah could try with the Adjudicator of Dissolution.

Her Soul was under the influence of an indeterminate authority as at this moment, Noah felt his will traverse across space and time to flow towards the Main Body of Svetlana that had entered the Supernal Haven of Dissolution!

Half of his will left behind the utterly majestic scene of powerhouses from the Hyperversal Havenly Plantae Extremity Lineage arriving from Vein Rifts and the War about to erupt against the Vacuous Malignancies here.
This will traversed across the Records of Svetlana as the scenes observed by this will gradually changed until...
WAP!
Records pulsed as his will carrying rivers of his Blood flowed across Histories to arrive into the main body of the Adjudicator of Dissolution that was within the Supernal Haven of Dissolution.

Her main body was currently situated on a shattered Archipelago that seemed to have been in this state for thousands of years, its landmasses still holding a sense of power as they floated serenely while supported by tendrils of Dissolution.

Amidst the shattered landmasses, her figure was covered by a veil of Dissolution as her eyes were closed, her expression showing a sense of difficulty and pain as if she were fighting a great battle in an unconscious manner.

It was at this time that Noah's will carrying rivers of Blood began to flow freely into her body, her Aspects of Existence trembling as it seemed yet another force had entered her to vie for the hegemony of her very Existence.
And she could do nothing about it as already, she was losing her sense of self.
Yet at this time...
HUUM!
A shock boomed from the surging rivers of Blood that were entering her existence as her Soul was roused.

It flickered with light as it awoke ever so slightly, a trace of awareness within her opening its eyes as Svetlana found herself in a crimson gold world- everything around her painted with this color as in front of her, Noah's figure appeared draped with a crimson gold robe that pulsed with a Havenly glow.
Just like her, he sat atop a golden sea of authority as they seemed like the only two beings here.
His eyes rotated with Nine Pupils in a shocking manner of grandeur as his voice thundered out towards the sliver of awareness before him.

[I'd normally continue a discussion with you about your Unchangeable Destiny, your sad history, and how you can actually overcome all of that...but we just don't have time. So, if you actually want a chance to regain autonomy and control of your soul and break free of whatever shackles were holding you down before, I need you to cooperate and not just let my authority permeate through you, but actively help it in doing so.]
His eyes glowed with awe inspiring power as he spoke, Svetlana blinking her own eyes as her awareness fully came to and she sensed the state of her existence!
A rueful expression bloomed on her face as she gazed at Noah closely for a second before she spoke.
[On the border of light and darkness, of good and evil...you don't actually consider yourself good, right? Some sort of hero or savior who aids the poor masses?]
At her words, Noah rose as the golden sea of blood beneath him churned, his figure instantly appearing before the sliver of awareness of Svetlana as his hand reached out to her.

[There's no need to analyze me. I'm no hero, and I'm no savior. The only reason I'm saving you now is for my own benefit. Just like the countless humans before me, I'm just a selfish being fighting for myself and those depending on me. So don't have any grandiose dreams about what I am...and decide now whether you grasp onto my authority, or perish into the eons of History.]
His words were low, and yet they felt like strikes of thunder as they resonated.
He knew every being he had killed, and he had killed far, far too many.
He obtained their memories and records- so he knew every single one closely!
He had destroyed countless civilizations and established powers since his rise- with them either being entirely extinguished or devoured by his Infinite Hyperversal Haven.
No, he was no savior.
He was only a man. A man with grand ideals and an unquenchable Quintessential thirst to understand the wonders that lay out there!
[Haha...]
Svetlana laughed while her fair hand reached out towards Noah's outstretched hand.
[...I wonder how big of a mistake this will be. It feels like I'm exchanging the control of my soul from one Demon to another. And you...seem to be a much more callous demon than my Master!]

Her face held traces of unwillingness and resignation that she erased entirely at this moment- two hands coming in contact as a moment after, the crimson gold world around them collapsed as rivers of extremely potent golden blood surged like snakes and barreled into Svetlana's awareness!

At the same time, Noah felt his Extremity Soul Values and Mana Values begin to drain rapidly as the Hyperversal Bow of Helios in his hands that was about to start sniping the Vacuous Lifeforms coming from the Extremity Bridge within Dissolution came down.

He would need every ounce of Extremity Soul Value for what was to come as it seemed he would be altering the records of a Zenith Tier 3 Vacuous Extremity while trying to erase the marks of a Tier 4 Vacuous Extremity and whatever he left behind on her!

chapters.title: Chapter 2739 Their Rise Tips the Scales! II
paragraphs: 2739 Their Rise Tips the Scales! II
As a great battle of wills was about to unfold within the Aspects of the Adjudicator of Dissolution...an even more significant event was occurring elsewhere.

In the domain within the very depths of the Vacuous Hyperversal Legions outside of the Vitalis Domains where multiple Tier 4 Vacuous Extremities and an existence on the Fifth Gradation of Extremity were taking the lead in a lot of the movements currently occurring with the War.
[My Extremity Clone has secured the Extremity Bridge within the Haven of Oceanus. Only the auras of two Tier 4s are worth worrying about and approaching, but I have Diego for support...]
The situation within the Havens their forces had managed to pierce through was relayed at a quick speed as dense waves of information were brought in, analyzed, and processed quickly.
The Entity of the Fifth Gradation of Extremity oversaw all of this with a stern expression as there couldn't be any mistakes.
Since he was taking command at this point in time, he had to perform in a way that the others could not gain any ammunition to speak negatively on the course of this war!
And things were proceeding smoothly.
Exceedingly so at that as all Extremity Bridges were enacted without issues.
All that had to happen now was-
[You dumbfuck, look at that smug expression on your face when everything is about to start going wrong.]
A new voice instantly erupted as from the folds of this domain, space warped while the image of an Entity with a terrifying aura appeared!
Her visage was reality shaking as it was a young woman in a light obsidian battle dress that radiated the aura of a Middle Grade Armament of Extremity.

Her lush hair flowed with black and gold strands of light as her fair skin shone with a lustrous glint. Her face emanated unrealistic beauty as on her forehead, a unique runic ecriture of indeterminate origins was etched.
Her appearance caused the aura of the Tier 4 Vacuous Extremities to be reigned in while the Tier 5 Entity had his face become cloudy as he continued.
[Why are you here...and what do you mean?]
The Entity of the Fifth Gradation of Extremity who had been controlling the pace of the battle so far did not like the Entity that had appeared.
There were many reasons, but the first and foremost reason was...her foul mouth.
[Are your ears not fucking working? Everything. Is. About. To. Go. Wrooong.]

She spoke her last six words slowly and in a very demeaning way, the expression on the Tier 5 Entity becoming entirely dark as the Tier 4s acted like they weren't hearing this discussion at all- focusing on their work!
And yet even as his shoulder face became darker, he didn't erupt against this being as he reigned in his anger while asking calmly.
[What exactly did you find now? How will things go wrong when everything is currently flowing so smoothly?]

The newly arriving woman floated towards his shrouded figure with a stoic expression on her face, her nose wrinkling as if she could smell something that caused her great displeasure as even the slightest facial muscles only further expressed her unrealistic beauty.

[While you're already beginning to celebrate, another anomaly with the potential to derail your whole war has risen. His addition tips the scales as he should already start disassembling your moves soon. If he isn't stopped, all I've seen so far is a great deal of True Deaths, and one set back after another that will slowly take you further from your purpose in this war.]
Her words were shocking ones as even the Tier 4s turned grim when they heard them.

Just who could this enemy be? How terrifying was his expertise in the Gradations of Extremity that his addition in the overall picture would tip the scales so much to be capable of beginning to derail the whole war?!
The Entity at the Fifth Gradation of Extremity had his expression become cold as he asked with somberness.
[Who is it? What Gradation are they in? Entities at our stage have not even begun to appear yet.]
Was it one of the prominent Vitalis Malignancies in the past who had veiled themselves in the eons of space and time? Did they already begin to move this early?
But at his question, the woman adorned in a Middle Grade Armament of Extremity shook her head with an annoyed sigh as she replied.

[That's the thing, he isn't even in the Gradations of Extremity yet. If you're too useless to erase him and stop his rise now before he advances into another stage of power...then you deserve the next loss. You can claim the title of Dipshit Infernal Emperor after that.]
[What!]
Her anger inducing words that were stated last were entirely filtered out from his mind as he focused on the first set of words.
The enemy who would derail their plan and begin causing heavy problems in this War...wasn't even on the Gradations of Extremity yet? He hadn't even attained Extremity?

[Don't fucking scream what. Just take care of it, and don't alert the old assholes of Vitalis about him while trying to kill him, otherwise it will become a lot more complicated. Remember, his appearance tips the scales to heavily favor Vitalis- but he is still at a stage where he can be killed. You'll need to move yourself if you want to succeed in eradicating him, and you'll also need someone with access to the Vitalis Annals of Extremity to fully kill him. Do this quietly and quickly, and make sure every move you make counts.]
Her words only became more and more obscene to listen to as their content was utterly maddening.
The target was an existence that hadn't even achieved Extremity...and a Tier 5 had to be deployed?
The Tier 4 Vacuous Extremities had their wills buzzing in alarm as the shrouded face of the Entity at the Fifth Gradation of Extremity only became more and more stern.
[You got it?] And yet, a nonchalant question was the only thing this demoness in front of him asked.
Silence reigned before the rough voice of the Entity rang out.
[Who...or what is he?]
What anomaly was this existence?
At this question, the woman with tendrils of black and gold hair smiled as the darker surroundings brightened up with a show of power and glory.
[An interesting guy seeking to open up a Dead Path, it seems. Even I wasn't able to discern too much after I discovered him through the effects of his actions- but his name is Noah...Noah Osmont.]
WAA!

[I would help you further by telling you where he is, but the effects of his actions are seemingly running across all Vitalis Havens as locking onto his position is hard. Give it your all and find someone else compatible in the Vitalis Annals of Extremity to track him down, otherwise...ah, you already know. Fall from glory, grace, power, and all that bullshit.]
After she said these words, her figure began to flicker as she was seemingly about to leave just as quickly as she had appeared.
[Wait.]
The Entity called out calmly as this terrifying woman before him tried to leave, his words continuing to ring out.
[Why don't you join me in seeking and eradicating him? With you, the chances of success should be near if not already at 100%. The others haven't even noticed him, but you have. With your aid...]
His words were calm and filled with reason, and yet...
[Give a guy an inch and he takes the whole fucking light year...I've already come here out of my own volition to help you, and you ask me for even more help? The fucking nerve...]
She shook her head with profound annoyance as the shrouded figure of the Entity remained calm, but they pulsed with a trace of anger!
His deep voice once more came out after a moment.

[Why would you not lend aid at such a critical moment? This war is meant to uncover the hidden and cultivated forces of Vitalis as we gain the information needed to finally take steps towards ending eons of fighting. With your authority, finding this Osmont shouldn't be a problem as I do not see a reason for you to not lend me your aid.]
A deep silence descended.
Her figure that was becoming wrapped in an obsidian spatial light reappeared briefly as her fair face full of shocking beauty was filled with annoyance, her voice echoing out once more.

[A reason? I don't need a reason. I don't care if this war is won or lost. You all can just continue killing each other over and over again and see where it brings you. Vitalis, Vacuous...at the end of the day, it's all bullshit. And most of you idiots will continue to live and die without ever knowing why. Fuck. It angers me just thinking about it. Anyways, good luck, and don't fuck it up.]
WAP!
With such words, this terrifying existence left as a stark silence was all that remained thereafter.

None of them cursed her out nor reacted negatively to what she said as even though her character and demeanor were the worst, she was one of the terrifying tools to arise within the Vacuous Hyperversal Domains in the eons that had passed!
An existence known as the Cimmerian Architect.
An Entity whose name was entrenched not just within the Vacuous Annals of Extremity, but also in the Vitalis Annals of Extremity!
And she brought forth shocking news of a newly rising enemy who would greatly tip the scales of war.
[Noah Osmont.]
The name thundered out from the Entity at the Fifth Gradation of Extremity as his voice continued soon after.
[Find out everything there is to know about him from our contacts within Vitalis.]
As he spoke, his own eyes pulsed with a terrifying light as he thought for a little while before soon after...his will moved to contact someone who would be able to help!
The goal was a simple one.
To balance out the scales of war once again to their favor as for this...Noah Osmont had to die.
