The Entity called out calmly as this terrifying woman before him tried to leave, his words continuing to ring out.
[Why don't you join me in seeking and eradicating him?
With you, the chances of success should be near if not already at 100%.
The others haven't even noticed him, but you have.
With your aid...]
His words were calm and filled with reason, and yet...
[Give a guy an inch and he takes the whole fucking light year...I've already come here out of my own volition to help you, and you ask me for even more help?
The fucking nerve...]
She shook her head with profound annoyance as the shrouded figure of the Entity remained calm, but they pulsed with a trace of anger!
His deep voice once more came out after a moment.
[Why would you not lend aid at such a critical moment?
This war is meant to uncover the hidden and cultivated forces of Vitalis as we gain the information needed to finally take steps towards ending eons of fighting.
With your authority, finding this Osmont shouldn't be a problem as I do not see a reason for you to not lend me your aid.]
A deep silence descended.
Her figure that was becoming wrapped in an obsidian spatial light reappeared briefly as her fair face full of shocking beauty was filled with annoyance, her voice echoing out once more.
[A reason?
I don't need a reason.
I don't care if this war is won or lost.
You all can just continue killing each other over and over again and see where it brings you.
Vitalis, Vacuous...at the end of the day, it's all bullshit.
And most of you idiots will continue to live and die without ever knowing why.
Fuck.
It angers me just thinking about it.
Anyways, good luck, and don't fuck it up.]
WAP!
With such words, this terrifying existence left as a stark silence was all that remained thereafter.

None of them cursed her out nor reacted negatively to what she said as even though her character and demeanor were the worst, she was one of the terrifying tools to arise within the Vacuous Hyperversal Domains in the eons that had passed!
An existence known as the Cimmerian Architect.
An Entity whose name was entrenched not just within the Vacuous Annals of Extremity, but also in the Vitalis Annals of Extremity!
And she brought forth shocking news of a newly rising enemy who would greatly tip the scales of war.
[Noah Osmont.]
The name thundered out from the Entity at the Fifth Gradation of Extremity as his voice continued soon after.
[Find out everything there is to know about him from our contacts within Vitalis.]
As he spoke, his own eyes pulsed with a terrifying light as he thought for a little while before soon after...his will moved to contact someone who would be able to help!
The goal was a simple one.
To balance out the scales of war once again to their favor as for this...Noah Osmont had to die.

chapters.title: Chapter 2740 Their Rise Tips the Scales! III
paragraphs: Noah Osmont had to die!

This truth was uttered within the mind of a Tier 5 Vacuous Entity as soon after, he moved with utmost caution- to the extent that he even masked his very own thoughts that were directed towards this being.
With the means of Tier 4 or Tier 5 Entities, one could easily feel when others had killing intent towards them as they could prepare.
This Entity didn't want Noah Osmont to even know that he was coming.
He didn't want this rising threat to prepare or have any means of retaliation under his belt!
He would be thorough.
He was the current Director of this War, but he could be replaced at any time.
BZZT!

At this thought, his shrouded visage flickered as an Extremity Clone formed of extremely potent Authority appeared beside him- taking his place as for this, his Main Body would be the one to make a move.
{Olga, Katia...with me. The rest of you, continue with previously assigned tasks.}
At his words, two female Tier 4 Hyperversal Extremities pulsing with terrific waves of power rose and accompanied the Entity at the Fifth Gradation of Extremity.
He was known by a few distinctions in the Vacuous Hyperversal Domains, being a leader of the Yog-Nyarvax Lineage- one of the Nine Hyperversal Infernal Extremity Lineages within the Vacuous Havens!
Yog-Nyarvax were Entities known for their Titanic worm-like bodies that were immensely hard to kill- especially so the further they traversed across the Gradations of Extremity.
They were also known as the Devours of the Olden Records.

They were Lifeforms who could uniquely traverse to the past Records of their enemies when they were weaker and begin devouring them from there- with the Primogenitor of their Lineage being titled the Prime Devourer.
The Prime Devourer!
The Primogenitor of the Yog-Nyarvax Infernal Extremity Lineage!

Such a being had his main body flicker away while accompanied by two Tier 4 Vacuous Extremities, his thoughts already moving and sending communications to another Entity at the Fifth Gradation of Extremity who would be able to aid him.
Thereafter, once they made their move...it would be a deadly one to end this rising threat that would tip the scales of War!
{Any other pertinent issues as we respond to the Legions of Vacuous Malignancies appearing within our Havens?}
A deep voice filled with an oppressive might of power rang out in a domain that couldn't be accessed unless one went through layers and layers of Records of Authorization.

Its surroundings flowed with pristine purple tendrils of Andromeda as minute white wisps of Vitalis Hyperversal Authority also flowed, with this region being filled with 81 thrones anchored in specific positions.
An impenetrable purple boundary then covered the periphery of these thrones as this...was one of the fortified Chambers of the Senatus of Extremity where its members could meet in a heartbeat!

The Senatus of Extremity was vast as its members were in the billions, but the core existences were an elected 81 Senatus Members who met and decided the fates of the innumerable masses of the Nether Havens of Extremity.

A Chamber like this was one that moved across the spacetime continuum as sometimes, it would be in Andromeda like today, or its location could be in Genesis, Penumbra...or anywhere else within the Seven Havens the next day.
Currently, all 81 Senatus Members were present to address the unfolding War and oppressive move from the Vacuous Malignancies.

They were all either Extremity Clones or traces of Souls of those holding seats in the Senatus of Extremity as their Main Bodies were already on the move to react and defend against the Vacuous Malignancies- very few Entities actually having their Main Bodies here.
Very few...but the existence that had spoken with a deep voice radiated an oppressive pressure of his main body as the aura he released...was that of the Fifth Gradation of Extremity.
He was known as The Rhetorician of the Senatus of Extremity!
The one who presided over their matters and spoke to control all discussions as he had to be listened to.
The other 80 Senatus Members on their own thrones circling in this domain wondrously held auras of Tier 4 Hyperversal Extremity.
This was the collection of power of all Seven Clans and Major Aeonic Inheritances of Extremity of the Nether Havens as their accumulation and might over the years were deep!

{All of the Infernal Bridges that have appeared either have our forces surrounding them, or the forces of the Supernal Havens of Extremity. The figurehead of the Hyperversal Havenly Celestia Extremity Lineage- the one I met anyways, has promised more reinforcements as time passes.}
The one to speak currently was the Extremity Clone of none other than Esteemed Thadeus.
The one who had led the procession of forces of the Senatus of Extremity into the Vein Rifts as a delegation to meet with the powerhouses of the Supernal Havens of Extremity!

His throne was surrounded by golden brilliance as his eyes pulsed with a gold light, strands of golden hair illuminating him and making him visible to all while many other thrones were shrouded by their own unique authorities.
His words garnered a nod from the Rhetorician of the Senatus of Extremity as another voice rose.
{I do have another issue that also relates to this War...and the power of our forces.}
The voice was calm and serene as it came from a throne surrounded by purple flames.
Flames that when they parted, the figure that was revealed was none other than the Seer of Avernus.
Seer Amestris!
The languid and gorgeous eyes of this clone blinked as many eyes turned towards her, her voice continuing to ring out.

{It deals with the weakening and gradual destruction of even our forces on the battlefield. The isolation of the Avernus Clan from means and treasures all others are partaking in, and the killing of our Extremities in a way that does not allow us to keep defending the Vitalis Hyperversal Domains.}

chapters.title: Chapter 2741 Their Rise Tips the Scales! IV
paragraphs: Her words caused the brows of many to rise as they already knew what she was talking about!
The pressure of the Rhetorician of the Senatus pulsed as he probed calmly.
{Oh?}
{Yes, Rhetorician.} Seer Amestris nodded calmly as she waved her hands to show many illusory screens that displayed the woes of the Avernus Clan over the last days!

{Isolation, chaos, deaths. All of these are things the Avernus Clan has faced over the last days as we have the highest death toll when counting all Seven Clans, with our lands currently burning in chaos. All of this stems from a Minor Conflict with this man here...}
She waved her hands once more as the visage of none other than Noah painted an illusory screen!
The eyes of 80 Tier 4s and the Tier 5 Rhetorician of the Senatus focused on this image as Seer Amestris continued.

{It is nothing new. The conflict began on the lower rungs of our forces and gradually grew, with the subject here- Noah Osmont, not revealing he was part of a force of supremacy connected to the Supernal Havens of Extremity as he wasn't treated like an associate or an Entity of the same standing as us. This has led to an unneeded conflict during this war that weakens all of us, with the forces he is connected to cutting off access to the rising Extremity Treasure known as Blood Sources, and our Extremities being butchered as if they were pigs for slaughter.}
WAA!
The sharpness in her voice wasn't contained as it spread out freely!
She gazed at all beings here on their respective thrones as she continued.

{The Avernus Clan is prepared to admit our initial fault in this matter as we seek to bring Noah Osmont to the table and discuss an end to this needless conflict. The woes of any members of the Seven Clans are the woes of the Senatus, and the butchering of 100 Tier 2 Hyperversal Extremities by those from our own Havens is not something we can turn our eyes away from. All of them...were on the front lines fighting against Vacuous Malignancies for the Senatus when they were butchered by those backing Noah Osmont, some who may even be in this very domain.}
A stark silence descended after her words as many of those situated on the thrones gazed at each other.
The Rhetorician of the Senatus of Extremity was calm as his domination figure was revealed.
It was a man built like a mountain, his size massive while sitting on the throne as halcyon threads of light swirled around his magnetic face.
Strands of golden hair fell freely as he spoke calmly.

{The Source of these Blood Sources are from the Supernal Havens of Extremity, none of us can aid you in that. But if the crux of it all is with this Noah Osmont, then we simply need to bring him to the table. Who here has a line of connection with this being?}
His authoritative voice echoed out as many beings silently looked at each other!
Nobody's voice rose for a moment as Seer Amestris spoke once more.
{He shares a connection with the prominent Scions of the Infinite Extremity and the Sima Clan. Some of his bodies have been verified to be within these domains.}
{Oh?}
Her words caused many eyes to turn towards multiple thrones that held the Extremity Clones of Entities from the Sima Clan and the Inheritance of the Infinite Extremity!
Receiving all of these gazes, a Throne representing a Tier 4 Ancestor of the Sima Clan vibrated before the voice of an old man emanated out.
{The one known as Noah Osmont is currently within one of the Domains of the Sima Clan as a guest of my grandson. I can pass on whatever message is decided on here towards his direction at most.}
These words caused a nod to bloom on the Rhetorician of the Senatus as he didn't seem to want to spend any more time on this issue, his voice thundering out.
{Very well, bring this Noah Osmont to the table and we will have the Avernus Clan and him bury the hatchet. What is next on the Agenda?}
The issue was brought up and resolved so quickly that the eyes of some Entities flashed with their own myriad of thoughts.

Days ago, a Representative of the Cult of the Endless Shadows had sought rectification from the Senatus of Extremity for the blatant attack and seizing of their Armament of Extremity, yet none of their complaints were brought to the floor as everything seemed to have been forgotten after the Vein Rifts bloomed in the Haven of Dissolution.
Yet now, the Avernus Clan brought an issue forward as it was already going towards a resolution!
What a difference in response.
What a difference in treatment!

One was an inconsequential Inheritance that didn't even have a single Tier 4 Hyperversal Extremity, while the other was one of the Seven Clans with a deep history and multiple of such Entities within their ranks.
Yet when watching such a reality play out, it was hard not to see the unfairness in this situation!

And as the Rhetorician of the Senatus tried to move past this issue, one of the thrones belonging to the Havenly Moon Clan shone as a feminine voice emanated from it {Well, another issue I wish to bring up may also be connected to this Osmont. It is the Havenly Hyperversal Emperor Blood Sources that the Havenly Moon Clan has obtained in great abundance. We...are finding the power of those who assimilate with these Blood Sources go so far as to double or even triple, and even further advancement is occurring right now as the issue we bring forth is the procurement of these Blood Sources for the armies of the Senatus of Extremity in the front lines.}
Her words were astonishing as Seer Amestris and other representatives of the Avernus Clan couldn't help but turn somber!
They didn't know that the Blood Sources they didn't have access to actually augmented one's power so much.
Other Clans were actually enjoying such boons? And their clan continued to be barred from them? This couldn't continue!

{The Infernal Havenly Commerce of the Supernal Havens of Extremity distributes these Blood Sources to...all who would pay a sufficient price, barring the Avernus Clan. Since their conflict with Osmont leads them to believe he may have a pull with the Infernal Havenly Commerce, we can also communicate with him and see if we can obtain more information on these Blood Sources, and what the larger plans of the Infernal Havenly Commerce are. Obtaining them for all of our forces...is equivalent to multiplying our power many times over.}
WAA!
The words held deep meaning to those who could truly understand the workings of things as the gaze of the Rhetorician of the Senatus of Extremity flickered with brilliance.
This was the second time the name of Noah Osmont was brought up in the agenda of the Senatus of Extremity.
This Entity had to be looked into!
{Very well, Melchior- simply invite this Noah Osmont to come for a briefing in the Chambers of the Senatus of Extremity.}
A command was laid out.
One of the thrones of the Sima Clan shimmered as the aged Entity on it nodded and passed the message on!

At the same time, on a silent throne that belonged to one of the Seven Clans- an entity enshrouded in a dark light grasped a round pearl that pulsed with a gravitational force of millions of Singularities, her authority flowing into it as she sent a message.
On the end of a shimmering Extremity Bridge that held the Havenly Bridge of Helios connected to it, the scene of the Haven of Helios being visible in the far distance.

The spacetime continuum warped from existing to not existing as Vacuous Hyperversal Authority stabilized everything, with Legions of Vacuous Malignancies swirling protectively behind the Infernal Bridge of Perdition as in the next moment, their figures trembled while all Vacuous Entities Tier 3 and below bowed their heads respectively!
This was because the aura of three Tier 5 Infernal Emperors appeared above them with a dozen Tier 4s in tow.

At their forefront, the Primogenitor of the Yog-Nyarvax Infernal Extremity Lineage could be seen as in the next moment, he pulled out a round pearl that pulsed with the brilliance of millions of Singularities.
From it, waves of information came through as the billowing waves of Vacuous Hyperversal Authority around this Prime Devourer pulsed, his voice echoing out.

{I have the possible locations of Osmont. We will gather more information before making a move as the moment we enter the Vitalis Havens, we will have seconds at most before their Havenly Emperors descend to oppose us. Before they arrive, every Record of Noah Osmont must be eradicated.}

chapters.title: Chapter 2742 Impending Danger! I
paragraphs: 2742 Impending Danger! I
A moment after their arrival, every record of Noah Osmont had to be erased!

This was the plan of an Entity that was in the Fifth Gradation of Extremity- an Entity that had brought two other beings of the same stage in addition to 12 Entities in the Fourth Gradation of Extremity.
What did it mean to traverse the Gradations of Extremity? How grander was one's power as they moved from one Gradation to another?
The workings of all of this were established and known as any existence achieving Extremity would step on the Gradations of Extremity.
The distinction of just how far they were on the Gradations depended on just what type of Concept they took to Extremity.

If they elevated a Planar Boundary- an average concept of a small standing to Extremity, they would only arrive at the First Gradation of Extremity as thereafter, they could start on the arduous task of elevating this concept across the Gradations!

It would only have Golden Hyperversal Havenly Extremity Rune Scriptures, but if an Entity was powerful enough to transform their soul and elevate themselves across the Gradations of Extremity, even this concept could have its standing altered from Golden Hyperversal Havenly Extremity Rune Scriptures to Obsidian...and even Crimson Hyperversal Havenly Extremity Rune Scriptures.

The simplest and most average concept of Extremity that was only at the Planar or Innate ranking...could theoretically be elevated to match even Consummate Boundaries that were taken to Extremity if one traversed across the Gradations of Extremity.
This was the Realm that Tier 4 Hyperversal Extremities stepped on.
It mattered not what their concept was as even the most simple sounding one...was something that could release an output and authority as the most distinguished Concepts of Extremity!
It was even theorized that the further one went towards the Gradations of Extremity and neared the peak, the concept of Extremity they were refining...
may even be comparable to the unachievable Dead Paths.
This was a theory.
This was what some Entities discussed with each other as they pondered on the path they followed!
So a force including a dozen Tier 4 Entities and three Tier 5 Esteemed Vacuous Infernal Emperors...was not something that even another Entity on the Fifth Gradation of Extremity could handle.
If such a force moved against an existence, it would only mean certain death!

And to have a glimpse of their power, the Prime Devourer turned to his left where a woman shrouded in a black robe and a pointed hat stood serenely, her gaze piercing as she stared at the Haven of Helios in the far distance.
[The Annals Inquisitor...how quickly would your Will be able to traverse across the Vitalis Annals of Extremity and ensure the complete eradication of this being?]
The Annals Inquisitor.
A Vacuous Malignancy...who had gained access to the Vitalis Annals of Extremity!
This was due to nothing but her Concept of Extremity and the grand achievements it had stacked up.

The Histories of Vitalis and Vacuous Malignancies were all respectively on their own Records, and yet they could kill each other and achieve True Death even if they didn't have access to the opposing Annals of Extremity.
After the Extremity Soul of a target was eradicated, the attack would follow their Records as 90% of the time, it would erase their Recorded History along with it.
Then, there was the small percentage where unique Entities with the power to deeply traverse and hide their Records in the Annals of Extremity existed.
Even if their Souls and existence were eradicated, only a portion of their Records would be erased with their death as if they hid their Records deep enough, a person would still survive!
And if the Records of an Entity in the Gradations of Extremity were still there, their Existence could always flicker into existence again from it.

In such instances, an Entity with proficient access in traversing the Annals of Extremity was required to make sure that no matter how deeply one had entrenched and hid themselves...all of their Records would perish.
Towards the question from the Prime Devourer, the Annals Inquisitor nodded with a sharp light in her deeply green eyes.

[Even if he hid his existence in Unrecorded Histories that have yet to occur, I'll be able to find him and extinguish him. All I need...is to grasp a portion of his Soul in my hands. After that...there will be no more Noah Osmont in any Recorded History or Unrecorded History.]
BOOM!
The words were filled with power and undeniability as with this assurance, the Prime Devourer nodded.
[Then I thank you in advance. The Vacuous Planalith Krystallos will be yours as soon as this task is completed...]
An air of mystery and somberness spread as these Entities spoke while waiting for the perfect moment to make a move.
They would confirm the location and then discern the best moment to strike with their own fantastical Concepts and Dynamis of Extremity.
And after they moved...a Tier 5 Entity would fall, much less a genius who had yet to even achieve Extremity!
[The Records of a foreign authority are being eradicated by your Lineage!]
[The target Entity is having their Records actively altered!]
In the Supernal Haven of Dissolution.

Prompts rose before Noah's eyes in abundance as his Extremity Soul Values were already depleted, with his currently relying on the glorious Extremity Reality Passage shining above his main body as it gushed out and regenerated the little Soul Values he needed every second!

He had Vacuous Hyperversal Authority cover any other deficiency as his Lineage actually erased the History of a Zenith Tier 3 Vacuous Extremity- something he wouldn't be able to do at this stage as the only reason he was...
was because the Entity themselves was working with him.
Svetlana herself lowered all defenses and let him rampage in her existence as Noah sank his hooks in and burned away an immovable authority that had almost made itself part of her.

Her veins, arteries, Innate Vacuous Hyperversal Meridians...every part of her body now flowed with austere golden blood that held traces of Vitalis Hyperversal Authority within it, this Blood cycling into her Heart as the moment it pumped like an engine to spread this Bloodline across her very existence...
BZZT!
An obsidian smoke began to buzz as the skin on her head split open, devilish smoke leaking from it as if she were being purified and made anew.
It was only at this moment a foreign voice full of shock and disbelief boomed out from this devilish smoke that was being expelled.
[What!?]

chapters.title: Chapter 2743 Impending Danger! II
paragraphs: 2743 Impending Danger! II
A single word.
A word that questioned and also proclaimed.

The moment Noah heard it, his Lineage moved with an even more oppressive force as above Svetlana's figure in this region of a shattered Archipelago, an illusory inverted mountainous Reality Passage flashed as rivers of Quintessence surrounded by Vacuous Hyperversal Authority rained down and smashed into Svetlana's figure!
Whatever remnant Will that was branded into her existence this whole time...
BOOM!
Was extinguished and erased entirely at this moment.
A crimson gold light then flashed as the pained expression on Svetlana's face eased, her dark hair gaining a shred of gold at this moment as her fair skin radiated stellar light.

Her figure floated from the shattered landmass she was on as she felt the Blood currently pumping across the vessels and existence, an Unfathomable change beginning to echo out across her that she could barely follow!
[A Quintessential Achievement!]
[Your Lineage has erased the Bloodline Mark of a Tier 4 Vacuous Extremity and greatly altered the Origin and Source of an Entity from an entirely different Existential Authority.]
[Your reach into the Vacuous Annals of Extremity has increased substantially.]
[Your Lineage and Soul has begun to entrench itself into the Anchor of the Havenly and Infernal Extremity Bridges of Dissolution and Anarchos.]
Yes.

Noah didn't just erase the authority of a powerful Entity from Svetlana, he also gained access to the Anchor that was required to stabilize the Extremity Bridge within the Haven of Dissolution that was currently allowing Vacuous Malignancies to cross into the Vitalis Domains.

He could feel Tendrils of himself spread from Svetlana and into the Havenly Bridge of Dissolution, slowly painting this part of the Bridge with his authority as ever so slowly, his will extended towards the Infernal Bridge of Anarchos!
He could feel a wave of possibilities in this direction as at the same time this began, the eyes of Svetlana flashed open while her pupils pulsed with a gold light amidst all the darkness.
And a moment after...her Soul buzzed as the dense Crimson Hyperversal Havenly Extremity Rune Scriptures began to seethe, her aura slowly starting to advance further!
Too many changes were occurring.
Too many transformations were blooming all at once.

Back in the Infinite Hyperversal Haven, Noah's Main Body that still held the Hyperversal Bow of Helios was experiencing even more profound changes as after his Lineage, his Unrecorded Havenly Quintessential Hyperversal Extremity Soul continued to bathe over his existence as it elevated even more parts of him.
[Records of your Traits, Constructs, and Modus Operandi have been fully integrated into your Unrecorded Havenly Quintessential Hyperversal Extremity Soul.]
[The effects of Infinite Mana, Samsara Universal Dao Origin, Protagonist, and the Infinite System have been taken to a Quintessential level.]
The Infinite System.
The Infinite Forge that RUINATION had been recalled into so that she could fully enjoy Noah's elevation of the Soul.
Every single part of him took a step forward at this moment.
In his Infinite Forge, terrifying transformations were taking place as RUINATION took centerpoint, Noah's Extremity Soul painting over her as her hands held onto something at this moment.

It was...the Half-Forged Armament of Extremity remaining after Noah had already replicated it by Plundering one from a Recorded History and then devouring it to fuel the ascension of his Extremity Soul.
She actually grasped it at this moment as...
[RUINATION has culminated a great deal of achievements and multiplied Loot equivalent to the level of Extremity many times over.]

[Ruination is assimilating the Authority of a Half-Forged Armament of Extremity with the aid of your Extremity Soul and utilizing the influx of Loot Light to propel herself towards the stage of Extremity!]
A glorious advancement began.
Since Noah could wield an Armament of Extremity himself due to his Extremity Soul, RUINATION also used the power of his soul to grasp an Armament of Extremity and devour it for her own use.
This was just Ruination.
But because of Noah being connected to so many intricate things, there were many more things affected apart from just her.
There was also the Infinite Hyperversal Haven that Noah had an unbreakable link with.
[The Infinite Hyperversal Haven that you share a quintessential link with has also been influenced by the advent of your Unrecorded Havenly Quintessential Hyperversal Extremity Soul.]
[The Backbone of an Extremity Vein has begun its construction in the Infinite Hyperversal Haven!]
HUUM!
The Aletheian Havens trembled.
The authorities of the Natural Laws and Fundamental Natural Laws churned.
The Decretum of Dreams, Avalon, Fantasia, Elysium, and all others rumbled.
Tendrils of all of these authorities...began to move and gather towards the midpoint of the Infinite Hyperversal Haven as a terrific construct just barely began forming.
An Extremity Vein within the Infinite Hyperversal Haven!
All of these changes were triggered by Noah even though he didn't himself guide them to the destination they were going to.
And as everything sublimated and came together to propel him to a new form of life with all aspects of him elevating...
HOONG!
An influx of information arose and thundered into his being.
Information that caused his eyes to flash with waves of tyranny and Quintessence!
[Daring!]
His gaze changed as he instantly felt an unprecedented feeling of danger.
Not from Oraculum. Not from fate or destiny.
It was from the assimilated trait that was now part of his Extremity Soul.
It was a warning from the Protagonist!
[Forces that wish to end the Cycle of the Hero's Journey have appeared.]
[The assimilated feature of [I Am The Main Character] bellows out in anger at those seeking to end the Cycle of the Hero's Journey and seeks more authority!]
[The Boundary of the Protagonist is being expanded towards Extremity.]
[The First Boundary Layer of the Protagonist has been attained.]
[The Boundary of the Hero is being expanded towards Extremity.]
[The First Boundary Layer of the Hero has been attained.]
[The Boundary of the Villain is being expanded towards Extremity.]
[The First Boundary Layer of the Villain has been attained.]
[The Boundary of the MacGuffin is being expanded towards Extremity.]
[The First Boundary Layer of the MacGuffin has been attained.]

In quick succession, four more Boundaries were added onto Noah's tally as they were then placed into his Quintessential Hyperversal Extremity Meridians, their Boundaries seething and transforming as they were taken towards Quintessential Zenith while very, very quickly propelling themselves across the Boundary Layers.

chapters.title: Chapter 2744 They don’t know they’re fighting the Protagonist! I
paragraphs: 2744 They don't know they're fighting the Protagonist! I
The effects of the Extremity Soul fully pervaded all parts of Noah as their effects were stellar, to say the least!
But they weren't the only new Boundaries to be expanded by the Protagonist.
After this concept ridiculously took itself and Hero, Villain, and MacGuffin towards Extremity, it tyrannically roared out as if it wasn't done!
[The Boundary of Systems is being expanded towards Extremity.]
[The First Boundary Layer of the Systems has been attained.]
[The Boundary of Cheats is being expanded towards Extremity.]
[The Boundary of Skill Trees is being expanded towards Extremity.]
[The Boundary of Cultivation is being expanded towards Extremity.]
[The Boundary of Plot is being expanded towards Extremity.]
[The Boundary of Harem is being expanded towards Extremity.]
[The Boundary of Ascendancy is being expanded towards Extremity.]
[The Boundary of Plagiarism is being expanded towards Extremity.]
DUM! DUM! DUM!
Fanfare erupted all around as with every expansion of an utterly ridiculous Boundary, this fanfare only became louder and more obscene!

The erupting symphony seemingly emboldened the Protagonist as it continued to test unfathomable boundaries, roaring out and wishing to establish ultimate glory as it sought to expand one more concept at this point in time, with other possibilities reserved for it at a later time.
With indomitable momentum, it sought to establish one more concept.
[The Boundary of Extremity is being expanded towards Extremi-]
BZZT!
The prompt never finished.
A spark came, tried to bloom, and fizzled out right after as Noah's immense Extremity Soul buzzed before a massive crack appeared at its very center- a grievous injury occurring at this moment!
[The Boundary of Extremity has failed to be expanded towards Extremity.]
[There is insufficient Authority to expand such a Concept towards Extremity as every time one tries to expand it and fails, a heavy injury equivalent to their current power may occur.]
The Protagonist slowed down.
It gazed at the heavy injury within its Extremity Soul as it seemed it had gotten ahead of itself, with some concepts actually still being far from its grasp at this moment!
But this was okay.
Apart from itself, Hero, Villain, and MacGuffin, the boundaries of Systems, Cheats, Skill Trees, Cultivation, Plot, Harem, Ascendancy, and Plagiarism were obtained.

As these concepts were added to his Quintessential Hyperversal Extremity Meridians and began their advancement across Boundary Layers while being elevated to the ranking of Quintessential Zenith, the huge crevice of his Soul began to heal rapidly.
Around his figure holding the Hyperversal Bow of Helios, Authorities of different colors surrounded him and swirled in a glorious manner as he seemed to be the center of a rotating stellar system!
And in an ever present grandeur....
DUM! DUM!
Drums and trumpets blared out in an upbeat symphony of new beginnings.
They wanted to cut short the advancement of the Protagonist.
They wanted to leave the Protagonist on the stage of Death and Rebirth...with him never undergoing Rebirth!
But they didn't know.
Oh, they didn't know!
[Mere extras that haven't even appeared before me, and yet they think they can put a stop on my glorious path?!]
Waves of wild Tyranny swirled as the True Emperor of Quintessence loudly proclaimed!
Mere extras tried to step on his Quintessential path, not knowing they were fighting the Protagonist!
They would learn.
They would come to understand!
BOOOM!

Explosive tendrils of utterly dreadful boundaries being taken across Boundary Layers rapidly exploded around his body, the swirl of authority around him turning into typhoons that were distorted and bent with the sheer pressure he released as a terrific and sensational transformation took place.

Far below his figure, towards the middle point of the Infinite Hyperversal Haven, rivers of Dreams, Fantasia, Prana, Apollyon, Elysium, Avalon, Niflheim, and Quantum all swirled to begin forming a stellar backbone of something that was only termed an Extremity Vein at this moment.
But what type of Extremity Vein would it be? And just what wonders and purpose would it have?!
This would all be determined when the Extremity Vein was no longer a backbone- but the genuine thing that was fully completed.

Along with the Decreta of Dimensions, tendrils of Manadynamics, Entropy, Gravitation...all Natural Laws and Fundamental Natural Laws flowed into the Extremity Vein as thereafter, the newly built Aletheian Havens of Helios, Genesis, Dissolution...they also began to make their way into the Extremity Vein in an ecstatic show of wonder.

The tendrils began to form a line from the middle point of the Infinite Hyperversal Haven- this line then began to increase in length as the backbone was gradually formed as its goal was to wrap around the whole Infinite Hyperversal Haven.

But this like...it wasn't straight at the center point relative to the whole Haven as it seemed to twist diagonally, and the more tendrils flowed into it to give it shape- the more clear it became as the Wills of Noah and his Vassals followed it to observe the line twisting and distorting space, gradually curving towards the ends of the Infinite Hyperversal Haven as this Extremity Vein...
Was actually forming a lemniscate symbol.
A symbol of Infinity!
An Extremity Vein that wasn't a circular line curving and wrapping around Noah's domains- but one that took on the shape of Infinity.
It was an ecstatic beginning to witness as it would leave any beings breathless at the immeasurable wonder.
And beneath all of this wonder- of the forming Extremity Vein and of Noah bellowing out how mere extras dare to even think of stepping on his path...
there were his people.

Some of them were newer than others as being exposed to this scene after they observed Noah grasp an Armament of Extremity and shoot arrows from it that shook their souls at every tug, the current scene was just too maddening!
Aurelia was among the newer faces along with Orion and other Lerneans as her golden hair fluttered while she gazed with incredulity above.
"What the hell is this..."

She saw the clusters of authority exploding around Noah as they had all been watching over the last day, with all of their thoughts in line that he had undergone a tremendous elevation of his soul that was about to end soon as things calmed.
And yet...an even more explosive transformation seemed like it was just beginning as they wondered...would this being ever pause and take a breath?!

Fanfare erupted all around as with every expansion of an utterly ridiculous Boundary, this fanfare only became louder and more obscene!

The erupting symphony seemingly emboldened the Protagonist as it continued to test unfathomable boundaries, roaring out and wishing to establish ultimate glory as it sought to expand one more concept at this point in time, with other possibilities reserved for it at a later time.
With indomitable momentum, it sought to establish one more concept.
[The Boundary of Extremity is being expanded towards Extremi-]
BZZT!
The prompt never finished.
A spark came, tried to bloom, and fizzled out right after as Noah's immense Extremity Soul buzzed before a massive crack appeared at its very center- a grievous injury occurring at this moment!
[The Boundary of Extremity has failed to be expanded towards Extremity.]
[There is insufficient Authority to expand such a Concept towards Extremity as every time one tries to expand it and fails, a heavy injury equivalent to their current power may occur.]
The Protagonist slowed down.
It gazed at the heavy injury within its Extremity Soul as it seemed it had gotten ahead of itself, with some concepts actually still being far from its grasp at this moment!
But this was okay.
Apart from itself, Hero, Villain, and MacGuffin, the boundaries of Systems, Cheats, Skill Trees, Cultivation, Plot, Harem, Ascendancy, and Plagiarism were obtained.

As these concepts were added to his Quintessential Hyperversal Extremity Meridians and began their advancement across Boundary Layers while being elevated to the ranking of Quintessential Zenith, the huge crevice of his Soul began to heal rapidly.
Around his figure holding the Hyperversal Bow of Helios, Authorities of different colors surrounded him and swirled in a glorious manner as he seemed to be the center of a rotating stellar system!
And in an ever present grandeur....
DUM!
DUM!
Drums and trumpets blared out in an upbeat symphony of new beginnings.
They wanted to cut short the advancement of the Protagonist.
They wanted to leave the Protagonist on the stage of Death and Rebirth...with him never undergoing Rebirth!
But they didn't know.
Oh, they didn't know!
[Mere extras that haven't even appeared before me, and yet they think they can put a stop on my glorious path?!]
Waves of wild Tyranny swirled as the True Emperor of Quintessence loudly proclaimed!
Mere extras tried to step on his Quintessential path, not knowing they were fighting the Protagonist!
They would learn.
They would come to understand!
BOOOM!

Explosive tendrils of utterly dreadful boundaries being taken across Boundary Layers rapidly exploded around his body, the swirl of authority around him turning into typhoons that were distorted and bent with the sheer pressure he released as a terrific and sensational transformation took place.

Far below his figure, towards the middle point of the Infinite Hyperversal Haven, rivers of Dreams, Fantasia, Prana, Apollyon, Elysium, Avalon, Niflheim, and Quantum all swirled to begin forming a stellar backbone of something that was only termed an Extremity Vein at this moment.
But what type of Extremity Vein would it be?
And just what wonders and purpose would it have?!
This would all be determined when the Extremity Vein was no longer a backbone- but the genuine thing that was fully completed.

Along with the Decreta of Dimensions, tendrils of Manadynamics, Entropy, Gravitation...all Natural Laws and Fundamental Natural Laws flowed into the Extremity Vein as thereafter, the newly built Aletheian Havens of Helios, Genesis, Dissolution...they also began to make their way into the Extremity Vein in an ecstatic show of wonder.

The tendrils began to form a line from the middle point of the Infinite Hyperversal Haven- this line then began to increase in length as the backbone was gradually formed as its goal was to wrap around the whole Infinite Hyperversal Haven.

But this like...it wasn't straight at the center point relative to the whole Haven as it seemed to twist diagonally, and the more tendrils flowed into it to give it shape- the more clear it became as the Wills of Noah and his Vassals followed it to observe the line twisting and distorting space, gradually curving towards the ends of the Infinite Hyperversal Haven as this Extremity Vein...
Was actually forming a lemniscate symbol.
A symbol of Infinity!
An Extremity Vein that wasn't a circular line curving and wrapping around Noah's domains- but one that took on the shape of Infinity.
It was an ecstatic beginning to witness as it would leave any beings breathless at the immeasurable wonder.
And beneath all of this wonder- of the forming Extremity Vein and of Noah bellowing out how mere extras dare to even think of stepping on his path...
there were his people.

Some of them were newer than others as being exposed to this scene after they observed Noah grasp an Armament of Extremity and shoot arrows from it that shook their souls at every tug, the current scene was just too maddening!
Aurelia was among the newer faces along with Orion and other Lerneans as her golden hair fluttered while she gazed with incredulity above.
"What the hell is this..."

She saw the clusters of authority exploding around Noah as they had all been watching over the last day, with all of their thoughts in line that he had undergone a tremendous elevation of his soul that was about to end soon as things calmed.
And yet...an even more explosive transformation seemed like it was just beginning as they wondered...would this being ever pause and take a breath?!

chapters.title: Chapter 2745 They don’t know they’re fighting the Protagonist! II
paragraphs: 2745 They don't know they're fighting the Protagonist! II
Beside Aurelia and her dazed expression, the figure of Barbatos with her blessed stature appeared with a sympathetic expression as she patted the shoulders of this Golden haired being.

She would eventually be like the rest of them and gradually become numb to the shocking things they saw, but lately...it seemed that more and more ridiculous things were happening that even those who had been with Noah the longest still received shocks!
Their wills were being tested even now as with all this change occurring, space fissured and cracked to the far, far left and right of the Infinite Hyperversal Haven.

It was the polar opposites that seemed like where the ends of Aletheian Havens were, and in such locations, two massive structures began to rise and be constructed from chunks of nearby Aletheian Havens as above them- brilliant runic markings could be seen shining with glory.
To the left, a grand construct the size of a Haven was being built as the runic markings above it read simply...
[Hyperversal Havenly Blacksmith's Forge]
And to the right....
[Hyperversal Havenly Alchemy Hall.]
Two constructs that wanted to make themselves renowned rose with utter majesty!
[The Hyperversal Havenly Blacksmith's Forge seeks to become a forge where Armaments of Extremity can be forged.]
[The Hyperversal Havenly Alchemy Hall seeks to become a pavilion where Planalith Krystallos can be forged.]

The transformations bloomed in abundance as they truly weren't limited to Noah- the effects of achieving his Unrecorded Havenly Quintessential Hyperversal Extremity Soul spreading to all things connected with him.
These were the changes now when he had just attained an Extremity Soul.
So what would be the final product when he actually took his Concepts to Extremity, including the Decreta, Natural Laws, and Fundamental Natural Laws?

These questions would be critical ones for the future to come as for now...the first set of Boundaries taken forward by the Protagonist achieved a great height of power as they were propelled from the First Boundary Layer and all the way into the Seventeenth Boundary Layer in a short period of time.
Amidst the swirling storms of authority, Noah felt his mind buzzing as he received the details of the most prominent Boundary Layers.

[The Seventeenth Boundary Layer of the Protagonist]:: The sublime control of the journey of the Protagonist begins to fall in your lap as the stages of your progression- namely the stages of [A Call to Adventure], [Aid and Cheats], [From the Known to the Unknown], [Challenges and Ordeals], [Point of Death and Rebirth], [Transformation], [Ultimate Boon], [Return], and [Master of Path] are now freely accessible to you up to the point of the highest stage of the cycle you're currently in. The rankings of Items, Concepts, or Entities who are embroiled and connected to you in any of these stages will have their Records and Information available for you to view for a set cost, no matter what height they have reached in the Gradations of Extremity- they will not be masked from the eyes of the Protagonist. The further an Item, Concept, or Entity is on the Gradations of Extremity, the less information is readily available, but information will be there nonetheless. If you can exceed this stage and attain Extremity in the concept of the Protagonist, it may then be possible for you to actively make alterations in the stages of Progression you're in, and even become capable of affecting the Items, Concepts, or Entities embroiled with you within the set stages...

[The Seventeenth Boundary Layer of the Hero]:: The definition of a Hero can vary depending on where you stand. This Boundary Layer of the Hero stands to reward you Quintessential Extremity Loot of your choice whenever you gain enough recognition as a Hero by the vast majority of the Conscious Entities of the Reality around you, or when you perform acts deemed heroic by the vast majority of the Conscious Entities of the Reality around you.

[The Seventeenth Boundary Layer of the Villain]:: Similar to the Hero, one can be defined as a Villain depending on which stance they take across their lifetime. This Boundary Layer of the Villain also stands to reward you with the Quintessential Extremity Loot of your choice whenever you gain enough recognition as a Villain or when you perform acts deemed villainous by the vast majority of the Conscious Entities of the Reality around you.

[The Seventeenth Boundary Layer of the MacGuffin]:: A MacGuffin is a plot device utilized to propel the intricate reality around the protagonist forward. It is usually the cause of conflict or what sets off the journey of the Protagonist, and it could be an item, a concept, or an Entity. There may already be a single or multiple MacGuffins that are currently propelling your reality, with this boundary layer allowing you to choose one item, concept, or Entity and designate it as a MacGuffin. Once selected, unknown and unforeseeable alterations of reality will occur around this item, concept, or Entity. If you can achieve Extremity in this concept, multiple MacGuffins may be available for selection as their existence could cause the stories of all conscious entities around you to resolve around this plot device.

[The Seventeenth Boundary Layer of Harems]:: You have a Harem of distinguished and beautiful Existences, but where are they? Why do they not share the spotlight with you and are left to collect dust in the background? This Boundary Layer of Harems seeks to change that as since no Entity can have a fast rate of progression that will ever come to match yours, this Layer goes a different route to provide a solution. At the current point in time, up to 9 Entities that are considered members of your Harem or the products between you and any members of the Harem- they can be selected to take the place of one of your Reified Sources of Boundaries as they can exhibit 50% of the total power of these Clones. If your concepts have attained Extremity or are much higher compared to them, this selection to have their Soul utilize the power of your Clones will rapidly aid them in going towards and past the Gradations of Extremity as they will feel like the tools they're wielding are their own. With this push, if the members of the Harem or their products between you and them still get left out of the spotlight, the Boundary of Harems can only give up and take a back seat...

chapters.title: Chapter 2746 They don’t know they’re fighting the Protagonist! III
paragraphs: 2746 They don't know they're fighting the Protagonist! III
The layers of the newly expanded boundaries were full of wonder by themselves, but their Seventeenth Boundary Layers were astonishing to look at.

The Boundary of Harems now allowed Noah to share a semblance of his power with a specific few beings, while the Seventeenth Boundary Layers of the Hero and Villain seemed to be two parts of a whole that would pull in a great deal of resources for him.
Whenever he moved, he was always a Hero to some and a Villain to others.
He would be getting both of the rewards for these two Boundary Layers as he navigated the Vacuous and Vitalis Hyperversal Domains!
Then, there was MacGuffin.
It allowed him to choose an item, concept, or entity and designate it as a plot device that may become the center point of conflict or what moves the current reality around him forward.
For this...he has to ponder a bit more on as he could only gain access to doing this again after he attained Extremity in this concept.
There couldn't be any mistakes!
Lastly, there was the Seventeenth Boundary Layer of the Protagonist.
When gazing at it, Noah knew that this was the exact tool among the many that the Protagonist brought forth that he had to utilize.
And so without a delay, as a storm of multicolored authority swirled around him due to other concepts being taken towards Extremity, he activated the authority of the Protagonist.
HUUM!

And his surroundings buzzed as the raging essence in the surroundings calmed every so slightly, a golden light blooming from Noah's eyes and flowing upwards as an utterly massive illusory golden book came into existence.
His figure seemed like a grain of sand before this forming illusory golden book as it looked advanced with sleek margins, and yet it also gave a sense of ancientness as it didn't have a title.

Noah felt his Extremity Soul Values being used up as this book was flung open, his Vassals below him seeing this scene as Aurelia's jaw was fully flung open in shock, and Barbatos who was beside her trying to communicate and tell her she would eventually get used to all this also found herself staring upwards in a stupor!

The Golden book fluttered as bordered pages with the titles of [A Call to Adventure], [Aid and Cheats], [From the Known to the Unknown], and [Challenges and Ordeals] were all passed until a particularly bright page labeled [Point of Death and Rebirth] appeared.
When this page was flung open, the pages of this Golden book pulsed as a reality began to be etched on it.
Not any random reality- but the reality willed to play by the True Emperor of Quintessence that related to the Entities who wished to bring to a stop his glorious path!
The entities who wished to keep him forever in this cycle of a Point of Death and Rebirth.
He would be able to see them no matter what height of power they achieved so long as they were embroiled in his journey!
This statement from the description of the 17th Boundary Layer of the Protagonist remained true as at this moment, the golden page was divided into four separate panels that were currently blank.

As his Extremity Soul Values were drained more and more, the top most left panel began to be filled with colors as in an instant, it showed a scene of crimson gold Minor Haven that was torn from above, with the figures of Noah and Ayame seen at the peak of a Golden mountain as beside them, Ayame's grandfather was passing a Curagulus Mask towards Ayame.

This action was halted as the gaze of all three beings were turned up at this moment, the colored image showing them gazing at the culprits that had torn the Haven above them- three Entities that shone like blinding Obsidian suns!
Each one was shrouded by billowing obsidian smoke, and yet they thundered down like hellspawn bringing down apocalypse as these...were the Entities seeking to end Noah's path.
Noah's eyes flashed on their figures on this top most left panel of the page as with a glimmer, a few bursts of information began to appear above their heads.

[The Prime Devourer]:: The Primogenitor of the Yog-Nyarvax Infernal Extremity Lineage, an Entity at the Fifth Gradation of Extremity. Due to the non-existent traces of the Hyperversal Extremity Authority of the Protagonist, no other information can be obtained.
This was the information attained by the Entity at the very center among the three!
Noah's eyes pulsed with a grand light of tyranny as he realized the identity of his enemy.
[A Tier 5 Vacuous Extremity?!]
His eyes blazed with power and possibilities as after he discerned the identity of this being, he looked at the details of the Entities to his left and right.

[The Annals Inquisitor]:: An Extremity Clone of an Entity at the Fifth Gradation of Extremity who is proficient in accessing both the Records of Vitalis and Vacuous Annals of Extremity. Her achievements make her extremely hard to kill by those at the same stage. Due to the non-existent traces of the Hyperversal Extremity Authority of the Protagonist, no other information can be obtained.

[Primogenitor of Talismans]:: A Hidden Identity of the Cimmerian Architect. She seems to be here just out of curiosity as those beside her don't know her true identity. Due to the non-existent traces of the Hyperversal Extremity Authority of the Protagonist, no other information can be obtained.
The other two were also shrouded in a dark light as their figures couldn't be easily discerned, but Noah found his eyes drawn over to the entity on the right of the Prime Devourer.

An entity whose Identity was hidden even from the other two Tier 5 Vacuous Extremities around her! From this being, Noah felt the greatest level of danger, and she wasn't even here for the sake of killing him!
She was only here to satiate her curiosity.
Her curiosity of...him?
Noah's eyes pulsed as he arrived at this conclusion, his Extremity Soul Values leaking even more as they were used as the paint to color the next panel on the Golden page.

The next panel showed a terrifying scene of Ayame's grandfather torn and shredded into trillions of minuscule pieces, with Ayame herself entirely turned to nothing but ashes as the billowing figure of the Prime Devourer arrived in front of Noah!

chapters.title: Chapter 2747 They don’t know they’re fighting the Protagonist! IV
paragraphs: 2747 They don't know they're fighting the Protagonist! IV
The second panel showed an Entity at the Fifth Gradation of Extremity right in front of Noah's visage!
And behind Noah, the Annals Inquisitor had her hand thrust out and grasping his head as she seemed to be seeking his very records, existence, and location of the Infinite Hyperversal Haven.

Far above them, the Primogenitor of Talismans- the hidden identity of the Cimmerian Architect- she could be seen floating serenely as her hand was flung backwards, a dense cluster of multicolored paper talismans flying out towards the torn Haven as far, far in the distance, roars of Vitalis Hyperversal Authority could be heard.
It was the roars of a Tier 5 Vitalis Hyperversal Extremity that was rushing over!

All of it generated a shocking amount of information as Noah felt as if his soul was being squeezed dry at this moment, with the third panel not capable of forming any picture as his Extremity Values were entirely depleted.
[You do not have sufficient authority to view the progression of possible reality any further within this [Point of Death and Rebirth].]
[You have gained a glimpse of an Unrecorded History with entities at a tremendously high level of Gradation!]
[A Quintessential Achievement!]
Authority buzzed around him as his eyes were clear.

His Nine Pupils seemed to be rotating like nine abyssal Singularities as they remained on the massive book opened to a Golden page with four panels- continuing to stare at the two colored panels that depicted Entities actually hunting him.
Him!
In the war occurring between Vacuous and Vitalis Hyperversal Legions, no Entity at the Fifth Gradation of Extremity had even made a move yet.
And yet for Noah, three Tier 5s came to extinguish his raging flame?!
What did they find out that made them move with such urgency?
'My path is about to be so glorious that even the higher powers of the Vacuous Hyperversal Legions became worried?'
Tyranny and Quintessence flashed in his eyes as he began to compute and think about many things.
He had seen the situation at hand.
The Protagonist had elevated multiple tools as at this point in time, Noah should already have the solution to this insurmountable issue that he faced.

And insurmountable was right as this wasn't even an Entity like the Avernus Extremity Overlord who was at Tier 4 that Noah had to face- they were Entities who could crush those like the Avernus Extremity Overlord within a second!
He had to find a solution to this...and even use this nexus event to come out ever stronger.

So as authorities raged around him and his Extremity Soul finished its transformations on all parts of him, the True Emperor of Quintessence continued to stare at a massive opened book that depicted an uncertain future.

Far below him, his Vassals watched his figure and the Golden book that made them all feel as small as grains of sand, the scenes depicted within the single page being visible to all of them with extreme clarity!
The bodies of Aurelia and Orion trembled.
The owner of the Golden Forge felt as if reality was no longer making sense as her blessed chest heaved up and down.
"He...he can see Unrecorded Histories this easily? What the fu-"
Her words weren't able to finish as she was interrupted a moment after, Kazuhiko stepping forward and pointing to the panels of the golden book with incredulity as what amazed him the most was...
"He can read webtoons of the future?!"
The very fabric of reality seemed to be getting violated around them as after these initial reactions, an angry voice rose as the visage of Barbatos blared with an aura of death.
"That's not the most important thing! Who dares to come for the life of Little Fish? Which of those three bitches needs to die?!"
Her eyes burned with interminable anger as she gazed at the three shrouded figures on the two colored panels.
A gaze of anger like this wasn't isolated to her alone as near the forefront, the figure of Henry gazed at his father who was shining with brilliance as he clenched his fists.
He was supposed to be the Son of Destiny. The Emperor of Destiny!
And yet what was he doing to aid his father?

This question caused the nails in his clenched fingers to dig into his palm until Golden Blood began to flow, tendrils of Vitalis Hyperversal Authority flowing into him at this moment as the Entity with the purest blood within the Lineage of the Havenly Quintessential Hyperversal Emperor began to express the newly expanded effects by an alarming degree.
In a different corner where the Vassals were clustered, Adelaide pulsed with coldness when looking at the panel where two terrifying beings surrounded her man left and right!
She never fought. She was never a combatant. But seeing this scene...it genuinely caused her Blood to seethe.
In another corner, Xiaomi's expression was one of utter coldness as around her, the Hyperversal Extremity Authority of Ruin pulsed and began to run rampant.
In another corner, the Emperor Penguin waved its flippers in defiance!
The feelings of all Vassals here were the same as they looked at the scene above them- at the scene of Noah gazing at the future as he now planned how to navigate it all by himself.
They wanted power.
They wanted to take some of the weight off his shoulders!
To share just some of his burdens, however small!
But knowing the powers out there and their own level of authority...they couldn't help but feel stifled as they truly didn't know if they would ever be able to share any of his burdens.
In the Domains of the Sima Clan.

Noah was within a domain filled with royal purple auroras of light as the land beneath him was also made of pure light, his eyes gazing at the figure of Erikson who was finishing devouring the Extremity Treasures collected by the power of the Sima Clan that could take an Entity to the 17th Boundary Layer in multiple concepts with relative ease.

His body also pulsed with the glow of the Havenly Quintessential Hyperversal Emperor Lineage as he had taken a Blood Source days ago, with Extremity being something he sought sooner rather than later as Probability would be warped in any way he sought to achieve it.
Besides Noah, the figure of the Extremity of Foundation could be seen as with a grim expression, his voice came out slowly.

[The...Senatus of Extremity has called for your presence in their Chambers. I've received word that the issues of you and the Avernus Clan, as well as the Blood Sources and the Infernal Havenly Commerce, are the points of discussion.]

It was the roars of a Tier 5 Vitalis Hyperversal Extremity that was rushing over!

All of it generated a shocking amount of information as Noah felt as if his soul was being squeezed dry at this moment, with the third panel not capable of forming any picture as his Extremity Values were entirely depleted.

chapters.title: Chapter 2748 The True Emperor of Quintessence Gazes at the Senatus! I
paragraphs: 2748 The True Emperor of Quintessence Gazes at the Senatus! I
At the words of the Extremity of Foundation, arcs of light flashed from the eyes of Erikson in the distance as he was roused.
Noah himself was calm while hearing that the Senatus of Extremity was calling for his presence!
This was the Senatus of Extremity.
The governing body of the Nether Havens of Extremity!
The most prestigious Entities were a consortium of the Seven Clans and the most renowned and powerful Aeonic Inheritances.

There were 81 Seats currently active which made all the major decisions, and there were the figureheads of Legions of Vitalis Hyperversal Extremities who could be mobilized with a wave of their hands.
"To be called before them would normally feel like a high honor, but why does it feel like something is off?"
Erikson rose up while saying such words, his father giving a light sigh as even he knew there were too many things at work.
In the vastness of it all, he was only a Tier 3 Hyperversal Extremity.
He may be significant and full of power, gaining the awe of the vast majority, but when the governing power of the very Havens was involved, even he felt small!
He turned towards Noah who didn't seem to have any significant reaction to his words as he continued.
[It is not up to us to determine, but an Ancestor will be here soon to act as the bridge-]
[An Ancestor? Why do you make me seem so old?]
BZZT!
Space twisted and tore.
A white light flashed as from it, an old woman with a cane flickered into existence, her voice full of power and regality as every time she walked, her cane rang out resonantly!
Seeing her figure, Erikson smiled and walked forward to support her as he spoke with care.
"Wise Granny, why are you getting involved in messy matters like this? It's not good for your heart, and we know you're only getting older."
The words were ones that even a Zenith Tier 3 Entity would not dare utter, but Erikson uttered them freely as the aged hand of the Seer of Sima moved to smack his hands away with a harrumph.
[My heart may have been getting old days ago, but it feels renewed with life and vigor after I got myself a new bloodline. A bloodline...that seems to be connected to our new friend here.]
Her gaze became locked on Noah's clone, and Noah's eyes were calm as he looked back at this Entity!
The one who had been capable enough among those who had joined his Lineage to send messages to him across it, with her voice ringing out incessantly every now and then.
He now gazed at her face to face as he could feel his lineage brimming powerfully within her.
PA!
Her cane resonated on the Aurora of lights around them as she walked towards him.
Her figure was adorned in a white robe that matched her vibrant hair, a hazy white light pulsing on her skin that gave off a feeling of age and power!
Her face was that of a wizened old woman, and yet it still held a sense of impeccable beauty as she smiled while coming a few feet away from Noah.
[Is it you? The one I've been speaking at with no replies this whole time? Or is that too outlandish to even imagine?]
Her first set of words were probing ones as Noah smiled while he replied without a trace of authority.
"Whatever could the Young Miss mean?"

[Hah! Young Miss? I've never been referred to as that for the last thousands of years!] The Seer of Sima laughed at Noah's words as her gaze turned even more piercing, staring at Noah silently as she continued.

[Well, no matter. Whatever the truth is will be revealed in due time. The busy little Senators are seeking to understand things just like me, and then there is your War with the Avernus Clan that they wish to discuss. Are you agreeable to appear before them?]
The figures of Erikson and the Extremity of Foundation off to the side gazed at each other with slight shock at the way that the Seer of Sima was talking to Noah.
She sought his opinion on whether he would appear before the Senatus of Extremity or not, as if he could say no and she wouldn't push it!
Since when was the Seer of Sima like this?
Facing her gaze, Noah's eyes flashed with interminable majesty as he placed his hands behind his back while replying.

"Just because others call for me, does not mean I will scramble to go to them. I will not send even my clone to their Chambers as the most I can do for the Senatus of Extremity...is to send a sliver of my soul to listen to them."
Not his main body. Not his clones.
A sliver of his Will at most!

His words were filled with tyranny as the Seer of Sima nodded, her hands waving and causing a crack to appear in space as Noah's eyes saw a dense number of Crimson Hyperversal Havenly Extremity Rune Scriptures swirling with this single move.

[I'm here to act as the bridge connecting the two sides. With the authority I have, I can transfer your trace of soul directly into the Chambers of the Senatus of Extremity through Old Fool Melchior's Seat. As for how things will turn out after that...even I don't know.]
HUM!
The crack in space pulsed as it distorted space and time, forming a bridge from this location and towards the Haven of Andromeda where the Chambers of the Senatus of Extremity were currently meeting!

Noah gazed at this forming crack as a sliver of his will containing a small trace of his soul leaked out from his head, forming into an illusory figure of him that was draped in a white gold Emperor's Robe, his fair illusory skin shining with brilliance as his dark hair flickered with stellar streams of colors every now and then.

He thought of many things, Oraculum and even the Protagonist beginning to be put to use as he wondered what's gains or possible losses could be made from meeting the governing body of the Senatus of Extremity as after a moment, his illusory body composed of a trace of his soul nodded towards the Seer of Sima and stepped towards the spatial crack!

chapters.title: Chapter 2749 The True Emperor of Quintessence Gazes at the Senatus! II
paragraphs: 2749 The True Emperor of Quintessence Gazes at the Senatus! II
Within a secretive domain in the Nether Haven of Andromeda.

Auroras of the Hyperversal Extremity Authority of Andromeda flowed along with trace tendrils of Vitalis Hyperversal Authority within this enclosed domains, 81 Thrones that gazed at each other floating in space as 80 Entities at the Fourth Gradation of Extremity and one Entity at the Fifth Gradation of Extremity had their auras burning brightly on these thrones!
At this moment, one of the thrones designated for the Sima Clan buzzed as the voice of Melchior emanated out.
[I hate to interrupt, but the Entity Noah Osmont that was called upon by the Senatus can appear before us now if we wish to address some of the prior issues.]
[Oh?]

The buzzing and authoritative voice of the Rhetorician of the Senatus rang out as his throne pulsed with golden light, his grand stature raising his right hand as the Chambers became quiet, and he nodded towards Melchior.
HUM!

Crimson Hyperversal Havenly Extremity Rune Scriptures flickered from beneath his throne as a light shone from it- a light that then shot out towards the center of the Senatus of Extremity as a crack in space bloomed!
And from this crack, a unique aura stepped out.

Bathed with brilliance, the illusory form of the True Emperor of Quintessence stepped out of the spatial crack as he entered into a restricted space that very few Entities ever had the honor to gaze upon.
He stepped into the Chambers of the Senatus of Extremity as the moment he did so, the crack he came from dimmed as many eyes and Wills locked onto him!
And his gaze was of utmost brightness as his Will also spread out to observe everything around him.

The aura of powerful entities at the Fourth Gradation of Extremity was maddening to feel, and yet his soul didn't buckle under the pressure as his head remained high, the voice of the Entity who had aided in utilizing their authority speaking out with his arrival.
[I present the one that has named himself the True Emperor of Quintessence, Noah Osmont.]
The voice of the Old Man from the Sima Clan rang out resonantly as thereafter, he smiled lightly while gazing at Noah and continuing.

[Noah Osmont, you stand before the Senatus of Extremity, consisting of the representatives of the Seven Clans and Major Inheritances within our Nether Havens of Extremity. The issues that brought you here today deal with your conflict with the Avernus Clan, as well as the Infernal Havenly Commerce and any knowledge you can shed on their Blood Sources.]

The Sima Clan Ancestor took the time to introduce the issue as the wills of extremely powerful beings swirled around Noah, with his Eyes of Extremity that were bathed with his Extremity Soul watching all 81 Senatus Members here closely as he learned of their names and identities.

Each of them emanated waves of tremendous power as they were all entities he couldn't even injure or touch at this moment, with the Golden haired Titan of a being sitting on the largest throne giving Noah the feeling of most danger as he felt like this being could reach him in the span of an instant!

Were anything to happen here, his guard was up for this Entity the most as he couldn't allow them to even get near him. For this, he had the simple means of dissipating this trace of Soul as none of his records would ever come close to being traced.
His gaze moved on from the most powerful Entity here as he continued to gaze around.
A moment later, his eyes showed a trace of surprise as he turned around to stare at a distant throne behind him where a figure shrouded in a dark light could be seen.
The identity of this being was particularly unique as towards them, Noah smiled devilishly.

[Ancestor Renee](Possessed):: An Entity on the Fourth Gradation of Extremity who has been possessed by a Vacuous Hyperversal Extremity. She stems from the Holy Church Aeonic Inheritance of Extremity as she was exposed to the trace soul of a Vacuous Entity at the Fifth Gradation of Extremity during an important ritual...
An Entity with history and information appeared before him as Noah smiled towards them, the eyes and gaze of this being swirling with a trace of shock as they wondered why he was staring their way!

But he didn't linger on this being for too long as he turned back towards the myriad of other thrones here, glancing at them as he came to lock onto the throne that held none other than Seer Amestris.
The Seer of Avernus.
Seeing this entity with her throne wrapped in purple flames, he smiled while waving his hands towards her throne.
An action that raised brows as it showed the utter lack of respect since these beings were still supposed to be enemies at this point!

The eyes of the Rhetorician of the Senatus rose as his face remained placid, his hands waving at this moment as a throne beside him took a spotlight- revealing a woman adorned in a sleek black power suit with gorgeous golden hair and a pair of glasses that buzzed with the authority of an Armament of Extremity.
She was the Speaker of the Senatus who took the lead on behalf of the Rhetorician of the Senatus when common matters were being dealt with!
She emanated pristine grace and beauty as she pushed up the glasses on the bridge of her nose while speaking out, the authority of a Tier 4 Hyperversal Extremity pulsing from her.
[Noah Osmont. The Chambers of the Senatus of Extremity are a sacred place of power. This is your first time here, so-]
"One second."
She had begun to speak, yet her words were interrupted as Noah stopped gazing around.

The eyes of the Speaker of the Senatus turned sharp as she and all others watched Noah's illusory figure snap his fingers, the space behind him beginning to buzz as a grand multicolored illusory throne bloomed into existence!

Adorned in illustrious runic etchings and cerulean lemniscate symbols, it looks like a throne rising up in the form of a resplendent multicolored mountain as only after it was enacted...did Noah's illusory figure sit atop it with majesty!

The action drew many sharp gazes as Noah's figure sat on his illusory True Throne of Quintessence unabashedly, a flaming multicolored crown appearing above his head as after he was seated, his voice rang out.
"You all were seated in your high thrones as it just didn't feel right for me to not be on mine. Now, you were saying?"
WAA!
A low yet resonant melody of tension and valor began to play in the background.
Imperceptible. Barely discernible. But it was the beginning of a symphony nonetheless!
The immensely powerful entities in these Chambers watched such a scene with shining eyes as no clamor erupted.
The eyes of the Speaker only became sharper as her glasses shimmered with brilliance while she continued.

[The Senatus of Extremity has manner and decorum. When given the space to speak, one speaks. Otherwise, all others listen. One of the issues at hand that brought you here is one that questions your connection to the Infernal Havenly Commerce stemming from the Supernal Havens of Extremity. That...
is a major reason for your wanton act just now to be allowed. Not because of you...but because of the power that stands behind you. Going forward, be mindful of this.]
They could all be his trace of soul wasn't surrounded by any Extremity Rune Scriptures.
Truly, this being before them had yet to even achieve Extremity!
And for him to talk to them and address them as if they were peers?

When they were so advanced on the Gradations of Extremity and even Tier 3 Entities gazed at them with awe and respect? No others said this loudly, but the majority of Entities here expected such a form of respect towards them!
"Oh?"
Her words caused Noah to release a dazzling smile as the Speaker only gazed at him calmly before continuing.
[Yes. But the first and connected issue to address is one with the Avernus Clan. Senatus Member Amestris, go ahead.]
Her words were directed to none other than the Seer of Avernus, the throne of this being lighting up with authority as the purple flames around her throne parted to reveal her astonishing figure.
Her voice was succinct as she stared at Noah while speaking.

[Your conflict with the Avernus Clan began due to a lower-level Extremity belonging to our Clan and was escalated up from there. The Avernus Clan admits fault in this as the ones responsible will be punished, with the Senatus of Extremity bearing witness now to bring an end to this conflict. Whether it is you and the power behind you, or the Avernus Clan...none of us benefit from continued chaos and death. For the good of the Seven Havens, this conflict- this War...must end.]
For the good of the Seven Havens.

These words rang out resonantly as when he heard them, Noah's smile only became brighter as his gaze moved from Seer Amestris and towards the Speaker of the Senatus who stared back at him calmly as if waiting for his reply!
And his reply...
"Oh, am I allowed to speak now?"
His reply was a taunting one.
Many wills buzzed silently once more as the eyes of the Speaker became ever sharper while speaking out the next set of words with blazing authority.
[You may speak.]

"Marvelous" Noah clapped his hands lightly at her words as he continued, "I'm oh so happy to be allowed to address the great Senatus of Extremity in these trying times, and I want to start...with a question."
WAA!
As he spoke, the mocking smile faded from his face as while seated on the throne of Quintessence, his figure emanated glory and stoicism while he continued!

"Days ago, the Avernus Clan took a shit on the Investiture of Extremity, attacking and massacring members of the Cult of Endless Shadows in the Haven of Penumbra as trillions of Lifeforms below the stage of Extremity were eradicated, multiple Extremities were killed, and an Armament of Extremity was blatantly stolen. The members of the Cult of Endless Shadows then raised their hands to the great Senatus of Extremity and called upon your endless power to rectify this matter...and yet were only met with silence as I don't recall hearing any Avernus Members questioned or brought to account."
Quintessence pulsed from his throne as tyranny began to swirl in his eyes!

"Now, the Avernus Clan speaks once after feeling the beginnings of their own destruction as moments after, the respected parties are all brought together as the Senatus of Extremity...addressed this particular issue very quickly! So I came to wonder...just how exactly does the Senatus of Extremity enforce its governance? How does it pick and choose which rules to enforce, and why did the woes of the Avernus Clan get a hearing so quickly when the woes of the Cult of Endless Shadows were never even addressed?"
BOOM!
Authority began to build up.
The True Emperor of Quintessence spoke with majesty as his voice rang out across the Chambers of the Senatus of Extremity!
