Within a secretive domain in the Nether Haven of Andromeda.

Auroras of the Hyperversal Extremity Authority of Andromeda flowed along with trace tendrils of Vitalis Hyperversal Authority within this enclosed domains, 81 Thrones that gazed at each other floating in space as 80 Entities at the Fourth Gradation of Extremity and one Entity at the Fifth Gradation of Extremity had their auras burning brightly on these thrones!
At this moment, one of the thrones designated for the Sima Clan buzzed as the voice of Melchior emanated out.
[I hate to interrupt, but the Entity Noah Osmont that was called upon by the Senatus can appear before us now if we wish to address some of the prior issues.]
[Oh?]

The buzzing and authoritative voice of the Rhetorician of the Senatus rang out as his throne pulsed with golden light, his grand stature raising his right hand as the Chambers became quiet, and he nodded towards Melchior.
HUM!

Crimson Hyperversal Havenly Extremity Rune Scriptures flickered from beneath his throne as a light shone from it- a light that then shot out towards the center of the Senatus of Extremity as a crack in space bloomed!
And from this crack, a unique aura stepped out.

Bathed with brilliance, the illusory form of the True Emperor of Quintessence stepped out of the spatial crack as he entered into a restricted space that very few Entities ever had the honor to gaze upon.
He stepped into the Chambers of the Senatus of Extremity as the moment he did so, the crack he came from dimmed as many eyes and Wills locked onto him!
And his gaze was of utmost brightness as his Will also spread out to observe everything around him.

The aura of powerful entities at the Fourth Gradation of Extremity was maddening to feel, and yet his soul didn't buckle under the pressure as his head remained high, the voice of the Entity who had aided in utilizing their authority speaking out with his arrival.
[I present the one that has named himself the True Emperor of Quintessence, Noah Osmont.]
The voice of the Old Man from the Sima Clan rang out resonantly as thereafter, he smiled lightly while gazing at Noah and continuing.
[Noah Osmont, you stand before the Senatus of Extremity, consisting of the representatives of the Seven Clans and Major Inheritances within our Nether Havens of Extremity.
The issues that brought you here today deal with your conflict with the Avernus Clan, as well as the Infernal Havenly Commerce and any knowledge you can shed on their Blood Sources.]

The Sima Clan Ancestor took the time to introduce the issue as the wills of extremely powerful beings swirled around Noah, with his Eyes of Extremity that were bathed with his Extremity Soul watching all 81 Senatus Members here closely as he learned of their names and identities.

Each of them emanated waves of tremendous power as they were all entities he couldn't even injure or touch at this moment, with the Golden haired Titan of a being sitting on the largest throne giving Noah the feeling of most danger as he felt like this being could reach him in the span of an instant!
Were anything to happen here, his guard was up for this Entity the most as he couldn't allow them to even get near him.
For this, he had the simple means of dissipating this trace of Soul as none of his records would ever come close to being traced.
His gaze moved on from the most powerful Entity here as he continued to gaze around.
A moment later, his eyes showed a trace of surprise as he turned around to stare at a distant throne behind him where a figure shrouded in a dark light could be seen.
The identity of this being was particularly unique as towards them, Noah smiled devilishly.
[Ancestor Renee](Possessed):: An Entity on the Fourth Gradation of Extremity who has been possessed by a Vacuous Hyperversal Extremity.
She stems from the Holy Church Aeonic Inheritance of Extremity as she was exposed to the trace soul of a Vacuous Entity at the Fifth Gradation of Extremity during an important ritual...
An Entity with history and information appeared before him as Noah smiled towards them, the eyes and gaze of this being swirling with a trace of shock as they wondered why he was staring their way!

But he didn't linger on this being for too long as he turned back towards the myriad of other thrones here, glancing at them as he came to lock onto the throne that held none other than Seer Amestris.
The Seer of Avernus.
Seeing this entity with her throne wrapped in purple flames, he smiled while waving his hands towards her throne.
An action that raised brows as it showed the utter lack of respect since these beings were still supposed to be enemies at this point!

The eyes of the Rhetorician of the Senatus rose as his face remained placid, his hands waving at this moment as a throne beside him took a spotlight- revealing a woman adorned in a sleek black power suit with gorgeous golden hair and a pair of glasses that buzzed with the authority of an Armament of Extremity.
She was the Speaker of the Senatus who took the lead on behalf of the Rhetorician of the Senatus when common matters were being dealt with!
She emanated pristine grace and beauty as she pushed up the glasses on the bridge of her nose while speaking out, the authority of a Tier 4 Hyperversal Extremity pulsing from her.
[Noah Osmont.
The Chambers of the Senatus of Extremity are a sacred place of power.
This is your first time here, so-]
"One second."
She had begun to speak, yet her words were interrupted as Noah stopped gazing around.

The eyes of the Speaker of the Senatus turned sharp as she and all others watched Noah's illusory figure snap his fingers, the space behind him beginning to buzz as a grand multicolored illusory throne bloomed into existence!

Adorned in illustrious runic etchings and cerulean lemniscate symbols, it looks like a throne rising up in the form of a resplendent multicolored mountain as only after it was enacted...did Noah's illusory figure sit atop it with majesty!

The action drew many sharp gazes as Noah's figure sat on his illusory True Throne of Quintessence unabashedly, a flaming multicolored crown appearing above his head as after he was seated, his voice rang out.
"You all were seated in your high thrones as it just didn't feel right for me to not be on mine.
Now, you were saying?"
WAA!
A low yet resonant melody of tension and valor began to play in the background.
Imperceptible.
Barely discernible.
But it was the beginning of a symphony nonetheless!
The immensely powerful entities in these Chambers watched such a scene with shining eyes as no clamor erupted.
The eyes of the Speaker only became sharper as her glasses shimmered with brilliance while she continued.
[The Senatus of Extremity has manner and decorum.
When given the space to speak, one speaks.
Otherwise, all others listen.
One of the issues at hand that brought you here is one that questions your connection to the Infernal Havenly Commerce stemming from the Supernal Havens of Extremity.
That...
is a major reason for your wanton act just now to be allowed.
Not because of you...but because of the power that stands behind you.
Going forward, be mindful of this.]
They could all be his trace of soul wasn't surrounded by any Extremity Rune Scriptures.
Truly, this being before them had yet to even achieve Extremity!
And for him to talk to them and address them as if they were peers?
When they were so advanced on the Gradations of Extremity and even Tier 3 Entities gazed at them with awe and respect?
No others said this loudly, but the majority of Entities here expected such a form of respect towards them!
"Oh?"
Her words caused Noah to release a dazzling smile as the Speaker only gazed at him calmly before continuing.
[Yes.
But the first and connected issue to address is one with the Avernus Clan.
Senatus Member Amestris, go ahead.]
Her words were directed to none other than the Seer of Avernus, the throne of this being lighting up with authority as the purple flames around her throne parted to reveal her astonishing figure.
Her voice was succinct as she stared at Noah while speaking.
[Your conflict with the Avernus Clan began due to a lower-level Extremity belonging to our Clan and was escalated up from there.
The Avernus Clan admits fault in this as the ones responsible will be punished, with the Senatus of Extremity bearing witness now to bring an end to this conflict.
Whether it is you and the power behind you, or the Avernus Clan...none of us benefit from continued chaos and death.
For the good of the Seven Havens, this conflict- this War...must end.]
For the good of the Seven Havens.

These words rang out resonantly as when he heard them, Noah's smile only became brighter as his gaze moved from Seer Amestris and towards the Speaker of the Senatus who stared back at him calmly as if waiting for his reply!
And his reply...
"Oh, am I allowed to speak now?"
His reply was a taunting one.
Many wills buzzed silently once more as the eyes of the Speaker became ever sharper while speaking out the next set of words with blazing authority.
[You may speak.]

"Marvelous" Noah clapped his hands lightly at her words as he continued, "I'm oh so happy to be allowed to address the great Senatus of Extremity in these trying times, and I want to start...with a question."
WAA!
As he spoke, the mocking smile faded from his face as while seated on the throne of Quintessence, his figure emanated glory and stoicism while he continued!

"Days ago, the Avernus Clan took a shit on the Investiture of Extremity, attacking and massacring members of the Cult of Endless Shadows in the Haven of Penumbra as trillions of Lifeforms below the stage of Extremity were eradicated, multiple Extremities were killed, and an Armament of Extremity was blatantly stolen.

The members of the Cult of Endless Shadows then raised their hands to the great Senatus of Extremity and called upon your endless power to rectify this matter...and yet were only met with silence as I don't recall hearing any Avernus Members questioned or brought to account."
Quintessence pulsed from his throne as tyranny began to swirl in his eyes!

"Now, the Avernus Clan speaks once after feeling the beginnings of their own destruction as moments after, the respected parties are all brought together as the Senatus of Extremity...addressed this particular issue very quickly!
So I came to wonder...just how exactly does the Senatus of Extremity enforce its governance?
How does it pick and choose which rules to enforce, and why did the woes of the Avernus Clan get a hearing so quickly when the woes of the Cult of Endless Shadows were never even addressed?"
BOOM!
Authority began to build up.
The True Emperor of Quintessence spoke with majesty as his voice rang out across the Chambers of the Senatus of Extremity!

chapters.title: Chapter 2750 You are in MY Presence! I
paragraphs: 2750 You are in MY Presence! I
The Senatus of Extremity was a collection of wills and voices.
Of the major powers that reigned over the Nether Havens of Extremity!
The choices they made and how they led generations of Entities across the Gradations of Extremity...were never questioned.
Others may have their own opinions, but they would never dare to actually voice them.
Yet on this day, an Entity sat in the midst of Tier 4 Vitalis Extremities and before the gaze of the Rhetorician of the Senatus of Extremity as he questioned them!
He asked...why was it that when the Cult of Endless Shadows sought for help and recompense for what happened to them, there was no answer?
And why was it that the Avernus Clan's issues were being addressed so speedily?!
His words were resonant as a tense symphony played audibly, the eyes of the watching Senatus Members shining with brilliance at Noah's words as once more, no clamor erupted!

Noah fearlessly gazed towards the Golden-haired Speaker of the Senatus, his eyes even moving to land on the Rhetorician of the Senatus on the throne beside her as this Entity continued to watch on coldly.
The Speaker was unfazed by Noah's words as her glasses pulsed with brilliance.
[You ask why? Did you think such a question would expose something or make it hard for us to answer?]
WAA!

[The answer is a simple one, O supposed Emperor of Quintessence. The force behind you has allegedly eradicated over 100 Tier 2 Hyperversal Extremities- a number that the Cult of Endless Shadows didn't have even a fourth of. So yes, the Avernus Clan is considered an issue of greater importance to address.]

[None of us are petulant children or Scions who gaze at the world as black and white. As good or evil. There are much, much larger forces for us to think and worry about. The answer that you think we would try and avoid saying...is that at the time, we truly did not believe that handling the Cult of Endless Shadows was worth our time. It was merely an Inheritance whose number of Extremities did not even exceed 50. This force added nothing to the overall picture of the Vitalis Hyperversal Domains, so why would we dedicate time for something irreversible done to it when we were at such a critical juncture? It was beneath us, so it was ignored. This was the choice that was made not just by a select few, but all Senatus Members here.]

Her eyes pulsed with a golden light as she pushed her glasses up the bridge of her nose again, her beauty increasing with every passing second as from her throne, she then began to point towards one force after another in different directions!

[The Havenly Moon Clan. The Inheritance of the Infinite Extremity. The Sima Clan...we all bore the responsibility of not answering the calls of the Cult of Endless Shadows as we considered them beneath our worries. That is the straight answer that you thought would be hard to get out of us. I mention the Sima Clan and Infinite Extremity to let you know that even the forces you associate with...also carry this same responsibility with them. Is that a sufficient answer to your question? Can we now be adults and move to resolve the truly important issues at hand?]
Her monologue ended.

Stark silence permeated the surroundings as the veiled faces of the Sima Clan Ancestor holding seats among the 81 Senatus Members turned dark, other Entities becoming the same when they were given the same label as everyone else!
The stark silence did not last long as...
PA! PA! PA!...
The sound of clapping rang out as the True Emperor of Quintessence did so while seated on his throne.
As if he couldn't agree more with the words of the Speaker of the Senatus!
"Precisely."
Quintessence shone around him as his voice rang out with a sense of magnetism.

"Your words ring true. Just like how you all viewed the Cult of Endless Shadows, I also consider the Avernus Clan far beneath me. Hell, I was able to isolate and fracture the whole Avernus Clan with a single word as before me, what is such a Clan worth?"

"Just like you all did not consider the Cult of Endless Shadows worthy of your time and attention to rectify the wrongs done to them...I also do not feel like the Avernus Clan is worthy enough for me to even think of rectifying their current plight. After all, from your own words...a mere force such as that adds nothing to my overall picture!"
His words buzzed with fearless glory in the face of Entities on the Fourth and Fifth Gradations of Extremity.
The faces of all Entities connected to the Avernus Clan felt their gazes changing as those from other Clans looked at Noah with astonishment!
In their minds, they wondered just what power stood behind him for him to talk like this while under the authority of the Senatus of Extremity.

And such a thought seemed to be clear as day for some as finally...the Speaker of Senatus became stern as her voice emanated out with power, the might of a Tier 4 Hyperversal Extremity moving with her voice.

[We have shown you courtesy on behalf of the force of the Supernal Havens of Extremity you may represent. But know and understand...you are still in the presence of the Senatus of Extremity. You are in the presence of Esteemed Emperors who have built the very backbone of these Havens. The Inheritors of Vitalis and the Rulers that have kept its order for eons! In the presence of such beings, there are things you can and cannot-]
"I sit in your presence?"
HUUM!
The words of the Speaker were interrupted yet again.
The True Throne of Quintessence buzzed as the Emperor atop it was roused.
His dignity seemed to have been set aflame as the pressure of a Tier 4 Hyperversal Extremity actually bore down unto him!
The trace of his Soul here buzzed as such an action roused the billowing and suppressed Tyranny within his very core as he asked once more.
"I sit in your presence?!"

chapters.title: Chapter 2751 You are in MY Presence! II
paragraphs: 2751 You are in MY Presence! II
He was the one standing before the presence of an esteemed council? He should feel veneration and respect by being in the presence of the Senatus of Extremity?
Who did they think they were?!
Billowing waves of Quintessence pulsed from his throne as his voice thundered out into the cold face of the Speaker of the Senatus.

With his flaming multicolored crown spinning, Noah tapped on the armrest of his illusory throne as he uttered out coldly- and this time as he bore the pressure of a Tier 4 Hyperversal Extremity on him, the power of his Unrecorded Havenly Quintessential Hyperversal Extremity Soul spread out.
[No...I am not in your presence.]
Authority.
His voice actually emanated Hyperversal Extremity Authority as it caused some Hyperversal Extremities to rise from their thrones!
Extremity Authority! But they could all very well see that this being's soul did not have even a single Hyperversal Havenly Extremity Rune Scripture as how was such a thing possible?
How could his voice carry the authority of Extremity if he hadn't brought any concept there?
Their questions weren't answered.

The aura around the illusory throne the True Emperor of Quintessence sat on only became more potent as this trace of his soul rejected the pressure from the Tier 4 Hyperversal Extremity, his voice echoing out with majesty.
[I am most definitely not in your presence. You...are in MY presence! You stand before the Tyrannical Emperor. The Gazer of the Unscalable Wall. The Extremity Despoiler.]
WAA!
[You stand in the presence of the True Emperor of Quintessence. You stand before me as for you, it is the highest form of honor!]
The moment these words ended, the multicolored illusory throne shone with blinding light as prompts cascaded over Noah's eyes.
[The Boundary of Tyranny is surging towards Extremity!]
[The Boundary Layers of Tyranny have been scaled at an unfathomable speed!]
Tendrils of purple lightning began to buzz around his throne.
Royal.
Regal.
Majestic!
It was the tendrils of profound Tyranny as his throne and figure very quickly became covered with them!
Surrounded by tendrils of such tyranny, he stared at the cold face of the Speaker that emanated even greater coldness.
Her fair skin and red lips pulsed with a trace of oppression as she uttered out coldly.
[Are you done?]
Her voice now buzzed with a threatening glare.

To her right, the massive throne of the Rhetorician of the Senatus of Extremity remained still as the golden-haired entity at the Fifth Gradation of Extremity stared calmly without reacting to any of the reality playing out!
Noah observed this scene and more as he shook his head while waving his right hand.
[No, I am not done.]

With a glimmer, his right hand produced an illusory screen of light that showed the scene of dozens of Apex Aeonic Lifeforms, four Tier 2 Hyperversal Extremities, one Tier 1, and a Zenith Tier 3 Hyperversal Extremity who were currently seated atop a purple vessel shaped like a celestial mountain.
[This is what remains of the Purple Sun Family that used to belong to the Avernus Clan before they renounced it and left in order to be capable of using the Havenly Bloodline Sources.]
Noah reclined back in his throne as the illusory screen to his right became bigger and bigger, the events within fully unfolding before everyone's eyes.

"All of them are Entities who have attained the Havenly Hyperversal Emperor Lineage. Some have yet to even achieve Extremity. And currently, they are sensing some new changes that have occurred with this Lineage..."
BZZT!
Around the bodies of the meditating Purple Sun Family, space buzzed as extremely thin tendrils of Vitalis Hyperversal Authority began to flow from the surroundings and enter their bodies.
Noah had activated and granted the authority of Quasi-Primitive Vitalis Manipulation as within the bodies of these beings, the feature of Vitalis Gene Manipulation was unlocked.

And once activated, thin threads of Vitalis Hyperversal Authority continued to be drawn into their bodies as the moment this began, the Zenith Tier 3 Ancestor of the Purple Sun Family opened his eyes in utter shock and incredulity, and he was followed by all those around him as they felt the pristine and Havenly glow of Vitalis Hyperversal Authority flowing into all of them!
This reality playing out in the illusory screen Noah had conjured up caused even more Tier 4 Senatus Members to rise from their thrones.
While reclined in his, Noah calmly gazed at all of them before his gaze became locked with the Speaker of the Senatus.

[Vitalis Hyperversal Authority will continue to be drawn into the bodies of all Entities with the Havenly Hyperversal Emperor Lineage passively as after enough is contained within them...only a single thing will occur thereafter.]
[Those with the Havenly Hyperversal Emperor Lineage can undergo their First Vitalis Awakening as easy as the passage of time.]
Seeing the scene before then and hearing the words of the True Emperor of Quintessence before them, many of the Senatus Members were astonished!
Because what they saw...was revolutionary.
It could alter the stage of power of the Vitalis Hyperversal Domains in a terrifying way!
Even the Four Hyperversal Havenly Extremity Lineages of the Supernal Havens of Extremity did not have such a terrifying capability.
On a distant throne, Seer Amestris rose as she could feel a billowing storm from the Aeonic Annals of Extremity, her gaze changing and becoming extremely sour.
A sense of great foreboding descended as Noah's voice continued to thunder out.
[The Avernus Clan will never gain access to the Blood Sources capable of granting the Havenly Hyperversal Emperor Lineage, I will make sure of this.]
WAA!

[All others around them will freely take them and elevate in power, Members of their own Clan like the Purple Sun Family here will continue to leave them as in the days and weeks to come, the Avernus Clan will continue to fracture until it disperses into dust.]
BOOM!
The words were thundering as they felt like a toll of death on one of the major Clans!

The True Emperor of Quintessence said this freely as while gloriously reclined on his throne, with tendrils of royal purple light of tyranny pulsing around him, he spoke words that even these powerful Entities would not be able to forget in their lifetimes.
[One of the glorious Seven Clans will fall without me having to lift even a single finger. This...I promise you.]

Noah had activated and granted the authority of Quasi-Primitive Vitalis Manipulation as within the bodies of these beings, the feature of Vitalis Gene Manipulation was unlocked.

And once activated, thin threads of Vitalis Hyperversal Authority continued to be drawn into their bodies as the moment this began, the Zenith Tier 3 Ancestor of the Purple Sun Family opened his eyes in utter shock and incredulity, and he was followed by all those around him as they felt the pristine and Havenly glow of Vitalis Hyperversal Authority flowing into all of them!
This reality playing out in the illusory screen Noah had conjured up caused even more Tier 4 Senatus Members to rise from their thrones.
While reclined in his, Noah calmly gazed at all of them before his gaze became locked with the Speaker of the Senatus.

[Vitalis Hyperversal Authority will continue to be drawn into the bodies of all Entities with the Havenly Hyperversal Emperor Lineage passively as after enough is contained within them...only a single thing will occur thereafter.]
[Those with the Havenly Hyperversal Emperor Lineage can undergo their First Vitalis Awakening as easy as the passage of time.]
Seeing the scene before then and hearing the words of the True Emperor of Quintessence before them, many of the Senatus Members were astonished!
Because what they saw...was revolutionary.
It could alter the stage of power of the Vitalis Hyperversal Domains in a terrifying way!
Even the Four Hyperversal Havenly Extremity Lineages of the Supernal Havens of Extremity did not have such a terrifying capability.
On a distant throne, Seer Amestris rose as she could feel a billowing storm from the Aeonic Annals of Extremity, her gaze changing and becoming extremely sour.
A sense of great foreboding descended as Noah's voice continued to thunder out.
[The Avernus Clan will never gain access to the Blood Sources capable of granting the Havenly Hyperversal Emperor Lineage, I will make sure of this.]
WAA!

[All others around them will freely take them and elevate in power, Members of their own Clan like the Purple Sun Family here will continue to leave them as in the days and weeks to come, the Avernus Clan will continue to fracture until it disperses into dust.]
BOOM!
The words were thundering as they felt like a toll of death on one of the major Clans!

The True Emperor of Quintessence said this freely as while gloriously reclined on his throne, with tendrils of royal purple light of tyranny pulsing around him, he spoke words that even these powerful Entities would not be able to forget in their lifetimes.
[One of the glorious Seven Clans will fall without me having to lift even a single finger.
This...I promise you.]

chapters.title: Chapter 2752 The Demon of the Seven Havens! I
paragraphs: 2752 The Demon of the Seven Havens! I
A promise.

This was what the True Emperor of Quintessence brought down as at this moment, the thrones representing Esteemed Havenly Emperors of the Avernus Clan burst into righteous purple flames of indignation.
The surroundings buzzed with power as multiple other wills and pressure from entities at the Fourth Gradation of Extremity descended on Noah!
But this was merely pressure.
They had yet to make a move on him with their authorities. And yet even under this pressure, Noah was undaunted as his Extremity Soul buzzed in response.
His soul was unique. It stood far apart from normal Extremity Souls as it was Quintessential!

So how could the pressure emanating from a Soul that had stepped on the Fourth Gradation of Extremity make him stand down? The only one he was cautious of was the Entity that had yet to make any moves or say anything towards him- the Rhetorician of the Senatus of Extremity.
A second passed.
The illusory scene Noah conjured stayed up for this second before it faded away as in this period of time, all Entities here computed and had millions of thoughts cross their minds.

The promise of this Entity seated on an illusory throne as well as the Blood Sources and his connection to the Infernal Havenly Commerce that allowed him to forcefully cause whoever the Primogenitor of this Lineage was to exclude the Avernus Clan...it showed that this being's standing and position in the Supernal Havens of Extremity was not low!
Seeing his Soul give off waves of Hyperversal Extremity Authority when they couldn't see any Hyperversal Havenly Extremity Rune Scriptures was another piece of the puzzle.
All in all, his demeanor and words, and whatever force stood behind him were one of the main things holding back an eruption of authorities at this moment.
Instead, the gaze of the golden haired Speaker became ever chillier as as her voice rang out.

[There are many paths we can take in our Records. Taking on a path of internal fighting and conflict...is not a wise decision. Those behind you should know this. The Primogenitors of the Nether Havens and the Primogenitors of the Supernal Havens have been protecting these lands over the eons that have passed together. Forces of the Supernal Havens never fought against our forces...nor did we kill each other based on vendettas that the other side is seeking to bury. The Avernus Clan seeks to bury this vendetta, this war ongoing between the both of you, and you would rather choose Annihilation?]
She mentioned great secrets and the identities of beings far greater than any of those who sat here.
Of Primogenitors that Noah only knew a few of from the names of Legends they left behind.
Of Entities like Extremity Steel!
At her words, Noah shook his head with a smile while replying.

[How do you forget that this began as an Apex War of Annihilation? Before that War began, I warned all forces trying to exterminate me and my people. Some forces were wise and listened, and other forces chose to push forward. They made a choice then as this...is my choice now. The complete disbarment and Annihilation of the Avernus Clan.]
WAA!
His words were irrefutable.
Immense silence descended as the Speaker's eyes now pulsed with liquified golden light, her voice once more sounding out!

[Taking on this path of conflict with our own people makes you no better than the Demons we face every day. And yet you come from among us as even with all your self-proclaimed titles and distinctions...the only thing you will be known by will be as another Demon.]
Her voice was becoming piercing as she continued.
[Is that the Legacy you wish to leave behind as we start yet another great war with our true enemies? A Demon who is even worse than them- A Demon of these Seven Havens?!]
Her piercing words clapped out like thunder!
And before any other voice could continue...
[Enough.]
HOOONG!
The booming voice of the Rhetorician of the Senatus of Extremity who had been silent this entire time rang out.
From his throne, a terrifying pressure rose as reality twisted and reformed from its mere eruption.

An interminable number of Crimson Hyperversal Havenly Extremity Rune Scriptures swirled around this Entity like an endless sea as under his thundering voice, the Speaker pulled back and sat down on her throne.
Nobody else uttered a word as at this moment, Noah raised his brows while coming to gaze at this being.
Emanating a sense of immense vitality and handsomeness, his golden hair danced on his head like rivers of reality as his eyes swirled with Vitalis Hyperversal Authority!
His eyes fully came to lock onto Noah at this moment as he spoke out slowly.
[Who are you to the Infernal Havenly Commerce? To the Primogenitor of the Havenly Hyperversal Emperor Lineage?]
He didn't speak regarding the Avernus Clan, but on Noah's own Identity!
And Noah only smiled at this as he shook his head.
[Does it truly matter in the end? One way or another, I have the authority that I have, and I do what I want.]
His Will could not be swayed.
He made this known as in their minds, they still didn't ascertain his identity to the force that he himself has enacted in the Supernal Havens!
The gaze of the Rhetorician remained calm at Noah's reply as he spoke again.
[You can select the terms and price you wish with the Avernus Extremity Overlord to end this feud. The Senatus will guarantee whatever terms you have stated will be enforced.]
WAA!
A shocking set of words left his grand visage.
Words that caused the faces of the Avernus Esteemed Havenly Emperors to turn dark as they turned towards the Rhetorician in shock!
What was this? The True Emperor of Quintessence alone would be allowed to set the terms? The Avernus Clan alone would pay the price? And the Senatus would enforce it?!
Why did these words make it seem like the Rhetorician of the Senatus was conceding to this being after seeing his connection to the unfathomable Infernal Havenly Commerce?
[Esteemed Rhetorician, this is not-] Seer Amestris quickly rose to object as before she could even finish, the right hand of the Rhetorician rose as she was silenced.
His gaze remained on Noah.
He waited for see what choice would be made at this point in time!

chapters.title: Chapter 2753 The Demon of the Seven Havens! II
paragraphs: 2753 The Demon of the Seven Havens! II
The Rhetorician of the Senatus of Extremity was different compared to Noah's initial conception of him.
This entity was very direct and to the point as the moment he spoke, his power and words made it so that a definite choice had to be made.
Noah's guard was already up to make a move at any moment he needed to, and he already had in mind what he needed to do for a seamless exit!
So when the Rhetorician of the Senatus offered him the choice to name whatever terms he wanted to the Avernus Extremity Overlord and have the Avernus Clan pay it to end their War...
[No.]
Noah's voice was steady as he denied it.
He stably sat on his illusory throne as he spoke while gazing at the enclosed stellar domain filled with 81 thrones.

[We live and die by the choices we make, and some choices are irreversible. I promised that the Avernus Clan would fracture and disappear into the ashes of history, so this...can be the only outcome. For me to become a Demon by making that choice? I will bear that burden!]
WAA!
[Besides...] His illusory throne pulsed as for the first time, it rotated in space to turn towards the thrones behind Noah.
DUN!
A beat began to pick up in the surroundings again.
DUN!
Drums of coming chaos began to play as the True Emperor of Quintessence turned around while speaking a set of words that would throw everything into chaos!
[...I do not make deals with a Senatus of Extremity that claims to protect the sanctity of these Seven Havens from the Vacuous Malignancies when within their very ranks...]
His turned throne came to stare in a direction that had a single Entity that Noah had smiled at before.
He stretched out his words slowly as it was like a burning truth was slowly carved out!

His eyes came to land on a particular Tier 4 Hyperversal Extremity as their eyes also locked onto him. Terrifying age and vicissitude flashed between their gazes as Ancestor Renee...watched him with a chilling light.
As if she knew what Noah was about to say exactly.
As if all of this time, she was waiting for it!
[Within your very ranks, you gleefully house Vacuous Malignancies. How can I trust such a Senatus?]
BOOOM!
He said these words while staring straight at Ancestor Renee.

Her shrouded figure had released its authority as she was visible to all, her deadly curves expressed as if to show Noah the Entity he was exposing. She was pristinely beautiful, and right now...her eyes held tremendous coldness and apathy as her reaction said that she knew Noah would expose her all along!
In the surroundings, the thrones of the other Senatus Members creaked and bustled as finally, a clamor began.
On the highest and biggest throne, the visage of the Rhetorician of the Senatus was also filled with utmost apathy as a dense golden light erupted from him right away!
But the moment he did so, a blaring obsidian light unfurled from the small body of Ancestor Renee as extremely dense and pure Vacuous Hyperversal Authority was released.

And whatever was triggered seemed to be in utmost abundance as its explosive points originated from over half of the 81 thrones in this domain- the one possessing Ancestor Renee having been very prepared at this moment.
After all, she had silently begun releasing her authority the moment Noah first gazed at her when he first arrived here!

Her eyes and body split apart as a pure Aurora of an Entity that had undergone their Fourth Vacuous Awakenings, eyes as dark as the Abyss blinking coldly as a serene feminine voice of an entity that was most definitely not Ancestor Renee emanated out while these eyes came to lock with Noah's.
[We will come for you. And we will come hard...this, I promise you.]
WAA!
The voice was magnetic.
It even repeated words that Noah had said to the Senatus of Extremity!
In response, Noah smiled at this Entity and nodded as his figure on the illusory throne had already begun to disperse before whatever chaos was about to unfold fully descended.
[Give it your best shot, and do it soon...otherwise, none of you will be able to even gaze upon a sliver of my Records.]
The time he attained Extremity- many, many Entities would come to find that point and time to be a reality of tremendous change that would be utterly irreversible.
If they wanted to have any chances at Noah, they would have to do it before this as after it? The difficulty was something they couldn't fully fathom at this moment in time!
BOOOM!

Space distorted and deformed as from the possessed body of Ancestor Renee, a trace of an aura at the Fifth Gradation of Extremity erupted out along with a sea of gorgeous Crimson Hyperversal Havenly Extremity Rune Scriptures.
It threatened to devour everything and everyone here as before it could even come close to Noah...
WAP!
His illusory figure and throne had entirely disappeared from the Chambers of the Senatus of Extremity.
He came, argued, and expressed his authority as after poking a sleeper operative implanted into the Senatus of Extremity, he left amidst a great unfolding chaos!
As for what would happen here? He would come to know soon enough!
In the Supernal Havens of Extremity.
At the depths of the Obsidian Havenly Saurischian Archipelago.
In an underground area, vibrant crystalline earth pulsing with tendrils of pure Dissolution lined up a descending stairway that was leading up to a massive spinning circle of light.
9 Tier 3 Hyperversal Extremities floated beside the massive spinning circle of light as it was made of dense and intricate runic markings that intertwined to form a heart shaking power!

[Set up by the Primogenitor of Formations, this Havenly Spatial Formation is one of the many set up across prominent Obsidian Havenly Archipelagos as once activated, it can take you great distances. Some local within this very Haven, others vast to a connected network of the Havenly Spatial Formation in other Supernal Havens. This...will take you to the base where you can enter the Hyperversal Havenly Gauntlet of Gradation within the Supernal Haven of Helios.]
The Havenly Master of the Saurischian Archipelago, the Havenly Titanosaurus, spoke towards Noah's clone that nodded with a smile.
As they walked down, Noah casually voiced out towards this Tier 4 Vitalis Extremity.
"Say, if I had an opportunity to set a trap to hunt Vacuous Malignancies at the Fifth Gradation of Extremity, which Ancestors can you connect me with to talk to?"
A question that caused the Havenly Master to stop in his tracks and gaze at Noah with astounding incredulity came out!

chapters.title: Chapter 2754 The Demon of the Seven Havens! III
paragraphs: 2754 The Demon of the Seven Havens! III
The Havenly Master of the Obsidian Saurischian Havenly Archipelago stared at Noah with a dumbfounded expression as his steps came to a halt.

The crystalline earth in the underground area they were in lightly pulsed with Dissolution as ahead of them, the circular and intricately designed Havenly Spatial Formation radiated illusory light that warped space and created a unique reality around it.
[You...what do you mean hunt Entities at the Fifth Gradation of Extremity?]
His words weren't dismissed right away by the Havenly Master as Noah smiled while nodding.
"Just that. I have information on where three Tier 5 Vacuous Hyperversal Extremities will appear in the future to come, and I wanted to try making them stay...in a permanent sense."
BOOM!
He wanted to make Vacuous Entities at the Fifth Gradation of Extremity to stay permanently!
Such daring words came from him as the Havenly Master saw he was entirely serious.

The fact that it was impossible for him to know this information or even have knowledge of experts at the Fifth Gradation of Extremity crossed through the mind of the Havenly Master as his eyes flickered with brilliance.
These were Entities that were extremely advanced in the Gradations of Extremity.
A single one of them making a move could alter the very makeup of the Seven Havens.
The Havenly Master thought of this and more as his eyes locked onto Noah seriously for the seconds that came.
He stared back calmly as after some time, the Havenly Master spoke seriously.

[I won't make it difficult for you, nor will I ask too many questions right now as if what you say is true, just discussing specifics of it will alert an Entity at the Fifth Gradation of Extremity. Hell, even thinking or concocting plans against such beings could have the Souls alert them. So...I will pass word to an Esteemed Havenly Emperor where you are going. They preside over the domain of the Nine Helios Extinction Mausoleum where the Hyperversal Havenly Gauntlet of Gradation. By the time you are propelled across space through the Havenly Spatial Formation, he would have received my word as you can go from there.]
The Havenly Master spoke as such.

And Noah nodded while looking at the buzzing formation in the distance, his mind filled with schemes and possibilities as at this moment, he was looking at whether it would be possible for multiple factors to come together and create a chance for him to finally break the wall of Extremity in terms of his concept at the time when Three Tier 5 Entities tried to erase his records.
He was calculating whether it would be possible to attain Extremity from the ambush and possible fall of Tier 5 Entities!
If everything fell into place at the same time.
When this thought came, he smiled.
Nothing ever coincidentally fell into place. For the truly powerful, they would make everything fall into place!

His mind was quickly made up as a possible golden path bloomed, and at the end of this path...he saw himself using this Nexus Event of Death and Rebirth to rise from the ashes and grasp his first Hyperversal Havenly Extremity Rune Scripture!
With such a thought in mind, he continued towards the Havenly Spatial Formation that would take him to the Supernal Haven of Helios.
To the Nine Helios Extinction Mausoleum!
Devastating battles were breaking out across all the Seven Nether Havens.

Vacuous Malignancies made their way in as constructs of the Hyperversal Savior's Arks spread out tendrils of Vacuous Hyperversal Authority into these Havens, Legions of Vacuous Malignancies crossed Extremity Bridges and spreading out mad destruction.
In such a reality, Legions of the Four Hyperversal Havenly Extremity Lineages of the Supernal Havens of Extremity began to make their appearance!
Celestia! Animalia! Plantae! Riboviria!
Members of these Lineages appeared in some capacity to reinforce the forces of the Nether Havens of Extremity as their battles were bound to establish their power and show pristine glory.

In the midst of all of this, no sides knew that the True Emperor of Quintessence had taken control to influence one side of the Extremity Bridge within Dissolution that was allowing Legions of Vacuous Malignancies to cross.
No side knew his Will was trying to use the Anchor that was Svetlana to gain control of the Infernal Bridge of Anarchos.
No side knew his involvement in this part of the war...nor what he had done to spark off an even more disastrous conflict within the Seven Havens.
A conflict that took place within the very Chambers of the Senatus of Extremity!
Across the folds of time and space.
Within the isolated and movable domain of the Chambers of the Senatus of Extremity.

A catastrophic scene was observable as over 40 of the 81 Thrones of the Senatus Members lay broken and fractured, the Extremity Clones that used to reside on them not in their positions as across the stellar enclosed domains, the remnants of Extremity Clones still pushing with tendrils of Vacuous Hyperversal Authority could be seen!
It meant that deaths of Extremity Clones had occurred from the fallout as at the very center of this enclosed domain, there was the most astonishing scene.

The body of the Rhetorician of the Senatus floated grandly and with insurmountable majesty as tendrils of golden light of Extremity coursed over him, his stature looking over the body of Ancestor Renee below his feet that was split open vertically with the whole upper body fractured in multiple places.

Her chest revealed golden blood that pulsed with residues of Extremity, with the even more astonishing thing being the fact that her Blood and remnants of her whole being were rising up to form a heart shaking singularity above her!
The singularity was taking on the form of a multicolored fruit that released a sweet smell that tugged on the very Souls of Entities nearby.
It was the formation of a Hyperversal Gradation Fruit of Extremity that only appeared whenever an Entity extremely advanced in the Gradations of Extremity fell!

The Havenly Master of the Obsidian Saurischian Havenly Archipelago stared at Noah with a dumbfounded expression as his steps came to a halt.

The crystalline earth in the underground area they were in lightly pulsed with Dissolution as ahead of them, the circular and intricately designed Havenly Spatial Formation radiated illusory light that warped space and created a unique reality around it.
[You...what do you mean hunt Entities at the Fifth Gradation of Extremity?]
His words weren't dismissed right away by the Havenly Master as Noah smiled while nodding.
"Just that.
I have information on where three Tier 5 Vacuous Hyperversal Extremities will appear in the future to come, and I wanted to try making them stay...in a permanent sense."
BOOM!
He wanted to make Vacuous Entities at the Fifth Gradation of Extremity to stay permanently!
Such daring words came from him as the Havenly Master saw he was entirely serious.

The fact that it was impossible for him to know this information or even have knowledge of experts at the Fifth Gradation of Extremity crossed through the mind of the Havenly Master as his eyes flickered with brilliance.
These were Entities that were extremely advanced in the Gradations of Extremity.
A single one of them making a move could alter the very makeup of the Seven Havens.
The Havenly Master thought of this and more as his eyes locked onto Noah seriously for the seconds that came.
He stared back calmly as after some time, the Havenly Master spoke seriously.
[I won't make it difficult for you, nor will I ask too many questions right now as if what you say is true, just discussing specifics of it will alert an Entity at the Fifth Gradation of Extremity.
Hell, even thinking or concocting plans against such beings could have the Souls alert them.

They preside over the domain of the Nine Helios Extinction Mausoleum where the Hyperversal Havenly Gauntlet of Gradation.
By the time you are propelled across space through the Havenly Spatial Formation, he would have received my word as you can go from there.]
The Havenly Master spoke as such.

If everything fell into place at the same time.

Nothing ever coincidentally fell into place.

Devastating battles were breaking out across all the Seven Nether Havens.

Celestia!
Animalia!
Plantae!
Riboviria!
Members of these Lineages appeared in some capacity to reinforce the forces of the Nether Havens of Extremity as their battles were bound to establish their power and show pristine glory.

chapters.title: Chapter 2755 The Demon of the Seven Havens! IV
paragraphs: 2755 The Demon of the Seven Havens! IV
The fall of any Entity at the Zenith Tier 4 or at the stage of the Fifth Gradation of Extremity was a rare and insurmountably difficult reality to come across.

When Entities of such levels did fall, their advanced progress in the Gradations of Extremity allowed what remained of their Aspects of Existence to form Hyperversal Gradation Fruits of Extremity- holy Panaceas that others only knew of in Recorded History but rarely came across!

They were extremely rare to even form as they required an impossible reality to occur, and their usage...could at the very minimum birth a Crimson Hyperversal Havenly Extremity Rune Scripture on any Entity.
Whether they had achieved Extremity or not.

A single Hyperversal Gradation Fruit of Extremity passed down a portion of the Inheritance of an existence that was extremely advanced in the Gradations of Extremity as after taking it, any Entity could be elevated to the Third Gradation of Extremity.
If their souls were unique and their existence was powerful enough, they could achieve an even greater result!

Such a Fruit formed above the shattered body of Ancestor Renee as a portion of the soul that possessed her was destroyed along with her- a heavy casualty occurring on this day as Ancestor Renee was one of the few who had their Main Bodies here.

The Rhetorician of the Senatus gazed at this scene coldly as his will surged to gaze at ten Senatus Members floating around him, and the fractured bodies of other Senatus Members who were caught in the battle that had bloomed here.
His will gazed at all of this as his voice rang out coldly.

[It is time to cleanse the Seven Havens of anything to do with Vacuous Malignancies. All Entities in seats of power will bring themselves before me and have their Soul analyzed for any connections with Vacuous Malignancies. Anybody who disagrees...will be executed on the spot!]
WAA!
His figure radiated a profound light of power as he spoke words of undeniability!
The gazes of the Tier 4 Hyperversal Extremities around him changed at such a drastic response, but they couldn't refute it.
The golden hair on the Rhetorician of the Senatus waved with glory and majesty as he continued while gazing into the far distance.

[We are in a precarious time of war that may decide how the Vitalis Hyperversal Domains live for the eons to come. Drastic times require drastic measures as first, we will secure our own borders and forces. Evelyn...you first!]
The Rhetorician called out.
And from behind him, the Speaker whose visage emanated great beauty and grace stepped out and came to bow before him.

His massive hand reached out and grasped her whole head as a golden light flashed, the Records of a Tier 4 Hyperversal Extremity being glanced at as an instant later, the Rhetorician nodded lightly as the Speaker moved to the side.
[Melchior.]
One name after another started to be called.
Great change began as the leadership of the Senatus of Extremity began to ensure that among their ranks, only those they trusted would be among them!
And in the midst of all this...
[What about my Avernus Clan?]
The voice of Seer Amestris rang out as billowing purple flames raged around her.
Grasping the head of Melchior, the Rhetorician glanced at her without a word as he called out another name!
Seer Amestris saw this scene as her gaze changed greatly.

[There is a Primogenitor stemming from the Avernus Clan out there. He would not sit still knowing that the Senatus that the Primogenitors set up did not defend the Avernus Clan in their time of need. That the Senatus allowed a Demon with unconfirmed backing and power to destabilize one of the Seven Clans!]
Seer Amestris asked the Rhetorician directly.
And after a pause as another Tier 4 Entity was analyzed and cleared, the Rhetorician turned towards her and spoke coldly.
[Amestris.]
He didn't answer her question.
He only called out her name as this beautiful Tier 4 Entity gritted her teeth and warped right before the Rhetorician, feeling his hand land on her head as Records were scanned!
He looked down at her figure a moment after as he spoke coldly.

[The Senatus has already intervened on your behalf and did their duty. Seek to resolve this issue yourselves. Get on your knees and beg Noah Osmont or the Infernal Havenly Commerce he is connected to if you must. Your people began this conflict, your people will resolve it.]
The eyes of Seer Amestris opened with incredulity as the Rhetorician continued.

[The Annihilation that Osmont seeks of the Avernus Clan is not death and destruction of all its Extremities- he wants to destabilize and break the identity of your Clan itself as some of your Extremities are already leaving the clan to assimilate the Blood Sources that are the cause of your chaos. For the overall picture, the Vitalis Domains will fairly have the same numbers of Vitalis Hyperversal Extremities protecting it, even if Osmont targets and kills a few more Avernus Extremities, those that do leave your Clan by assimilating Blood Sources will be more powerful than their prior selves as they will fill any gaps made. This..is the verdict of the Senatus of Extremity. The fate of the identity of the Avernus Clan lies in your own hands.]
WAA!
The words shocked many of the Entities here as their minds moved at extremely high speeds.

Was the capability that Osmont had displayed of the Havenly Hyperversal Emperor Lineage so obscene that it altered the mind of the Rhetorician so much? Or was there something else at play? The Infernal Havenly Commerce?

Many questions buzzed in their minds as by the time the majestic hand of the Rhetorician left Seer Amestris' head, her eyes scowled with clear anger as she talked back right in the face of this Entity without fear.
[The decision of the Senatus is to leave one of the Seven Clans to fend for itself? What use is it for us to be a part of the Senatus? And you all...]
Her gaze turned to the other Senatus Members who represented the other Seven Clans and Major Inheritances.
[What is to prevent Osmont from declaring war on any of your Clans and Inheritances and denying access to the Blood Sources for you all as well? What will the Senatus do for you then?]
Her words were chilling as even before a second passed, Melchior of the Sima Clan sighed as he gazed up at the stellar chaos around them.
[The rest of us didn't start a War of Annihilation with him...]
Silence descended in the Chambers.
And a moment later...
[Dawn.]
The Rhetorician continued to call out the name of another Senatus Member as reality propelled itself forward.
The results of this meeting...were ones that nobody had expected going into it!
Time passed.
Seconds turned into minutes.
And with the mere passage of minutes, many changes and events took place as information was spread across the Seven Havens rapidly.

The new fronts of war in front of Extremity Bridges had their states determined, and what occurred in the pristine Chambers of the Senatus of Extremity became known by other members of the Seven Clans and prominent Inheritances.
From this event, the name of the Entity who was systematically destabilizing and destroying one of the Seven Clans spread.
Noah Osmont.

His identity was an enigma as the connections he held to the Supernal Havens were a mystery, and he held many distinctions as currently...the most pronounced one that was making its rounds was the one that the Speaker of the Senatus had called him!
A Demon of the Seven Havens.
Getting into a conflict with him meant facing Annihilation of your very Clan or Inheritance as even if the Senatus intervenes on your behalf, he would not stop his ways.
This was Osmont.
This rise of a new name and Entity that they had to be careful of, and yet from their intelligence and all the information they had recorded...this being had yet to even achieve Extremity!
As for the being in question himself...he remained in the Infinite Hyperversal Haven as he prepared.
Before his eyes at this very moment, prompts continued to cascade.
[Your distinction as a Villain is rising quintessentially!]
[A Quintessential Extremity Loot has begun to be forged at the core of your Origin.]
[Your distinction as a Hero is rising greatly!]
The Seventeenth Boundary Layers of the Villain and Hero activated.
Noah gazed at the prompts serenely while feeling singularities blooming at the top of his Aletheian Havens.
He then placed the Hyperversal Bow of Helios in his hand down as he gazed in front of him where a Sporos IV of Extremity floated serenely.
It was a Sporos that now needed maturity after drinking the nutrition of over half of the 100 Tier 2 Avernus Extremities and over a thousand Vacuous Malignancies.

chapters.title: Chapter 2756 Fallout! I
paragraphs: 2756 Fallout! I

The Loot that stemmed from killing so many Vacuous Hyperversal Extremities and Tier 2 Avernus Extremities was abundant, and even more so once processed by RUINATION who was currently taking herself to the stage of an Armament of Extremity.

The Sporos IV of Extremity that was insurmountably hard to mature in subsequent stages couldn't help but mature quickly while fed with such premium loot as it truly was the equivalent of what made the core existence of hundreds of Entities that had attained Extremity.
And when this Spore matured into an Ash Tree of Gradation, his Eighth Aletheian Haven would be complete, and his Extremity Soul would undergo further elevation.
[The time nears...]

He spoke while staring at the dazzling seed going towards maturity as his mind gave out another command, the Hyperversal Bow of Helios falling from his hand as a domain of crimson gold Pure Hyperversal Extremity Authority spread out from it.

He was about to undertake something of utter importance that would require a great deal of his attention and Will- something that should play a critical piece if he truly sought Extremity during the stage of Death and Rebirth!
His command was a simple one.
Tendrils of authority began to gather around him as...the Modified Golden Hyperversal Planalith Krystallos Refinement Art was activated!
When he used it to make a Low Grade Ruin Planalith Krystallos, Xiaomi had utilized it to propel herself to Extremity.
So when Noah activated this Refinement Art right now, his target was a single one.
[Quintessence.]
HUUM!
He wanted to forge a Quintessence Planalith Krystallos.

This was yet another achievement he wanted to add to his roster as this, paired with his 9 Aletheian Havens about to be completed, and surviving the point of Death and Rebirth against Entities at the Fifth Gradation of Extremity...he knew that such achievements and accumulation would be enough to fully propel Quintessence to Extremity!
The forging of all 9 Aletheian Havens alone was a Quintessential Achievement that would pave the way there, but Noah innately felt like there should be more. That he should do more.
He couldn't quite express why he felt like this, but a vast majority of his soul was telling him to collect as many achievements as he could before Quintessence was propelled to Extremity!
And so...a singularity was born before his eyes as his Meridians buzzed.
Vitalis and Vacuous Hyperversal Authorities seethed along with his Extremity Soul Values and Mana Values as radiant, gorgeous, and pristine multicolored waves of radiance began to gather.
They were none other than Quintessence.
[The Refinement of an Authority that has never before achieved Extremity is being attempted!]
[The success and failure of such a Refinement is unknown as there has never been a Recorded History of it.]
[If successful, you will earn the distinction of a Hyperversal Refinement Pioneer!]
A glorious Refinement began as Noah prepared.
At the same time, his eyes breezed over the dazzling details of the next Boundaries to be elevated towards the 17th Layer as their means were astonishing!
Within the Supernal Haven of Dissolution.
In an enclosed domain surrounded by Hyperversal Extremity Authority, the figures of the core members of the Avernus Clan were contained within.

Currently, the visage of Seer Amestris stood beside the illusory image of the Avernus Extremity Overlord with a grim expression- the reality that had occurred in the Chambers of the Senatus of Extremity being extremely clear to them right now as they seemed to be searching for the path forward!

Away from their figures in this enclosed domain, the scattered Tier 3 and Tier 2 Hyperversal Extremities who had their Records cleaved by Seer Amestris to save them from Noah's Virions could also be seen, along with the figure of a woman surrounded by tendrils of blue light.
A woman who rose up and came to float before Seer Amestris and the illusory figure of the Avernus Extremity Overlord with sheer incredulity and a sense of madness on her face.

[Haha...you went to grovel before the Senatus of Extremity and Osmont, and the result was the Avernus Clan becoming alienated from even the Senatus as Osmont gave you the middle finger in front of everyone's eyes. How fucking funny is that?]
Her eyes pulsed with cerulean Lunacy.
Madness leaked from every corner of her being as hearing her tone, the authority from Seer Amestris leaked out powerfully as her figure appeared before Extremity Blue, her palm striking out to slap!
And yet...
HUUM!
Another authority opposed her as Extremity Blue stopped the slap from reaching her gorgeous yet crazy face by grasping onto Seer Amestris' hand.
[You see...I've given my soul time to be refined and elevated as I've fully stepped on the Fourth Gradation of Extremity.]
Her visage pulsed with power as a myriad of Crimson Hyperversal Havenly Extremity Rune Scriptures swirled around her.
[I've walked less than you on the Gradations of Extremity, but we're at least on the same step now, O Great Seer of our Clan.]
With a glimmer, the outstretched hand of Seer Amestris buzzed and was released as she stared at Extremity Blue coldly.
And Extremity Blue wasn't done as a dazzling blue light of Lunacy fully began to brim around her existence.

[Our great Clan. The Avernus Clan was a name that demanded respect and reverence not all that long ago, where even when we destroyed an Inheritance and took an Armament of Extremity, nobody dared to even look at us. Yet look at us now...]
She pointed to the side where Tier 2 and 3 Extremities who were previously affected by the Pathogenic Authority of Osmont now lay with many of their Records cut out and their power in tatters.

[...our Extremities are demoralized, and even more of them are renouncing our Clan one by one for the sake of greater power. And all of this shit happened in a matter of days, can you fucking believe that? And the worst of it all, you choose to take it lying down!]

He couldn't quite express why he felt like this, but a vast majority of his soul was telling him to collect as many achievements as he could before Quintessence was propelled to Extremity!
And so...a singularity was born before his eyes as his Meridians buzzed.
Vitalis and Vacuous Hyperversal Authorities seethed along with his Extremity Soul Values and Mana Values as radiant, gorgeous, and pristine multicolored waves of radiance began to gather.
They were none other than Quintessence.
[The Refinement of an Authority that has never before achieved Extremity is being attempted!]
[The success and failure of such a Refinement is unknown as there has never been a Recorded History of it.]
[If successful, you will earn the distinction of a Hyperversal Refinement Pioneer!]
A glorious Refinement began as Noah prepared.
At the same time, his eyes breezed over the dazzling details of the next Boundaries to be elevated towards the 17th Layer as their means were astonishing!
Within the Supernal Haven of Dissolution.
In an enclosed domain surrounded by Hyperversal Extremity Authority, the figures of the core members of the Avernus Clan were contained within.

Currently, the visage of Seer Amestris stood beside the illusory image of the Avernus Extremity Overlord with a grim expression- the reality that had occurred in the Chambers of the Senatus of Extremity being extremely clear to them right now as they seemed to be searching for the path forward!

Away from their figures in this enclosed domain, the scattered Tier 3 and Tier 2 Hyperversal Extremities who had their Records cleaved by Seer Amestris to save them from Noah's Virions could also be seen, along with the figure of a woman surrounded by tendrils of blue light.
A woman who rose up and came to float before Seer Amestris and the illusory figure of the Avernus Extremity Overlord with sheer incredulity and a sense of madness on her face.

[Haha...you went to grovel before the Senatus of Extremity and Osmont, and the result was the Avernus Clan becoming alienated from even the Senatus as Osmont gave you the middle finger in front of everyone's eyes.
How fucking funny is that?]
Her eyes pulsed with cerulean Lunacy.
Madness leaked from every corner of her being as hearing her tone, the authority from Seer Amestris leaked out powerfully as her figure appeared before Extremity Blue, her palm striking out to slap!
And yet...
HUUM!
Another authority opposed her as Extremity Blue stopped the slap from reaching her gorgeous yet crazy face by grasping onto Seer Amestris' hand.
[You see...I've given my soul time to be refined and elevated as I've fully stepped on the Fourth Gradation of Extremity.]
Her visage pulsed with power as a myriad of Crimson Hyperversal Havenly Extremity Rune Scriptures swirled around her.
[I've walked less than you on the Gradations of Extremity, but we're at least on the same step now, O Great Seer of our Clan.]
With a glimmer, the outstretched hand of Seer Amestris buzzed and was released as she stared at Extremity Blue coldly.
And Extremity Blue wasn't done as a dazzling blue light of Lunacy fully began to brim around her existence.
[Our great Clan.
The Avernus Clan was a name that demanded respect and reverence not all that long ago, where even when we destroyed an Inheritance and took an Armament of Extremity, nobody dared to even look at us.
Yet look at us now...]
She pointed to the side where Tier 2 and 3 Extremities who were previously affected by the Pathogenic Authority of Osmont now lay with many of their Records cut out and their power in tatters.
[...our Extremities are demoralized, and even more of them are renouncing our Clan one by one for the sake of greater power.
And all of this shit happened in a matter of days, can you fucking believe that?
And the worst of it all, you choose to take it lying down!]

chapters.title: Chapter 2757 Fallout! II
paragraphs: 2757 Fallout! II
Her gaze moved from Seer Amestris and onto the illusory figure of the Avernus Extremity Overlord.
Her eyes crazed with Lunacy seemed to hold immense disappointment as she continued.

[You are not the same man I chose to follow all those years ago. You took the Inheritance of a great Primogenitor and built the Avernus Clan into what it is today...where is that great man? Since when did you become so passive? So meek? You delegate everything to the Great Seer Amestris as look at where we are now. You should have been there confronting Osmont in the Chambers of the Senatus of Extremity! You should have taken the lead to eradicate him days ago! You...are the biggest fucking disappointment.]
BOOM!
Stemming from Lunacy, utterly disastrous words were uttered as profound anger blared from Seer Amestris' eyes while the visage of the Avernus Extremity Overlord turned to stare at Lunacy coldly!

[And look at that, only fucking glaring at me. The old you would have erupted with authority and beaten me down...how the times have changed. The Avernus Clan that I knew and followed was not this. Bowing down before our enemy? Diplomacy? Fucking laughable. Good look to however you all choose to face Osmont as from now on...I will move on my own.]
WAA!
A dazzling blue light erupted and covered her glorious figure as space began to warp and twist around her.
[I will let Lunacy guide me...and I will either grasp Osmont's Records in my hands, or I will lie dead before his feet. But at least...I will go down fighting.]
A flash of blue.
A glimmer of light.
And Extremity Blue was gone from this domain, leaving the illusory figure of the Avernus Extremity Overlord and the enraged Seer Amestris.
The Seer who had purple flames burning around her as she stared at the Avernus Extremity Overlord and asked coldly.
[What now?]
The illusory figure of the Avernus Extremity Overlord flashed as his figure gazed towards a certain direction, seeing something no other being could see as his eyes pulsed with mystery and power!
Light years away from the obscured domain they were in, still in the Supernal Haven of Dissolution.
Atop a brilliant Golden floating landmass radiating a light of Dreams, a bustling market that had the Infernal Havenly Commerce at its very center could be seen.

The frenzy of trading for the Blood Sources was greater than ever as the more time passed, the more the capabilities and power of the Lineage it granted became known as there was always a profession of beings coming and going from multiple locations of the Infernal Havenly Commerce across the Supernal Haven of Dissolution!

In this branch of the Infernal Havenly Commerce, an aged Noah with white gold strands of hair and a straw hat continued to make the trades as he sat on a simple throne, a crystalline gold table in front of him holding rows and rows of Blood Sources shining in the radiance of dreams all around as he made yet another sale.
But right about when everything was going to proceed as per normal...
HUUM!
The eyes of all Entities on this dreamy floating landmass had to rise up.
Even Noah squinted his gaze as from the skies, the authority of a Tier 4 Hyperversal Extremity reigned down.
From a vessel that looked like a flattened Singularity, a procession of Extremities led by an Entity at the Fourth Gradation of Extremity floated out.
They were adorned in blue and purple robes that depicted endless galaxies and singularity as on their backs, an ecriture pulsing with power read [Overseers]!
Such Entities descended as the one leading them was a man looking to be in middle-aged, his body robust and built as he also held a fan in his hand that made him look like a scholar.

The throngs of Entities at the level of Apex Aeonic Lifeforms or Tier 1 and 2 Hyperversal Extremity made from a myriad of Inheritances or Clans made way for them as they came to stand before Noah's simple throne and crystalline table.

Noah's gaze was calm at the appearance of this Tier 4 Hyperversal Extremity and dozens of other Extremities behind him as he squinted his eyes, and the Entity at the forefront began to speak calmly while nodding his head towards Noah with recognition!

[The Singularity Overseers seek an audience with the Infernal Havenly Commerce to mediate with the True Emperor of Quintessence. We are prepared to pay a price to clear all misunderstandings and conflicts due to the matters of the past.]
A procession of the Singularity Overseers Aeonic Inheritance!

The man before everyone's astonished eyes was the Singularity Overseers Overlord- his Extremity Clone actually coming in person this time as he sought to wipe out the conflict he had with the True Emperor of Quintessence that rose from the War of Annihilation their forces participated in!
They had seen what occurred with the Avernus Clan.
The True Emperor of Quintessence hadn't pointed his blade towards them as before this occurred, they actually came forward themselves to rectify the conflict before it could greatly escalate.
In the form of an old man, Noah smiled with a wizened gaze as he replied.
[You had a conflict with the Little Emperor of our Infernal Havenly Commerce?]
WAA!
The words uttered by him caused the eyes of all watching Extremities to shine with brilliance.
This whole time, there were only strong speculations that Noah Osmont belonged in some way to the Infernal Havenly Commerce, but they never received a confirmation of his position or to what extent!

But these words confirmed everything as after they were uttered, the Singularity Overseers Overlord nodded while waving his hands, two Tier 3 Hyperversal Extremities behind him moving forward while pulling another Tier 3 Entity wrapped by chains swirling with Crimson Hyperversal Havenly Extremity Rune Scriptures, his face filled with maddening rage as he was actually dragged like a prisoner before everyone's eyes.
He!
It was the Hyperversal Extremity of Devouring who was actually in chains!

[The one responsible for participating and promoting our forces into the Apex War of Annihilation was this being here. The Tier 2 and 1 Hyperversal Extremities involved in the attack after the war have been executed. All the Apex Aeonic Lifeforms who participated in that war had their Origins shattered, and they will not recuperate for at least a hundred years. Their actions were spared somewhat since they were only following orders. With this, we hope to bury and leave behind any conflict between our two sides.]
Extremities executed! Apex Aeonic Lifeforms had their Origins shattered!

The moves of the Singularity Overseers were decisive as after all this, they brought forward Devouring who participated in the conflict for the sake of obtaining Xiaomi and her Innate Pellucid Foundation.
Noah stared at this being in his veiled identity as even after all of this, he asked dubiously with raised brows.
[That's it?]

Words that caused the Singularity Overseers Overlord to pause momentarily, his purple eyes glowing with the light of innumerable stars as they flashed before he waved his hands- his mere motion causing space to fluctuate two blinding lights bloomed to his left and right.
The lights astonished those in the surroundings and caused them to move back as the voice of the Singularity Overseers Overlord emanated out.
[To fully clear the whole conflict, we are also prepared to pay the tribute of two Low Grade Armaments of Extremity.]
