chapters.title: Chapter 2758 Fallout! III
paragraphs: 2758 Fallout! III
The Singularity Overseers Overlord looked like a refined scholar from ancient times as he pushed the two Low Grade Armaments of Extremity forward.

It was a move that astonished the watching gazes in the surroundings as in addition to executing all those involved and even putting up the renowned Extremity of Devouring in shackles that pulsed with vibrant Crimson Hyperversal Havenly Extremity Rune Scriptures which suppressed his very concepts and Extremity Soul, even Armaments of Extremity were offered!
Noah's eyes were sharp as he stared at the two blinding lights before him closely.

One was a full body armor that shone with a deep blue light, his eyes quickly pulling up its identity as it was termed [Singularity's Carapace], its hard exterior swirling with Pure Hyperversal Extremity Authority of Oceanus.
The other...was uniquely a weapon that Noah could only liken to a baseball bat, its name ridiculously being [Extremity Splitter]!
It shone with an obsidian hue as the bat seemed to be forged of an unknown crystalline material that pulsed with Pure Hyperversal Extremity Authority of Penumbra.

Two uniquely powerful Low Grade Armaments of Extremity presented themselves before his eyes as Noah beckoned towards them while nodding his head, streams of his Extremity Soul wrapping around the two weapons as they passed behind his simple throne and disappeared!

They began traversing across endless records to reach into the Infinite Hyperversal Haven as after this, Noah's gaze in the form of an old man smiled while speaking serenely towards the Singularity Overseers Overlord.
[Consider the debt between our Little Emperor and your Inheritance paid. Furthermore...]
SHAA!

With a wave of his hands, the space before them glimmered as hundreds of millions of Blood Sources began to appear, Noah hiding his devilish smile as they all went towards the Singularity Overseers before him.
[Since there is no more conflict, let us all enjoy the treasures lying before us.]
With a wave of his hands, the Blood Sources proliferated as a shocking event took place in this Archipelago of the Infernal Havenly Commerce!

Need would soon begin to spread on what had just occurred here as the identity of Noah Osmont and his connection with the Infernal Havenly Commerce was confirmed, as well as the fact that currently...this Commerce had collected Four Armaments of Extremity publicly.
Their power...was not to be underestimated!
In the Infinite Hyperversal Haven.

Noah was in the process of refining a Quintessence Planalith Krystallos as the very reality was twisting and distorting before his eyes, his own body radiating most of the Authority of Quintessence that went into this Planalith Krystallos as it took every ounce of his soul to ensure that it's Refinement remained stable!
But...he could still spread out his will and gaze up to see the space above him split as after crossing a myriad of Recorded Histories, two dazzling Armaments of Extremity descended.
They pulled with glorious power as Noah's Eyes of Extremity flashed with brilliance, their details unfolding before him!

[Singularity's Carapace]:: A Low Grade Armament of Extremity born in the constant cycles of sprouting Singularities coming in contact with the core of a budding Minor Haven with Oceanus. The core was ultimately forged into this Carapace after millions of cycles as its hardness is extremely difficult to penetrate. Among Low Grade Armaments of Extremity, an Armor always stands on top due to its Innate protective nature even before the activation of its more basic or advanced features. When adorned, this Armament can show its glorious exterior as is, or it can be transformed to look like anything you wish. It covers your body and Records while protecting you innately with 81 Defense Extremity Rune Scriptures of Oceanus, and after actively feeding 1,000 Extremity Soul Values and 1,000,000 Extremity Mana Values into it, an Aura of Oceanus is adorned around you that layers another 81 Defense Extremity Rune Scriptures of Oceanus. Its more advanced features include [Bastion of Oceanus], [Impenetrable], and [Sacrifice]...

[Extremity Splitter]:: A Low Grade Armament of Extremity that was formed by the Extremity of Steel after he was inebriated by the Extremity Wine made from 9 Hyperversal Gradation Fruits of Extremity. A chaotic and explosive form of the Hyperversal Extremity Authority of Penumbra lies at its very core as an existence with Obsidian Hyperversal Havenly Extremity Rune Scriptures is most ideal in the usage of this weapon as an Extremity. Its base attack only activates fully when aimed at the heads of one's enemies, utilizing 1,000 Extremity Soul Values and 1,000,000 Extremity Mana Values to release a concentrated burst of force into a single target that has an output of 81 Chaotic Attack Extremity Rune Scriptures of Penumbra, each one being equivalent to three Obsidian Hyperversal Havenly Extremity Rune Scriptures. Advanced usage of this Armament of Extremity includes features that greatly increase the focused single target damage output at the cost of much greater reserves of Extremity Soul Values, these features including [Smackdown], [Pulverizer], and [Reality Smasher]...
The details of the two weapons were unique in their own ways as the Extremity Splitter in particular...this bat seemed extremely devious!
Even more so was the blacksmith that had designed this weapon- the name of Extremity Steel rising up once again as this time, the stellar concept of Hyperversal Gradation Fruits of Extremity rose.

Such Fruits were rare information from Noah's memories, only being records of rumors from the memories of Entities he killed as they were things that other Extremities couldn't even fathom getting their hands on.
And yet Extremity Steel became inebriated from the wine made from 9 Hyperversal Gradation Fruits of Extremity and forged this Low Grade Armament of Extremity as a consequence!
Where was this being now? What about all the other disastrously strong Primogenitors mentioned across the eons of time and space?
Even with these questions buzzing, Noah couldn't stop looking at the [Extremity Splitter] and the many shocking ways it could be used.
This was especially so if it was paired up with Noah.
His enemies up to the Fourth Gradation of Extremity couldn't even perceive him unless he wanted them to.
If he appeared behind them while swinging this obsidian bat on their heads that would decimate them with an indeterminate number of Rune Scriptures...
ah!
Thinking of it alone made Noah look forward to it!

chapters.title: Chapter 2759 Fallout! IV
paragraphs: 2759 Fallout! IV

Reality had progressed in such a way that with the advent of the Infernal Havenly Commerce and the mere idea of trading his Blood Sources...had now brought Noah multiple Armaments of Extremity that the most powerful Clans sought.
The Sima Clan. The Havenly Moon Clan. The Avernus Clan. The Orientis Clan. The Ouroboros Clan. The Prometheus Clan. The Caecilli Clan.

Out of these Seven Clans that waded across the Seven Havens, Noah was systematically destroying one of them, and his fingers were reaching deep into the hearts of the other Clans through his Blood Sources.

Over the next few days, he expected more and more of them to join his Havenly Quintessential Hyperversal Emperor Lineage as at this very moment, he continued to receive pure streams of Vitalis Hyperversal Authority that would only propel his next Awakening to be ever closer!
The future Noah envisioned was a grand one as multiple pieces would come together to create an utterly beautiful whole.
He moved steadily, but not slowly as one achievement after another continued to unfold.
HUUM!
And this remained to be true as while two Low Grade Armaments of Extremity descended, a certain seed radiated a refulgence of light and began to bloom.
The Sporos IV of Extremity began to bloom into a grand Ash Tree IV of Gradation.
[The Quintessential Hyperversal Sporos IV of Extremity has sprouted into the Quintessential Hyperversal Ash Tree IV of Gradation!]
[A tremendous level of source essence went into manifesting such a construct as it is an achievement worthy of distinction.]
An eruption of authorities ensued.

And Noah remained steady as from the things occurring around him, even more streams of multicolored Quintessence flowed into the Planalith Krystallos in front of him- a massive illusory multicolored tree beginning to sprout across the Infinite Hyperversal Haven!
Noah's will gazed at this unfolding illusory tree calmly as after its authority was assimilated into him, he would fully finish forging his Eighth Aletheian Haven and start the Ninth and final one.
After that...there was only a single step that had to be taken!
HOONG!

Space was twisted and distorted all around his Reified Wealdian Source of Indefatigable- his clone that had stepped on the Havenly Spatial Formation that pulsed with intricate runic markings of Crimson Hyperversal Havenly Extremity Rune Scriptures of [FORMATIONS].

His body crossed great distances from the Supernal Haven of Dissolution as among the Entities from the Nether Havens, Noah became one of the first to move from the Supernal Haven of Dissolution and into another Supernal Haven.

The destination this time was the Supernal Haven of Helios as here, the Havenly Hyperversal Gauntlet of Gradation was located- a unique but dangerous treasure domain that was born under the warping of Vitalis Hyperversal Authority and the nearby spacetime continuum!

Entities and Treasures from Recorded Histories appeared within this Gauntlet as due to an unfathomable nature, it was filled with great peril as only the most profound geniuses in the Second or Third Gradation of Extremity entered this Gauntlet to seek opportunities to traverse even faster across the Gradations of Extremity.
It was basically a way to accelerate their growth to not be in the thousands of years- at the expense of possibly losing their lives and Records within the Gauntlet.
Never in history...had an Entity who had yet to even achieve Extremity enter.
But...there were always firsts for everything.
WAP!

With one final distortion of space, Noah's visage felt a blazing crimson gold radiance unfold as he found himself in the center of another Formation, the auras of multiple Tier 3 Hyperversal Extremities locking onto him right away as he gazed around the stellar scene before him.

The Formation he stood on seemed to be in the center of a burning sun as tendrils of molten heat of Helios circled all around, and an overabundance of stellar golden suns could be seen all around him in the far distance- and they were anchored in space as if they were domains to live in!

And they were truly just that as trillions of auras of Lifeforms could be felt all around them, with a single massive semicircular sun in the far distance acting like a golden floating Archipelago that pulsed with a crimson radiance.
A Crimson Havenly Archipelago in a heavily protected location within the Supernal Haven of Helios!
The Tier 3 Hyperversal Extremities around Noah had humanoid forms, but their skins were painted with a bronze golden hue as on their forehead, two white wings fluttered serenely on each side.
They were adorned in white robes wrapped around their muscular bodies, the style similar to what Noah had seen in Recorded History of the Greek Humanoids and the Chitons they used to wear.
9 of such Tier 3 Hyperversal Extremities locked onto Noah with scrutiny as before any communication could occur...
WAP!
Space fluctuated above them as a shockingly powerful aura descended.

Noah's eyes rose to observe an unrealistically beautiful and blessed figure of a woman with pristinely dark hair, her blessed visage adorned in a crimson gold robe-like chiton as her wide eyes held dual golden pupils that were radiating the light of genuine suns.
Her pupils...were genuine suns!
Her forehead held a pair of dazzling Golden wings that moved with utmost glory, her nose sharp as her lips radiated a crimson light.

A fiery heat swirled around her as the authority she gave off far exceeded Tier 3 or 4, her wide eyes becoming sharp as she motioned her hand into a fist while gazing at Noah, and both of their figures combusted into a flurry of golden flames as they disappeared!

The guarding Tier 3 Hyperversal Extremities of the Celestia lineage breathed out again as if their whole existence was being suppressed before, one of the mighty muscular men turning to the other and speaking out in a hushed tone.
[Who is that? Why did the Ancestor come out to receive him personally?]
A heavy question.
And it was one that they would not have the answer to for some time!
For Noah, space warped and twisted once more as by the time he blinked, he was in an entirely different location.

Around him, crimson gold waves of Pure Hyperversal Extremity Authority of Helios flowed in liquid form as if they were gorgeous rivers, the earth below him taking on the same form as he seemed to be surrounded by tendrils of Helios.
Directly in front of him, the dazzling entity adorned in a crimson gold chiton vibrated power at the Fifth Gradation of Extremity as she spoke with sharp eyes.
[The Little Dinosaur says you present an opportunity to hunt down Vacuous Malignancies at the Fifth Gradation of Extremity?]
She got straight to the point as at such words, Noah could only smile brilliantly!

The Orientis Clan.

chapters.title: Chapter 2760 Honorarium! I
paragraphs: 2760 Honorarium! I

A pair of golden wings fluttered on her forehead as her golden skin glowed with Vitalis Hyperversal Authority, this entity of the Celestia Extremity Lineage gazing at Noah closely as her fist unfurled at this moment.
And with a single opening of her fist...
SHAA!
An array of thousands of Crimson Hyperversal Havenly Extremity Rune Scriptures erupted out like fluttering birds as they formed a circular domain of crimson gold light around them.
Each Rune Scriptures read dominantly- [VEIL]!
[With this, nothing should leak out even into the Aeonic Annals of Extremity. Let's see...]

Her golden dual pupils shone as she stared closely at Noah, tendrils of Helios flowing around her crimson gold robe hiding her blessed visage as her unrealistically beautiful face showed a surprised expression.

[Noah Osmont...even finding your mere name while you're right before me took more effort and longer than when gazing at an Entity at the Fourth Gradation of Extremity. What veiling treasure do you obtain? Or is it innately a quality of yours?]

Noah's uniqueness was shown based on her words, as well as his scope of authority and weakness as Entities at the Fifth Gradation of Extremity could still attain Records of his name among other things!

He nodded lightly while his own eyes gazed at this being before him, the 17th Boundary Layer of the Protagonist putting in most of the work as he perused his current unfolding Recorded History to gaze at the identity of this being.
[Something like that...Extremity Solarium, is it?]
WAA!

The utterance of her identity caused her dual pupils to flash as she snapped her fingers, two thrones made of pulsing Hyperversal Extremity Authority of Helios forming behind each of them as she sat down naturally while crossing her legs, her expression thoughtful as she looked at Noah.
[The Little Dinosaur shouldn't have told you my identity, and he was sure that you were someone that hasn't even attained Extremity yet. And this...
seems to be true, and yet not at the same time.]
Her dual pupils were filled with thoughts as a moment later, they lit up with a trace of surprise as they looked at Noah closely once more!
[You...did you Scale the Unscalable Wall? Did you grasp Extremity in an Aspect of your existence before actually grasping Extremity of a concept?]

The intuition of Entities at the Fifth Gradation of Extremity was utterly deadly as the longer Noah spent in her presence, the more clues she was picking up about him as he waved his hands dismissively.
[It's nothing much. But we are here to discuss the possibility of ambushing and erasing the records of Entities at the Fifth Gradation of Extremity, yes?]
He diverted the topic from himself and towards the matter that should occupy even greater interest currently.
And the Esteemed Havenly Empress before him nodded as she motioned for Noah to sit on the throne made of Helios behind him.
[So? What exactly are the details?]
With an air of majesty, Noah sat down while beginning to speak slowly.

[Within the next day, three Tier 5 Vacuous Entities will appear within the Nether Haven of Helios for a brief few seconds. I know when and where they will appear as I was looking to see if there were any Tier 5 Vitalis Entities who would be up to ambush these Infernal Emperors.]

Noah spoke casually in a manner as if one was talking about the most inconsequential thing ever, but the gaze of Extremity Solarium only became extremely inquisitive at his words as she silently pondered before she replied.

[For the three of them to take the risk of appearing within the Vitalis Hyperversal Domains knowing they would be sensed quickly, they must plan to be here briefly before making their exit. Meaning they're here for something, or someone....is it you?]
Her dual pupils shone with a profound radiance as she seemed to arrive to conclusions naturally with the little information she held.
Noah naturally smiled at her question while shrugging his shoulders.
[Who knows. Maybe, maybe not. I just probed to see whether ambushing them was something feasible.]
Pure Hyperversal Extremity Authority of Helios flowed like beautiful rivers between them as Noah naturally discussed with an Entity at the Fifth Gradation of Extremity as if it were no big deal.
Instead of replying to him regarding his question, Extremity Solarium gazed at him calmly and intently for a few seconds before she instead asked a question.
[What do you know about Honorariums?]
Her question was a probing one as when Noah raised his brows, she continued.

[Achievements, Feats. Astonishing accomplishments etched across eons. Achieving Extremity in a ridiculously short period of time, jumping across Gradations to kill higher Entities. Forging Armaments of Extremity, Refining Planalith Krystallos...grand Honorariums that are recorded in the Aeonic Annals of Extremity as those with a great enough distinction even grant a material reward.]
Extremity Solarium waved her right hand as multiple illusory screens depicting some of the things she mentioned played out, Noah looking at them intently while nodding.
[I know a thing or two about Honorariums.]
He knew!
After all, he had been stacking them one after another in the past days as he made his way towards Extremity!
The dual pupils of Extremity Solarium pulsed at his words as she continued.

[You may grasp something about them, but not the extent of what they truly stand for. Think of Honorarium as a form of Dignity, Glory, or Eminence. It is not something that can be easily seen around someone, but it is critical to a being and who they are. Those with a high enough glory have a profound destiny as traversing the Gradations of Extremity is easier for them, opportunities present themselves with more ease, and dangers are reduced or alerted to them before they arrive. The greater the glory or dignity...the grander the levels of Honorariums one has stacked, the more distinguished they are. Destroying an Entity at the Fifth Gradation of Extremity is impossibly hard as a being like this has accumulated a great number of Honorariums, but such a thing...would also award a tremendous level of Honorarium!]

chapters.title: Chapter 2761 Honorarium! II
paragraphs: 2761 Honorarium! II
Honorarium!
It was a type of dignity that transformed one's existence in imperceptible ways as their achievements actually affected the flow of Reality around them.

As she spoke about this, the Esteemed Havenly Empress before Noah's eyes reclined on her crimson gold throne of Helios as the golden wings on her forehead fluttered, her eyes gazing up above serenely.

[There are Primogenitors who have accumulated so many Honorariums that the moment they make a move, the whole reality unfolds in such a way as if they were at the very center of everything, and everybody else was just playing a minor part in their Records.]

As he heard this, Noah raised his brows. It seemed that people with a great deal of achievements were actually trying to make themselves the centers of attention- possible main characters of the unfolding reality as those around them with lesser accomplishments would only serve as their extras!
It felt...like others were intruding on his playing field.

But he knew that before he appeared, in the eons of History that passed, there were of course Emperors and Entities who defined their Eras. Beings that shone brightly and held power to shift the very working reality of these Havens.
But now that he was here...
'You can all take a backseat...'
His thoughts alone raged with tyranny as he looked expectantly into the future!
Extremity Solarium then refocused her gaze onto Noah as she continued.

[I see no falsehood in your words, even with the fact that you knowing something like this raises a lot of questions. A major one is what my Extremity Clone has been figuring out by going into the Supernal Haven of Dissolution and glancing at the newly enacted Records there. The Underdwellers are abuzz about you. Noah Osmont...let me ask you about something that has yet to reach my attention, but would have been brought to me soon enough. This Infernal Havenly Commerce...what do you plan to do with it?]
WAA!
A probing question that Noah expected down the line has brought itself much earlier as finally, a key figure in the Supernal Havens of Extremity locked onto his Infernal Havenly Commerce!

The Blood Sources sold from his Infernal Havenly Commerce were already transforming the Underdwellers from the Nether Havens as of course, the Havenly Extremity Lineages had gathered information about this and kept an eye on the Archipelagos he set up within Dissolution.

[The Records of the buzzing Underdwellers seem to think you are merely connected to the Infernal Havenly Commerce, but from what I'm gathering, you should be at its very core. So, you can obtain knowledge of the movements of Vacuous Entities of the Fifth Gradation of Extremity in advance, with you being critical enough or having something that would force them to make a move, and you have a Vitalis Lineage contesting with even the Four Hyperversal Havenly Extremity Lineages of these Supernal Havens. Everything about you points to an Entity that should be supported by pillars of Honorariums...you would greatly benefit from following the path of your predecessors and others like you by joining factions of Primogenitors.]
Her dual pupils radiated waves of beauty and grace as she continued!

[Behind every one of the Four Hyperversal Havenly Extremity Lineages are Primogenitors. Even the prominent Lineages of the Nether Havens have their own Primogenitors among them. Join their cause and be under their light. Their Honorariums will mask yours. Enemies will not be able to easily discover your Records nor be able to plan to do whatever they're planning to do to you in the next day. Under the banner of honorariums and records of Primogenitors, you will have the time to cultivate your power until you rise to a sufficient level in the Gradations of Extremity where you can finally move alone, unhindered.]
Her words were like claps of thunder filled with simmering calmness as she proposed a pathway for Noah!
And yet the moment he heard it...he shook his head with a smile while denying such a path vehemently.
[I do not plan to bask under anyone's light. Such a thing would seek the budding Quintessence and Tyranny within me entirely!]
Tendrils of multi-colored light erupted around the crimson gold throne of Helios he sat on as he said such words.
And he continued.

[Even now, I move alone, unhindered. Many forces have tried to topple me before, and yet they were ground down to become ink that filled the pages of history. Their legends and honorariums faded into nothingness as in this unfolding eon, history will only repeat itself.]
Quintessence freely blazed around him as he spoke.
The Entity at the Fifth Gradation of Extremity gazed at him calmly, her dual pupils flashing with light as she ultimately sighed in the end and shook her head.

[Another crazy guy chasing dead paths. Even if you manage to overcome that wall, do you know how difficult a path you have ahead of you? Ah....no matter. If Infernal Emperors are entering the Vitalis Hyperversal Domains for something you possess or you yourself, then of course we shall partake in an opportunity to derail them. Of course, you won't be left empty handed as depending on the results, you can take 25% of the gains obtained from this opportunity.]
Her eyes flickered as she instantly got down to business.
25% of the gain.
Noah himself wouldn't be doing anything but provide the information, but he would attain 25% of the gains that may stem from this ambush!
He nodded lightly at such words as Extremity Solarium took his affirmation and continued.

[I will include two or three others to share in this opportunity right before it occurs- this leaves less of a chance of the Infernal Emperors being warned or alarmed of this ambush. Once something is Recorded and pondered about, it is easy for others to grasp it. But apart from this...you're supposed to be stepping into the Havenly Hyperversal Gauntlet of Gradation. I recommend you do this after you've grasped at least a single concept to Extremity and can freely utilize your own Hyperversal Havenly Extremity Rune Scriptures. Apart from your clone dying within the Gauntlet, there is even a threat of complete eradication of your Records if you aren't careful enough. You will only truly benefit if you have already embarked on the Gradations of Extremity.]
Her calm words were inviolable as she leaned forward from her crimson gold throne, her eyes sharp as she spoke once more.
[Now, just how many more details can you give me about this? When and exactly where? And if you somehow have a grasp of anything to do with their identities, this will go much smoother...]

[Behind every one of the Four Hyperversal Havenly Extremity Lineages are Primogenitors.
Even the prominent Lineages of the Nether Havens have their own Primogenitors among them.
Join their cause and be under their light.
Their Honorariums will mask yours.
Enemies will not be able to easily discover your Records nor be able to plan to do whatever they're planning to do to you in the next day.

Under the banner of honorariums and records of Primogenitors, you will have the time to cultivate your power until you rise to a sufficient level in the Gradations of Extremity where you can finally move alone, unhindered.]
Her words were like claps of thunder filled with simmering calmness as she proposed a pathway for Noah!
And yet the moment he heard it...he shook his head with a smile while denying such a path vehemently.
[I do not plan to bask under anyone's light.
Such a thing would seek the budding Quintessence and Tyranny within me entirely!]
Tendrils of multi-colored light erupted around the crimson gold throne of Helios he sat on as he said such words.
And he continued.
[Even now, I move alone, unhindered.
Many forces have tried to topple me before, and yet they were ground down to become ink that filled the pages of history.
Their legends and honorariums faded into nothingness as in this unfolding eon, history will only repeat itself.]
Quintessence freely blazed around him as he spoke.
The Entity at the Fifth Gradation of Extremity gazed at him calmly, her dual pupils flashing with light as she ultimately sighed in the end and shook her head.
[Another crazy guy chasing dead paths.
Even if you manage to overcome that wall, do you know how difficult a path you have ahead of you?
Ah....no matter.
If Infernal Emperors are entering the Vitalis Hyperversal Domains for something you possess or you yourself, then of course we shall partake in an opportunity to derail them.
Of course, you won't be left empty handed as depending on the results, you can take 25% of the gains obtained from this opportunity.]
Her eyes flickered as she instantly got down to business.
25% of the gain.
Noah himself wouldn't be doing anything but provide the information, but he would attain 25% of the gains that may stem from this ambush!
He nodded lightly at such words as Extremity Solarium took his affirmation and continued.
[I will include two or three others to share in this opportunity right before it occurs- this leaves less of a chance of the Infernal Emperors being warned or alarmed of this ambush.
Once something is Recorded and pondered about, it is easy for others to grasp it.
But apart from this...you're supposed to be stepping into the Havenly Hyperversal Gauntlet of Gradation.
I recommend you do this after you've grasped at least a single concept to Extremity and can freely utilize your own Hyperversal Havenly Extremity Rune Scriptures.
Apart from your clone dying within the Gauntlet, there is even a threat of complete eradication of your Records if you aren't careful enough.
You will only truly benefit if you have already embarked on the Gradations of Extremity.]
Her calm words were inviolable as she leaned forward from her crimson gold throne, her eyes sharp as she spoke once more.
[Now, just how many more details can you give me about this?
When and exactly where?
And if you somehow have a grasp of anything to do with their identities, this will go much smoother...]

chapters.title: Chapter 2762 Cultivation! I
paragraphs: 2762 Cultivation! I
Unfathomable.
As Solarium watched the man before her release few but intricate details, this was the only word she could think of!
But of course, she didn't allow this to show on her face.
She was supposed to be an Ancestor of stupendous power and might- someone at the Fifth Gradation of Extremity.
When she faced Entities of the Fourth Gradation or below, they couldn't even fully raise their heads towards her!
This was all due to her glory.
Her accomplishments.
Her Honorariums!

It was to the extent that the achievements she held were much grander than any of her peers, and this formless power that existences couldn't perceive or see...it made it hard for those who didn't even come close to her achievements to even talk to her.

When she spoke towards Tier 4 Hyperversal Extremities and below, most would be compelled to take her words as if they were commands- she didn't even have to utilize any of her Pure Hyperversal Extremity Authority.

Such a level of power bordered on natural hypnotism as if she said a simple command to a Tier 1 or 2 Hyperversal Extremity, they would find themselves moving to accomplish this command before their soul even understood what was happening!
That was how powerful she was.
And then, this entity came before her.
His body was robust as it pulsed with waves of multicolored light, his face carrying a devilish charm as he...had not even grasped Extremity of any concept.
When Solarium realized this, she reigned in her shock to keep her stature in check as this being treated it like it was nothing!
But even this wasn't the crucial point.
It was the fact that since the very beginning...he looked straight at her.
His eyes observed her body freely, from the crimson gold robe she wore to her dazzling dual sun pupils.
He then talked to her...casually.

As if he was talking to just any other being. And it was more than this as within his gaze and eyes, Solarium could pick up a hint of surety of confidence from him that when he faced her- he didn't have an ounce of fear!
He could freely interrupt her pace of the conversation and even steer it to whatever he wanted to talk about.
She had realized an utterly horrific fact at that point.
This Entity before her...his mere existence did not care for the Honorariums that she- an Esteemed Havenly Empress at the Fifth Gradation of Extremity, had gathered!
It meant that this being before her had such a high level of glory and dignity- that he had collected enough Honorariums even before he had achieved Extremity in a Concept as he had surpassed her.
Such a reality was surreal.
She suspected that a large part of it had to do with him likely scaling the Unscalable Wall.

She had heard Records of others reaching this Wall. But none had scaled it as far as she knew. They all attained Extremity in a concept soon after as their Souls naturally entered the Gradations of Extremity.
So when she theorized this about the Entity before her, she wanted to ask and understand!
And yet...he dismissed it as if it were nothing and diverted her to other topics entirely.
She was flabbergasted by such a being, but her standing did not allow her to show such emotions as when facing this entity, she at the very least kept her regality!
But she knew.
The Vacuous Malignancies targeting him had grasped something about him that even they, at the Fifth Gradation of Extremity, seemed dangerous.

It meant that this being had to be protected as he would grow to be a terrifying force of the Vitalis Hyperversal Domains. And yet when she offered for him to join the banner of a Primogenitor and be based by their glory...he denied it right away.
He held that much confidence.

Solarium continued to gaze at him with a calm demeanor as he talked while he was situated on a throne she conjured as if it were the most natural thing, but her thoughts were abuzz trying to dig up any more information about this being from the little records of him she grasped.

An even more drastic task for her was understanding the Infernal Havenly Commerce connected to this being fully...and just how distinct the Lineage it was spreading out way in comparison the the Lineage she held- or the other three Extremity Lineages!
In the background, her Extremity Clone moved with haste as it collected information...
[Glory...]

Noah's main body uttered out this word as the branches of a multicolored Ash Tree IV of Gradation drooped onto his body like endless rivers from all directions, his body buzzing with authority as his soul was being refined while his Eighth Aletheian Haven was going towards completion- the light of Elera painting it gloriously as everything within his Origin came to life.

His Reality Passages swirled with interminable might as they seemed to be getting empowered ever so slowly, and in the midst of all of this, Noah thought about his conversation with Extremity Solarium.
He thought of the Honorariums he had amassed already, as well as those that would come from the dead paths he was opening up in abundance!
The more he saw them, the more he affirmed they were paths no other beings could walk on.
And nothing expressed this more than the other prominent concepts expanded by the Protagonist towards Extremity.
His eyes flashed as he glimpsed the details of one such concept.

[The Seventeenth Boundary Layer of Plagiarism]:: Plagiarism comes in many forms, with the best plagiarists capable of taking someone else's work and passing it off entirely as their own- going even further to surpass the original. This Boundary Layer sees the countless concepts out there as it seeks to make them yours. At its current stage, you can plagiarize a Concept of Extremity that has reached the 17th Boundary Layer from a selected target visible to you, their concept that becoming etched into your Records as if it were yours to begin with, and that reality has always been this way. The target will have the selected concept entirely erased from their Records as truly, it was all yours to begin with- you never even plagiarized. When taken to Extremity, the Boundary of Plagiarism will allow you to plagiarize up to 81 Concepts of Extremity of targets with similar or lesser Soul Values, and the possibilities to plagiarize Items or even the very Records of Entities themselves become possible....
Yes.
The Boundaries expanded by the Protagonist continued to deliver the most shock!

chapters.title: Chapter 2763 Cultivation! II
paragraphs: 2763 Cultivation! II
When a boundary like Plagiarism existed, of course Noah's Honorariums were bound to descend in large numbers!
And this was just one of many.
He had yet to utilize MacGuffin as Hero and Villain were actively working along with the Protagonist, and then, there were more.

[[The Seventeenth Boundary Layer of Cultivation]:: What is cultivation? It is a process of development and improvement of nothing else other than oneself. Entities who have yet to awaken cultivate their body and money for less than a century before they die, and Entities who have grasped onto Mana and other forms of Authorities embark on a path to cultivate their Aspects of Existence before they perish. The major obstacles on the path of improvement and development of oneself are barriers and bottlenecks that one has to fight to overcome before one can enter a new stage of life. This Boundary Layer seeks to abolish the obstacles on the path of your cultivation as no matter what concept or authority you are cultivating, an absolute limitation does not exist does not exist for it. Once you reach a sufficient level in a concept or authority, it will naturally elevate to another level....]

[...An example is your Extremity Soul. You managed to overcome its absolute bottleneck and achieve the next level, and with the 17th Boundary Layer of Cultivation, you can now absorb any treasure capable of elevating the soul apart from the Ash Tree of Gradation to continue elevating the strength of your Soul. Of course, the treasure has to be sufficient enough to refine your current soul. Your Extremity Soul has permeated across your other Aspects of Existence and taken them a step forward, but you haven't officially attained Extremity of your Body and Origin- with your Soul only assimilating into them and reinforcing them with a shred of Extremity. Their bottlenecks no longer exist as the demarcation and ideology that you can only attain Extremity in the Origin and Body after you take a Boundary to Extremity is abolished. This Boundary of Cultivation will also be applicable to your Items, Authorities, or even forms of Awakenings you are undergoing. Currently, it also allows you to enter a state of epiphany termed [Quintessential Unity of Existence] nine times for an indeterminate amount of time, with such a state allowing you to experience a profound state of resonance with Recorded and Unrecorded Histories that allows you to easily elevate lesser concepts to Extremity, establish Dynamis of Extremity with utmost ease, guarantee success in Farming, Forging and Refinements, or comprehend things you had no knowledge of before. In this state, the rate of progress of your Cultivation is also elevated to a Quintessential level across all fields. If it ever achieves Extremity, this Boundary will allow you to abolish any limitations of cultivation imposed on yourself, concepts, Dynamis, and many more things as the possibilities are endless...]
Yes.
Another tool expanded by the Protagonist.
And it was truly a heavy one.
Noah had begun refining the Quintessence Planalith Krystallos with confidence due to this Boundary Layer, and the other possibilities that came with it were utterly disastrous!
His eyes flickered as he gazed at the massive illusory tree that seemed to be anchored into the Infinite Hyperversal Haven as he thought about the Boundary of Cultivation.
He felt the millions of illusory branches descending unto him and elevating his Origin and Soul as he had grasped the current rate of progression.
Now...it was time to put this Boundary to use and see just how profound its effects would be compared to what he was currently experiencing.
So while pondering on glory, boundaries, and refining...Noah's body which was surrounded by tendrils of multicolored light spoke lightly.
[Quintessential Unity of Existence].
Everything turned still.
The barely forming Quintessence Planalith Krystallos halted its spinning.

Noah's floating figure came into focus as his fair skin glinted off a terrifying radiance, the very bounds of existence twisting at this moment as if one looked from a distance, they would observe that the Reality above Noah...had almost bent and curved like an inverted mountain as its peak formed right above his head and connected with him.

And the reality below his feet-space, the Aletheian Havens, and even his Vassals gazing on from below...everything felt distorted and curved on the spacetime continuum as another 'curved' mountain of reality pointed and connected to his feet!

And a similar scene played out to his left and right as it seemed like all of reality curved into focal points around him, his figure becoming the center of the Infinite Aletheian Haven and even the surrounding Records of the Aeonic Annals of Extremity as he entered a profound state of epiphany.
He entered [Quintessential Unity of Existence]!
DUM! DUM!
A symphony of celestial drums began to beat as when he opened his eyes, everything resumed.
But...the still Quintessence Planalith Krystallos now began spinning at a rate far faster than even the fastest emerging Singularity.
And the millions of branches of the Ash Tree IV of Gradation...remained the same, but the authority they were supplying Noah ridiculously increased by a factor of 10.
BOOM!
An explosion of utter might and majesty bloomed with his figure at the center as an influx of essence and authority of unimaginable levels thundered into him.
[A Quintessential Burst of Authority is flowing into you and overloading your Origin and Soul!]
A heavy prompt came as his soul buzzed, his Eighth Aletheian Haven rapidly becoming filled with Cosmos and light years of Elera as a moment after, his body buzzed with a roar!
[Your foundation cries out with hunger as the overloading authority is shared by your Body!]
[Your Origin has achieved stupendous accomplishment as on the Ninth Aletheian Haven, it will arrive before an Unscalable Wall.]
[Your Body has achieved stupendous accomplishment as with sufficient authority, your Foundation will arrive before an Unscalable Wall.]
[Due to the Boundary of Cultivation, the Unscalable Walls of the Origin and Body will be perforated as if they did not exist.]
A shocking emergence of prompts.
Prompts that told of the glory of a Boundary exclusive only to Noah- of a Dead Path that was only granting him the level of power it held because he took it to Quintessential Zenith!
It wasn't a Planar, Innate, or Consummate Boundary- but a Dead Path elevated to a level exclusive to him across eons of History.
Quintessential Zenith!

chapters.title: Chapter 2764 Cultivation! III
paragraphs: 2764 Cultivation! III
A factor of 10.
This was what the Quintessential Zenith Boundary of Cultivation elevated the amount of Authority he was absorbing from the Ash Tree IV of Gradation.

This single sprouting was supposed to be enough for Noah to finish forging his Eighth Aletheian Haven and even start his Ninth, and he would need to cultivate the Sporos V of Extremity and sprout it to become an Ash Tree V of Gradation in order to complete his Ninth Aletheian Haven.

Cultivating such a seed was bound to be the hardest one ever, but the increase of the authority he absorbed by a factor of 10 put into question whether the path of using the next level Sporos would even be required!
His intuition already told him that even though he would embark on his Ninth Aletheian Haven with the current Ash Tree of Gradation, it would not be enough to complete it.
The only question that remained...was just how close could he get towards the Ninth Aletheian Haven's completion?
HUUM!
Like a celestial Entity gracing reality from ancient times, he moved to actualize the theoretical possibility as he maintained his [Quintessential Unity of Existence].
It didn't state a specific timer that he could be on this stage as it may end in a second, a minute, a day, or maybe a year.
It stated it so in its description.
He could enter this state a total of 9 times so far, and he would remain in it for an indeterminate amount of time.

He couldn't hope to remain in such a shocking state for even a day, as this would simply be too obscene for even this Boundary at its current level. But seconds, minutes, or hours were a very real possibility.
And so, he would use them fully!
BOOM!
The Quintessence Planalith Krystallos he was refining spun so fast that the reality around it was becoming distorted.
His three aspects of Existence all took in the authority of the Ash Tree of Gradation.

His Body and Origin seethed as while the Havens of his Origin went towards completion, his already robust Foundation of his Body that had already been bathed by his Extremity Soul seemed to almost be close to the Unscalable Wall.
After his Soul, his Body would likely be next in scaling what others could not scale.
And as if to ascertain his thoughts...
[Your already indomitable Foundation has taken a step forward as it nears the Unscalable Wall!]
A prompt came as he could feel his trillions upon trillions of cells drinking the factored authority of the Ash Tree of Gradation.
[Good...]
Feeling the immense power of the state of [Quintessential Unity of Existence] and how things were proceeding, Noah wanted to put to use its other features as he gazed down at the Vassals below him.
One of the boons of being in this state of epiphany was the fact that under it, he could even elevate lesser Boundaries to Extremity!
Now...what exactly did lesser refer to?
To affirm this, his eyes quickly scanned the entities below him for those who held multiple of what he considered lesser concepts.
And very quickly, multiple candidates were selected as without any bias, he simply tapped his finger and selected a Vassals who had expanded the highest number of lesser concepts of Extremity.
And a moment later...
WAP!
The space beside him- within the very eye of the storm caused by the Quintessential Unity of Existence- the visage of none other than the Daughter of Hatred appeared.

Among all the possible Vassals below, it just so happened that after she achieved Extremity in Hatred through Noah's Writ of Extremity, she continued taking multiple other concepts that defined her towards Extremity!
This was the only reason she was currently here.
By pure chance, Lilith was selected as she stared at Noah's majestic figure with shock!
When she gazed at him at this moment, it didn't seem like she was staring at an Existence.

She felt...as if an emotionless cluster of records was gazing at her and seeing everything as she couldn't even hold eye contact with him for a second, her eyes gazing down as his voice thundered out.
[As the Daughter of Hatred, you took it upon yourself to expand Deception, Hellion, Sanguinity, Lust, Chaos, and Twilight.]
His voice...it didn't seem like his normal voice.

When listening to it, one felt as if they were hearing the overlap of countless records coming together as the moment his words finished, Lilith realized that his hand had already landed on her forehead as he continued.
[What is Deception? At its core, it is falsehood and disinformation. To attain Extremity in it, one must even be capable of deceiving themselves...]
BOOM!
As he spoke, Lilith felt her soul surge as shockingly, her Boundary Layers of Deception instantly jumped and attained the 17th Layer.
The hand of the Entity who now grasped her forehead seemed to stir and churn it wildly as an influx of information about Deception surged in her mind!
What she didn't know...was that Noah's current state of epiphany allowed him to experience a state of resonance with Recorded and Unrecorded Histories.

At this moment, he focused on the concept of Deception as an influx of knowledge from written Records and unwritten Records flowed through him and into the mind of Lilith- Noah detaching himself from this process as his soul didn't expand this concept of Deception, and he simply took the concept of Deception within Lilith's soul towards Extremity!
His voice that vibrated with undeniable authority thundered in the mind of the Daughter of Hatred over and over again as after an influx of Records of Deception coursed through her...
BZZT!
A new Hyperversal Havenly Extremity Rune Scripture began to bud in her soul.
And before her eyes, prompts rose.
[You have been led towards the Extremity of Deception by a Great Entity experiencing a profound epiphany!]
[Through an influx of Records, you have forcefully comprehended the Extremity of Deception!]
In a short moment, Lilith watched with utter shock and horror as an Obsidian Hyperversal Havenly Extremity Rune Scripture of [DECEPTION] formed in her soul!

sentences.text: 2764 Cultivation!
III
A factor of 10.
This was what the Quintessential Zenith Boundary of Cultivation elevated the amount of Authority he was absorbing from the Ash Tree IV of Gradation.

This single sprouting was supposed to be enough for Noah to finish forging his Eighth Aletheian Haven and even start his Ninth, and he would need to cultivate the Sporos V of Extremity and sprout it to become an Ash Tree V of Gradation in order to complete his Ninth Aletheian Haven.

Cultivating such a seed was bound to be the hardest one ever, but the increase of the authority he absorbed by a factor of 10 put into question whether the path of using the next level Sporos would even be required!
His intuition already told him that even though he would embark on his Ninth Aletheian Haven with the current Ash Tree of Gradation, it would not be enough to complete it.
The only question that remained...was just how close could he get towards the Ninth Aletheian Haven's completion?
HUUM!
Like a celestial Entity gracing reality from ancient times, he moved to actualize the theoretical possibility as he maintained his [Quintessential Unity of Existence].
It didn't state a specific timer that he could be on this stage as it may end in a second, a minute, a day, or maybe a year.
It stated it so in its description.
He could enter this state a total of 9 times so far, and he would remain in it for an indeterminate amount of time.
He couldn't hope to remain in such a shocking state for even a day, as this would simply be too obscene for even this Boundary at its current level.
But seconds, minutes, or hours were a very real possibility.
And so, he would use them fully!
BOOM!
The Quintessence Planalith Krystallos he was refining spun so fast that the reality around it was becoming distorted.
His three aspects of Existence all took in the authority of the Ash Tree of Gradation.

His Body and Origin seethed as while the Havens of his Origin went towards completion, his already robust Foundation of his Body that had already been bathed by his Extremity Soul seemed to almost be close to the Unscalable Wall.
After his Soul, his Body would likely be next in scaling what others could not scale.
And as if to ascertain his thoughts...
[Your already indomitable Foundation has taken a step forward as it nears the Unscalable Wall!]
A prompt came as he could feel his trillions upon trillions of cells drinking the factored authority of the Ash Tree of Gradation.
[Good...]
Feeling the immense power of the state of [Quintessential Unity of Existence] and how things were proceeding, Noah wanted to put to use its other features as he gazed down at the Vassals below him.
One of the boons of being in this state of epiphany was the fact that under it, he could even elevate lesser Boundaries to Extremity!
Now...what exactly did lesser refer to?
To affirm this, his eyes quickly scanned the entities below him for those who held multiple of what he considered lesser concepts.
And very quickly, multiple candidates were selected as without any bias, he simply tapped his finger and selected a Vassals who had expanded the highest number of lesser concepts of Extremity.
And a moment later...
WAP!
The space beside him- within the very eye of the storm caused by the Quintessential Unity of Existence- the visage of none other than the Daughter of Hatred appeared.

Among all the possible Vassals below, it just so happened that after she achieved Extremity in Hatred through Noah's Writ of Extremity, she continued taking multiple other concepts that defined her towards Extremity!
This was the only reason she was currently here.
By pure chance, Lilith was selected as she stared at Noah's majestic figure with shock!
When she gazed at him at this moment, it didn't seem like she was staring at an Existence.

She felt...as if an emotionless cluster of records was gazing at her and seeing everything as she couldn't even hold eye contact with him for a second, her eyes gazing down as his voice thundered out.
[As the Daughter of Hatred, you took it upon yourself to expand Deception, Hellion, Sanguinity, Lust, Chaos, and Twilight.]
His voice...it didn't seem like his normal voice.

When listening to it, one felt as if they were hearing the overlap of countless records coming together as the moment his words finished, Lilith realized that his hand had already landed on her forehead as he continued.
[What is Deception?
At its core, it is falsehood and disinformation.
To attain Extremity in it, one must even be capable of deceiving themselves...]
BOOM!
As he spoke, Lilith felt her soul surge as shockingly, her Boundary Layers of Deception instantly jumped and attained the 17th Layer.
The hand of the Entity who now grasped her forehead seemed to stir and churn it wildly as an influx of information about Deception surged in her mind!
What she didn't know...was that Noah's current state of epiphany allowed him to experience a state of resonance with Recorded and Unrecorded Histories.

At this moment, he focused on the concept of Deception as an influx of knowledge from written Records and unwritten Records flowed through him and into the mind of Lilith- Noah detaching himself from this process as his soul didn't expand this concept of Deception, and he simply took the concept of Deception within Lilith's soul towards Extremity!
His voice that vibrated with undeniable authority thundered in the mind of the Daughter of Hatred over and over again as after an influx of Records of Deception coursed through her...
BZZT!
A new Hyperversal Havenly Extremity Rune Scripture began to bud in her soul.
And before her eyes, prompts rose.
[You have been led towards the Extremity of Deception by a Great Entity experiencing a profound epiphany!]
[Through an influx of Records, you have forcefully comprehended the Extremity of Deception!]
In a short moment, Lilith watched with utter shock and horror as an Obsidian Hyperversal Havenly Extremity Rune Scripture of [DECEPTION] formed in her soul!

chapters.title: Chapter 2765 Cultivation! IV
paragraphs: 2765 Cultivation! IV
It didn't end here as an instant later, the entity before her continued to speak.

[Hellion...What is a Hellion? It is an inciter. An agitator that disrupts the order of reality to flow to their own liking. To attain Extremity in it, one must be capable of inciting even Reality to their will...]

While being utterly frozen at this unfolding reality, Lilith once more felt her Boundary of Hellion smash into the 17th Layer right away, an influx of Records barreling into her brain as before even a second passed...
[You have been led towards the Extremity of Hellion by a Great Entity experiencing a profound epiphany!]
A surreal reality unfolded.

An Entity had not attained Extremity himself in his concepts that were of pristine ranking and Tier, and yet he guided the Soul of another being in front of him to achieve Extremity in two lesser concepts within the span of mere seconds!
What a profound achievement.
What a Quintessential glory!
This...was Cultivation.
This was the development and improvement that no other beings could even come close to.

Noah tested its limits firsthand as fantastically, he was able to take Planar Boundaries expanded by the Daughter of Hatred and elevate them towards Extremity- even transforming them to become Innate Boundaries simply because they were tinged by a trace of his Records.
[A Quintessential Achievement!]
[You have successfully guided another Entity in achieving the Extremity of a concept while distancing yourself from said concept.]
[A profound achievement that shows you could achieve Extremity of lesser concepts at will, and yet your aim is much higher as you choose not to.]
[You have gained an even deeper understanding of Quintessence!]
[The more profound acts of Quintessence you continue to perform, the easier it will be for you to take the step towards the Extremity of this concept.]
[You have gained the distinction of Vanguard of Extremity!]
[Your Honorariums are accumulating their glory for an even grander reward at your time of choosing.]
The scene was ecstatic.

With the very workings of reality warping around him in for directions and millions of illusory tendrils of branches sinking into him, he grasped the forehead of the Daughter of Hatred and took one concept within her to Extremity after another.
[What is Sanguinity?....]
[What is Lust?...]
One wasn't harder than the others.
To Noah, it felt like he was simply resonating with countless Records and sifting through them to access a database of information others could barely even imagine.

It allowed him within less than a minute to grasp the head of the Daughter of Hatred and take Deception, Hellion, Sanguinity, Lust, Chaos, and Twilight to form Obsidian Hyperversal Havenly Extremity Rune Scriptures within her soul!
Bustling waves of authority buzzed and exploded as he removed his hand thereafter, the dazed figure of the Daughter of Hatred opening her eyes to just gaze at Noah as...
She could only stare at his chest.
His eyes, his gaze...it felt too scorching to hold- too unfathomable to stare at!
And yet for him, he only tapped his finger in her direction once more.
And she disappeared, her visage warping and returning right where she was a minute ago as in her place, the glorious figure of the Emperor Penguin appeared.
[The First Spiritual Beast. You have expanded Vanity, Gold, and Ego towards Extremity.]
[What is Vanity?]
An utterly ridiculous reality unfolded thereafter as while grasping onto the head of the Emperor Penguin, one concept after another touched upon the stage of Extremity.
And after Vanity, Gold, and Ego were taken to Extremity within the Emperor Penguin's soul, his figure was warped away as in his place, Kazuhiko appeared!
And within less than a minute, Kazuhiko was warped away with three different Obsidian Hyperversal Havenly Extremity Rune Scriptures forming in his soul, Orion taking his place soon after.

Then Aurelia, Katelyn, Maximilian....Noah first ascertained what he could do with Entities that had Planar Boundaries, and when he saw how he transformed them into Innate Boundaries when taking them to Extremity, he then began to choose those who had Innate Boundaries!
All of them...were considered lesser in his eyes.
After all, his boundaries stood at the Quintessential Zenith!
His Boundaries allowed for the current ridiculous reality to unfold.
And as he took his distinction as a Vanguard of Extremity to a ridiculous level...
HUUM!

An aspect of his that was already near the peak of possible power at his current level radiated glory, his fair skin blazing with a white gold radiance that caused the very surrounding space to tremble!
[Your Foundation has reached an unsurpassable level below the stage of Extremity.]
[You have achieved a Quintessential Foundation across eons of Recorded History!]
[Your Body gazes at an Unscalable Wall that stands before.]
Boundless waves of authority sought to continue elevating his Body, but they couldn't cross a wall.
A wall that wasn't meant to be crossed until after one took a concept to Extremity!
But then, his body suffused with profound light as the radiance of the Quintessential Zenith Boundary of Cultivation blazed around it.
And...
[Your body disdainfully gazes at the Unscalable Wall as it begins to crumble!]
He didn't have to prepare any tools to knock this Wall down as he did with his soul.
His Body simply gazed at it with disdain as it began to crumble!
DUM!
And the moment it did so, heavy drums began to resound as he tacked on yet another profound achievement.
Another glorious Honorarium!

As waves of prompts exploded, his Nine Pupiled Eyes that were filled with boundless records gazed up to see the reality above him split apart, a rift that held behind it unfathomable mysteries blooming as from it- two massive Existential Extremity Rune Scriptures of VITALIS and VACUOUS descended.

[The Quintessential Achievement that is being recorded for the first time has allowed the Honorarium of Extremity Sanctification of the Body by Hyperversal Havenly and Infernal Existential Extremity Rune Scriptures.]
The so called Unscalable Wall fell apart as tendrils of profound authority began to rain down from the massive Existential Extremity Rune Scriptures that had begun to spin above him.
[Your body is undergoing a profound transformation and elevation of your Tier of Existence.]
[The Quintessential Zenith Boundary of Ascendancy has been triggered!]
Yes.
In the midst of Noah's transformation, there was yet another Boundary that was expanded by the Protagonist which came into play.
Ascendancy.
It was something that would make Noah's transformations that were already obscene...just slightly broken!

chapters.title: Chapter 2766 Just a little excessive! I
paragraphs: 2766 Just a little excessive! I
Ascendancy!
It was triggered at this moment as to understand what it was about to do, one had to know what its most powerful Boundary Layer granted.

[The Seventeenth Boundary Layer of Ascendancy]:: The process of Ascension is always an important one as the self experiences an elevation of existence to a new tier, or a slightly elevated form of the current self. This boundary layer is strictly meant to further elevate you whenever you undergo transformations that drastically change your value or Tier of existence. Any possible result of a transformation will be elevated and enhanced further by 100% of what it was bound to be. When attaining the Extremity of Ascendancy, the factor of elevation will accordingly increase in addition to other unknown boons.
One of the shortest Boundary Layers among those recently expanded by the Protagonist.
And yet it was one of the more straightforward ones as its use was singular!
100% elevation and enhancement of whatever form of transformation of existence Noah was undergoing.

His body was taking itself into the stage of Extremity as the Pure Hyperversal Extremity Authority of VITALIS and VACUOUS were the ones aiding him in this process since he didn't have Extremity Rune Scriptures of his own.
And now, this process was going to be enhanced even more!
DUM!
A booming drum exploded out as shockingly, it stemmed from his heart.

His golden blood churned and roiled like a celestial river coursing through countless vessels and Extremity Meridians as it devoured the authority pouring into it, his body becoming suffused with a magisterial glow as it cracked, splintered, and reformed all at once as he began to enlarge in size.
Yes.

Every part of him was enlarging and expanding to his very cells, the Boundary of Ascendancy combining with the ridiculous effects of the Boundary of Cultivation as the level of authority and transformation taking place was taken to an excessive level.
It was utterly excessive as within a second, Noah's body had already expanded to the size of a single light year.
And the elevation didn't stop, his body continuing to absorb obscene amounts of authority while being altered at a fundamental level!
This continued until...
[You have initiated the attainment of the Unrecorded Infernal Quintessential Hyperversal Extremity Superius Physiology!]
Unrecorded Infernal Quintessential Hyperversal Extremity Superius Physiology!

When the prompt of this mouthful set of words came, everything went utterly bonkers as his body that had grown to a single light year exploded with grandeur and rapidly went to 10 light years....100 light years....a thousand light years!
All in the span of milliseconds.

All while he was in a state of profound epiphany, refining a Quintessence Planalith Krystallos, refining his Extremity Soul, forging his Eighth Haven, and breaking past the Unscalable Wall of his Body.

The scene was an ecstatic one to see as the entire Infinite Hyperversal Haven trembled, his Vassals being transported to far away distances as Noah's body was enlarging in stature and size to the extent he was gradually coming to be the same scale as the myriad of Aletheian Havens forged within the Infinite Hyperversal Haven!
It was an unforgettable scene that was bound to be recorded in the eons of History, and it wasn't the only thing that Noah was going through at this moment.
His main body had activated the stage of Quintessential Unity of Existence, but it could be accessed by any of his bodies that had traces of his Soul and Will.
With its activation, it also brought about a great change in another place entirely- in the Nether Haven of Dissolution!
The Adjudicator of Dissolution opened her eyes as she affirmed her current reality.

Her very existence was connected to the Infernal Bridge of Anarchos and the Havenly Bridge of Dissolution as she truly became an Anchor for this Extremity Bridge- one of the purposes she was supposed to play as a tool being achieved at this moment.
She didn't want it.
She didn't seek it.
She wanted to leave it behind a long time ago, but people like her didn't have the luxury of a choice.

And now, she joined the hands of another devil to break away from the original one as her soul felt his Lineage and Will that flowed through her- his will that already covered the Havenly Bridge of Dissolution and was seeking its claws into the Infernal Bridge of Anarchos!
What plans did he have by doing this?
What conflict would she now be in the center of from this Entity that she now knew she sorely misunderstood?

She wanted to have her questions answered as she while her Main Body was recuperating in the Supernal Haven of Dissolution, her Extremity Clone that was taking on the role of the Anchor still felt the hands of Osmont's clone entrenched into her at the beginnings of the Extremity Bridge.

His Clone was right there as there were two Hyperversal Savior's Arks surrounding and protecting this area, with two Tier 4 Hyperversal Extremities releasing a cataclysmic Extremity Domain Expansion in this area while in the far distance, a battle was raging between them and Legions of the Havenly Plantae Extremity Lineage, with Legions of the Senatus of Extremity and Curagulus of Extremity also joining the fray in an assault that sought to reach and break the established Extremity Bridge.

And yet in the midst of all of this...the Adjudicator of Dissolution had no words at the reality that Noah's clone that was right there in the very center of the Legions of Vacuous Hyperversal Authorities- behind the tight encirclement of even two Tier 4 Hyperversal Extremities...he remained floating freely as if they couldn't even see he was there.
They sought to protect the Extremity Bridge, not knowing that there was already someone right next to it who was seeking to gain full control!
How was it that Osmont could float freely and escape the tremendously powerful wills and souls of Entities at the Fourth Gradation of Extremity?!

chapters.title: Chapter 2767 Just a little excessive! II
paragraphs: 2767 Just a little excessive! II

Such a ridiculous reality made Svetlana seek to know more and understand the devil she had allowed to pervade into her Records as even though she could feel her Extremity Soul being refined as she felt like she was approaching the Fourth Gradation of Extremity, what did it matter if she didn't even understand the entity who had altered and was currently altering her very records?

What if she had truly made an even grander mistake and enslaved herself to an entity even worse than her old Master? One who had the ability to make Tier 4 Entities not even know he existed right before them?!

She had to get a semblance of an answer as her main body in the Supernal Haven of Dissolution closed her eyes tightly and sank into her Records, her will manifesting into an illusory body that came in front of the manifested Will of the Entity she accepted the help of.
His manifestation was clothed in a simple gold robe with flowing dark hair, and she began to speak as soon as she saw his broad back and calm yet devilish face.
[Just what are y-]
BZZT!
Her words didn't finish.
Her whole soul trembled as her manifested Will within her backed off in astonishment as it felt a terrifying formless pressure erupt around Noah's manifested Will!
The Will...turned towards her as his gaze caused her to tremble- as if he could see absolutely everything she was made of.
His eyes...she tried to meet the gaze of his vibrant pupils as shockingly, her Will felt a sense of oppression as she could only gaze up to the tip of his nose.
She...could not meet his gaze.
'What the fuck?!'

She was a Zenith Tier 3 Hyperversal Extremity whose Hyperversal Extremity Authority was currently booming and being refined towards the Fourth Gradation of Extremity- all of this being a benefit from the Bloodline and Will of this Entity before her.

Dozens of Crimson Hyperversal Havenly Extremity Rune Scriptures of DISSOLUTION were being born in her Extremity Soul and elevating it even further as a being like her...couldn't even bring herself to gaze at the eyes of the manifested Will of Noah Osmont?!
It was a surreal reality as in her shock, she felt his inquisitive gaze go over her as his voice rang out.
His voice that felt like an overlap of countless records and ancient phenomena.

[The Soul Seed of a Zenith Tier 4 Hyperversal Extremity was entrenched in you even before you stepped on the Gradations of Extremity, containing the construct that was able to initiate the formation of the Extremity Bridge apparent in the Nether Haven of Dissolution currently.]
He spoke as if he was analyzing everything about her.
In the state of Quintessential Unity of Existence, many more things were laid bare before him!

[If I seek control of this Extremity Bridge, the most apt way of doing so will be through the Soul Seed containing the Source of this Construct that has the Will of the Tier 4 Vacuous Extremity erased. This seed should also be just a part of a whole as on the other side, there should be another Anchor with a similar signature Seed Within the Infernal Haven of Anarchos...]
WAA!

The moment she heard these words, Svetlana felt the space before her fluctuate as this Entity appeared in front of her, his right hand rising to grasp the forehead of her manifested Will as she felt the soul of this Entity begin to enter her Records once again with shocking speed!
His Will coursed through her and became centered on the Soul Seed that held the Source of the Construct of the Extremity Bridge displayed in the Nether Haven of Dissolution.
And his voice thundered out majestically.
[Since it is half of the puzzle, if its Records resonate with the other half...]
HUUM!
Svetlana felt her soul buzz.

In the Nether Haven of Dissolution, the gazes of the Tier 4 Hyperversal Extremities protecting the Anchor of the Extremity Bridge had their gazes change as they turned around and felt the bridge behind them vibrate briefly!
Thereafter, it retained its calm.
But within the soul of the Anchor, Svetlana saw a devilish smile form on the manifested Will of the Entity before her as he spoke drastic words.
[Got you.]
HUUM!
She felt her soul buzz once more as shockingly, she felt a connection be established from the Source of the Construct in her soul...to another Source in an entirely different Domain.
Across eons of space and time.
Across regions that rejected space and time.
With the Aeonic Annals of Extremity as the pathway, a shocking leap was taken!

His will which had barely been making headway on the side of the Infernal Bridge of Anarchos instantly surged forward and covered light years of this bridge as on the other side, there was another Anchor.

In the span of an instant, from the depths of the soul of this Anchor, the Will of the True Emperor of Quintessence bloomed from a Soul Seed holding the other half of the Construct of the Extremity Bridge!

Svetlana felt the faint connection to the other Anchor solidify as with wild abandon, the will and soul of the Entity before her flowed into her Soul Seed and used this connection to traverse unimaginable distances into another Soul Seed- the True Emperor of Quintessence making a bid to fully control both the Infernal and Havenly sides of the Extremity Bridge!
Svetlana experienced all of this as her astonishment paved way to a trace of fear.
She felt the ever present will of the Entity she had grabbed onto the hands of as she truly questioned whether she had made the right decision.
Just who- no, just what is this Entity known as Noah Osmont?
A simple question.
But it didn't have a simple answer.
On the other side.
At the end of the Infernal Bridge of Anarchos.
Within the depths of the Soul of the Anchor of the Infernal Bridge of Anarchos.
Obsidian waves of light were the only thing filling up this Soul as the Entity taking on this role was in a state of deep slumber, but all of sudden...
BOOM!
A critical point within his soul exploded forth with a shocking Will as the Source of the Construct of the Infernal Bridge began to leak out rivers of illusory golden blood!
This Blood coagulated to form a devilishly handsome figure shrouded in a golden robe as he gazed at the Soul he had made a breakthrough in.
The soul of another Zenith Tier 3 Entity- a Vacuous Malignancy who was the other opposite Anchor to the Adjudicator of Dissolution!

The manifested figure of Noah gazed at it with a smile as his right hand motioned forward, the golden rivers of his will containing his Havenly Quintessential Hyperversal Emperor Lineage gushing out with even more fervor as they contained vibrant Vacuous Hyperversal Authority.

They spread and pervaded into every space of this soul as at the center of it all, Noah gazed out into the darkness as his eyes shone with a chilling light, his voice light and being one that only he could hear.
[The Infernal Haven of Anarchos...]
The words of the True Emperor of Quintessence were filled with authority as at this moment, his reach began to extend towards a far, far domain!
