chapters.title: Chapter 2768 Superius! I
paragraphs: 2768 Superius! I

With the depths of the souls of the Anchor of the Infernal Bridge of Anarchos, brazen seas of golden blood gushed out and painted over everything as the Source of the Construct- the Soul Seed implanted in this Entity fell under Noah's control in the same manner as Svetlana!
From the Soul, Noah's will pathogenically spread across all other aspects of Existence of this Entity who was gradually roused from his state of slumber.
In a short period of time, parts of his soul coalesced as his figure manifested, his eyes fluttering and open to gaze at a world of gold all around him.

And in the surging seas of gold, the visage of a man with his hands clasped behind his back could be seen as when the manifested soul tried to gaze at him, it felt like his eyes couldn't even rise above the chest of this being.
[Marlac...your destiny has changed entirely on this day as for now, continue to slumber.]
HUUM!

With these words, the Zenith Tier 3 Hyperversal Extremity, Marlac...he felt his Records undergoing alteration as ever so slowly, a heavy veil fell over his eyes as he returned back into a deep state of slumber.
On the outside, the limbs of his form were outstretched as on his fractured chest, the structure of the Infernal Bridge of Anarchos began and only extended outwards.
At this moment, a will silently began to spread from his body as the situation of the other side was confirmed.

The surrounding area was filled with something white flames as at the very front of the bridge, a massive draconic Entity with flaming white scales and three serpentine heads floated with grand might at the Fourth Gradation of Extremity.
Around him, Legions of Vacuous Malignancies were being commanded and moving towards the Infernal Bridge as they entered the domain fields of Hyperversal Savior's Arks.
Noah gazed at all of this calmly as further behind them, waves of scattered Legions could be seen as their numbers were many!
Apart from the blazing white flames, particles of pure Vacuous Hyperversal Authority flowed serenely as they seemed to be in much greater abundance than in the Nether Havens of the Vitalis Domains.

And even further away, Noah saw the roots of a shockingly huge white tree stretching out for light years- its size alone being equivalent to a Minor Haven as when his gaze followed this tree, he saw 9 branches extending from it in different directions.
At the end of these 9 branches, the largest Planes of Existence he had ever seen shone with utmost grandeur- countless quintillions of entities having their life force shining brilliantly within!
This was the glimpse that Noah obtained when he first opened his eyes in the Infernal Haven of Anarchos.
Gazing at the Legions clustering towards the Infernal Bridge he had gained control of, his will flashed with brilliance as from it, small golden particles of unseen light began to be released.
They were further masked by the dazzling obsidian light of Vacuous Hyperversal Authority as slowly but surely, they began to spread across the Legions of Vacuous Entities all around him!
Within the Infinite Hyperversal Haven.

Noah's figure had ballooned to an indeterminate number of light years as he was far faster than a Cosmos or even a Plane of Existence, his sheer stature exceeding trillions upon trillions of light years as within his own Infinite Hyperversal Haven...he looked to be on the same scale as the Aletheian Havens constructed throughout.
Unfathomable.
Incomprehensible!
These were the only words that came to mind as even imagining such a thing wasn't easily done!
But the transformation occurred regardless.
His body was breaking past an Unscalable Wall as the result this time...was uniquely something that began with the moniker of Infernal.
His Lineage was the Havenly Quintessential Hyperversal Emperor Lineage.
His Soul was the Unrecorded Havenly Quintessential Hyperversal Extremity Soul.
Havenly.
It appeared over and over again for his most critical transformations.
It was all influenced heavily...by Vitalis.
After all, he was born in the Vitalis Domains as his lineage naturally took this path, and so did his soul.
Much of him was leaning and aligned with Vitalis as such a reality...the Existential Extremity Rune Scripture of VACUOUS took great offense!
It wasn't balanced.

And he...was no longer limited to Vitalis as he had now gained access to Vacuous Annals of Extremity and was proceeding smoothly with his Vacuous Awakenings. His Existence was now not limited only to Vitalis.

Since the last Unscalable Wall of the Soul that was torn down granted the Unrecorded Havenly Quintessential Hyperversal Extremity Soul, the Existential Extremity Rune Scripture of VACUOUS took the lead this time and gushed such potent Authority for the refinement of Noah's body as the result...was something that had the moniker of Infernal.
The Unrecorded Infernal Quintessential Hyperversal Extremity Superius Physiology!

In his state of Quintessential Unity of Existence, Noah gleaned some information when it came to Physiologies as unique ones could be attained when elevating to the stage of Extremities by special existences who had some form of a profound Extremity Foundation and unique accomplishments.
Something like undergoing Vitalis or Vacuous Awakening before Extremity. Something like forging a Dead Path to the stage of Extremity.
There were a myriad of possibilities, but Noah was attaining his unique physiology from multiple different avenues as his physique...was Unrecorded.
No other entity across Recorded History held it!
BOOM!
His size was an uncountable number of light years as it was as massive as the Dream Aletheian Haven, Avalon Aletheian Haven, and multiple other Aletheian Havens stacked on top of each other.
The Existential Extremity Rune Scriptures of VACUOUS and VITALIS expanded to be even larger than him above his stature as they showered down glorious tendrils of authority.
It was...utterly ridiculous.

And after he reached such a brazen height and devoured all of this authority, Noah felt the phenomenal strength coursing through him as a moment later, he began to reduce in size as he felt the abundant authority within his body be compressed.
Compressed and made even more terrifying as at this moment, droves of information about this shocking physiology flooded his mind!

chapters.title: Chapter 2769 Superius! II
paragraphs: 2769 Superius! II

[Unrecorded Infernal Quintessential Hyperversal Extremity Superius Physiology]:: Your body underwent a profound transformation and elevation of existence through none other than the Existential Extremity Rune Scriptures, such an action prompting the rise of an Unrecorded Extremity Physiology. Upon further elevation by your own qualities, concepts, and prior Foundation, this was the unintended result. At its current stage of refinement, it approaches the resiliency and hardness of a Zenith Low Grade Armament of Extremity, with your skin coursing with and capable of outwardly manifesting an [Innate Extremity Superius Aura] that is capable of withstanding the equivalent attack of 243 Crimson Hyperversal Havenly Extremity Rune Scriptures, or 999 Obsidian Hyperversal Havenly Extremity Rune Scriptures, or 8,991 Golden Hyperversal Havenly Extremity Rune Scriptures. Your current physiology contains such a compressed cluster of pure Authority within it that it now passively releases 9 [Infernal Superius Wheels of Extinction] that automatically and passively circle your body. These Infernal Superius Wheels of Extinction can be controlled at will to target enemies as each one can descend with superius might to deliver damage equivalent to 243 Crimson, or 999 Obsidian, or 8,991 Golden Hyperversal Havenly Extremity Rune Scriptures....
BOOM!
The description of his new physiology never finished.
His compressing body went from the size of a Haven to the size of a Cosmos, very quickly compressing even further as within moments, he was the size of a Universe.
But in this compression, 9 terrifying rings of crimson gold light bloomed around him.

They formed from interviewing runic lines that swirled with Quintessence, Infinity, Protagonist, Manadynamics, Loot, Cultivation...all of Noah's fantastical Concepts seemed to hold the backbone of these forming rings of light!
All of it was layered with a trace of Hyperversal Extremity Authority that didn't have a source linked to any specific concept- but purely connected to the strength of his body.

A myriad of Infinity symbols formed within the 9 Infernal Superius Wheels of Extinction, intricate lines forming across each of them as thereafter, tendrils of Pure Vacuous and Vitalis Hyperversal Authority permeated across the rings of light.
Vacuous Hyperversal Authority was ringing in with much more abundance like sentient snakes, it layered over everything and granted these ecstatic rings of light a devilish light.
In the midst of all of this, Noah's body continued to compress as very quickly, he became the size of a galaxy.
He then became the size of a world as a millisecond later, he attained the size of an average humanoid that had yet to even touch Mana!
And his compression continued as he then became the size of a grain of sand.
HUUM!
The 9 forming Infernal Superius Wheels of Extinction continued to swirl around him with immense glory as finally, his body compressed to become the size of an atom.
Imperceptible.
Immeasurably small!
And reality buzzed with grandeur.
A moment later...
WAP!
His body flashed as it grew to 4 meters.
About double the average size of an Entity taking on a Humanoid form as he seemed gloriously imposing, this form being returned by him as this...seemed to be the most stable.
BZZT!
His eyes opened to release rays of majesty as he gazed at the silently swirling Crimson gold Infernal Superius Wheels of Extinction.
They closely remained around his body as with a thought, they became transparent and imperceptible to the extent that others couldn't see them.
He then motioned with his hand as all 9 rings moved across space under his command, their size changing according to his will as they could become as small as atoms or as vast as a Cosmos!
They were terrifying tools Innate to his body.
They could explode with the power of 999 Obsidian Hyperversal Havenly Extremity Rune Scriptures each as what did this signify?

A Tier 2 Hyperversal Extremity held a few hundred Obsidian Hyperversal Havenly Extremity Rune Scriptures within their Existence as their upper tier was 333 before they could try breaking past the wall of the Third Gradation of Extremity.
At the absolute peak, a Tier 2 could have 333 Obsidian, or 2,997 Golden, or 81 Crimson Hyperversal Extremity Rune Scriptures!

At this moment, with the strength of his body alone that held the hardness of a Zenith Low Grade Armament of Extremity or a single one of his 9 Infernal Superius Wheels of Extinction, he could erase every single Rune Scripture a Tier 2 Entity held.
Then, you had Tier 3 Hyperversal Extremities.

A weak one could have hundreds of Obsidian Rune Scriptures, with those at the Zenith of Tier 3 having an upper tier of 12,321 Obsidian Hyperversal Havenly Extremity Rune Scriptures, 110,889 Golden, or 2,997 Crimson Extremity Rune Scriptures!
Of course, most Entities had a mixture of Golden, Obsidian, and Crimson Rune Scriptures as these numbers vary, but this was the absolute truth Noah had ascertained so far.
But even while gazing at these numbers...he had achieved a stupendous accomplishment so far.
Before even taking a concept to Extremity, the power of his body alone was equivalent to the power of an average Tier 3 Hyperversal Extremity.
And this wasn't his limit.
His body could get stronger.
Even at this very moment, he had only discerned half of the description of his new physiology as grand changes had occurred with his Meridians, Bloodline, and more!
Apart from this, his Origin and Soul could also get stronger!
When his Origin also crossed the Unscalable Wall similar to his Body and Soul...Noah foresaw that this was the time that he would be ready to undertake the perilous trial of life and death.
Of the Death and Rebirth where Entities at the Fifth Gradation of Extremity wanted to end everything about him.
At that time...Noah could see an Extremity of Quintessence.

After all, what was more Quintessential than an Entity who had yet to even step on the First Gradation of Extremity, but had scaled past the limits of all three of his Aspects of Existence...facing off and surviving the undeniable might of an Entity at the Fifth Gradation of Extremity?
What could possibly be more Quintessential?!
When this Unrecorded History would take place, Noah in no way believed he would be at the same level as an Entity at the Fifth Gradation of Extremity.
No. But to attain the shocking feat of Quintessence, he simply had to survive against the methods of such a powerful Entity.
And for this...he was prepared.
After this event ended though.
After he overcame death and had a rebirth into an Entity that had attained the Extremity of Quintessence...he truly had no idea where his power would be!
Too many things would happen.
Too many concepts would also attain Extremity.
That moment...was bound to be an irreversible nexus event that would decide all the Histories to unfold!

But in this compression, 9 terrifying rings of crimson gold light bloomed around him.

They formed from interviewing runic lines that swirled with Quintessence, Infinity, Protagonist, Manadynamics, Loot, Cultivation...all of Noah's fantastical Concepts seemed to hold the backbone of these forming rings of light!
All of it was layered with a trace of Hyperversal Extremity Authority that didn't have a source linked to any specific concept- but purely connected to the strength of his body.

A myriad of Infinity symbols formed within the 9 Infernal Superius Wheels of Extinction, intricate lines forming across each of them as thereafter, tendrils of Pure Vacuous and Vitalis Hyperversal Authority permeated across the rings of light.
Vacuous Hyperversal Authority was ringing in with much more abundance like sentient snakes, it layered over everything and granted these ecstatic rings of light a devilish light.
In the midst of all of this, Noah's body continued to compress as very quickly, he became the size of a galaxy.
He then became the size of a world as a millisecond later, he attained the size of an average humanoid that had yet to even touch Mana!
And his compression continued as he then became the size of a grain of sand.
HUUM!
The 9 forming Infernal Superius Wheels of Extinction continued to swirl around him with immense glory as finally, his body compressed to become the size of an atom.
Imperceptible.
Immeasurably small!
And reality buzzed with grandeur.
A moment later...
WAP!
His body flashed as it grew to 4 meters.
About double the average size of an Entity taking on a Humanoid form as he seemed gloriously imposing, this form being returned by him as this...seemed to be the most stable.
BZZT!
His eyes opened to release rays of majesty as he gazed at the silently swirling Crimson gold Infernal Superius Wheels of Extinction.
They closely remained around his body as with a thought, they became transparent and imperceptible to the extent that others couldn't see them.
He then motioned with his hand as all 9 rings moved across space under his command, their size changing according to his will as they could become as small as atoms or as vast as a Cosmos!
They were terrifying tools Innate to his body.
They could explode with the power of 999 Obsidian Hyperversal Havenly Extremity Rune Scriptures each as what did this signify?

A Tier 2 Hyperversal Extremity held a few hundred Obsidian Hyperversal Havenly Extremity Rune Scriptures within their Existence as their upper tier was 333 before they could try breaking past the wall of the Third Gradation of Extremity.
At the absolute peak, a Tier 2 could have 333 Obsidian, or 2,997 Golden, or 81 Crimson Hyperversal Extremity Rune Scriptures!

At this moment, with the strength of his body alone that held the hardness of a Zenith Low Grade Armament of Extremity or a single one of his 9 Infernal Superius Wheels of Extinction, he could erase every single Rune Scripture a Tier 2 Entity held.
Then, you had Tier 3 Hyperversal Extremities.

A weak one could have hundreds of Obsidian Rune Scriptures, with those at the Zenith of Tier 3 having an upper tier of 12,321 Obsidian Hyperversal Havenly Extremity Rune Scriptures, 110,889 Golden, or 2,997 Crimson Extremity Rune Scriptures!
Of course, most Entities had a mixture of Golden, Obsidian, and Crimson Rune Scriptures as these numbers vary, but this was the absolute truth Noah had ascertained so far.
But even while gazing at these numbers...he had achieved a stupendous accomplishment so far.
Before even taking a concept to Extremity, the power of his body alone was equivalent to the power of an average Tier 3 Hyperversal Extremity.
And this wasn't his limit.
His body could get stronger.
Even at this very moment, he had only discerned half of the description of his new physiology as grand changes had occurred with his Meridians, Bloodline, and more!
Apart from this, his Origin and Soul could also get stronger!
When his Origin also crossed the Unscalable Wall similar to his Body and Soul...Noah foresaw that this was the time that he would be ready to undertake the perilous trial of life and death.
Of the Death and Rebirth where Entities at the Fifth Gradation of Extremity wanted to end everything about him.
At that time...Noah could see an Extremity of Quintessence.

After all, what was more Quintessential than an Entity who had yet to even step on the First Gradation of Extremity, but had scaled past the limits of all three of his Aspects of Existence...facing off and surviving the undeniable might of an Entity at the Fifth Gradation of Extremity?
What could possibly be more Quintessential?!
When this Unrecorded History would take place, Noah in no way believed he would be at the same level as an Entity at the Fifth Gradation of Extremity.
No.
But to attain the shocking feat of Quintessence, he simply had to survive against the methods of such a powerful Entity.
And for this...he was prepared.
After this event ended though.
After he overcame death and had a rebirth into an Entity that had attained the Extremity of Quintessence...he truly had no idea where his power would be!
Too many things would happen.
Too many concepts would also attain Extremity.
That moment...was bound to be an irreversible nexus event that would decide all the Histories to unfold!

chapters.title: Chapter 2770 Superius! III
paragraphs: 2770 Superius! III
This was the general outline of the path he was trying to follow.
His Aspects of Existence attaining Extremity, and then taking the concept of Quintessence to Extremity right after!
HUUM!

Being 4 meters large, Noah's form seemed grand in stature compared to normal humanoid forms as the crimson gold Infernal Superius Wheels of Extinction visibly swirled around him again, his skin shining with an iridescent glow as it pulsed with power.

Before him, the Quintessence Planalith Krystallos continued to spin madly as this process allowed it to be 70% completed, and the branches of the Ash Tree of Gradation had less than 50% of their authority left for Noah to absorb.

His right hand raised at this moment as he felt his new found body- his Meridians that were expanded as if they were wide and endless rivers of reality, and the Innate power he held that was all settling down and being quantified.
He then clenched his fist as he uttered calmly.
[Innate Extremity Superius Aura]
THUMP!

His heart released a booming echo as the Havenly Organ beside it shuddered, a crimson gold aura rising from it and enveloping Noah's whole body as he seemed like a celestial entity covered by an utterly gorgeous and magnificent aura of crimson gold flames!
It blazed 1 meter around his body as with a motion of his will, it expanded outwards for miles gloriously before he retracted it to blaze around his body.
This was the Innate Extremity Superius Aura.
It could innately defend against 243 Crimson or 999 Obsidian Hyperversal Havenly Extremity Rune Scriptures!

In addition to the Infernal Superius Wheels of Extinction that were supposed to be used offensively, Noah could also turn them into defensive tools as his current state of power...was extremely unique.
He could truly match Tier 3 Hyperversal Extremities with the strength his body provided alone!
If he paired this with the False Hyperversal Havenly Extremity Rune Scriptures of DESPOILER among other tools under his grasp, he could truly begin butchering Tier 3 Entities.
The thought was a glorious one as all of this was brought about by scaling the wall of the Aspect of the Body.

And among its many effects, there were also unintended ones that Noah very much welcomed as he gazed up to see the massive Existential Extremity Rune Scriptures of VACUOUS and VITALIS retreating, but within his Body...his Innate Vacuous and Vitalis Meridians were now expanded and surging with such potent Vitalis and Vacuous Hyperversal Authorities that in no time...
[The concentration of Vitalis and Vacuous Hyperversal Authorities within your Aspects of Existence has reached a critical threshold.]
[Your Existence is embarking on the Third Vitalis and Vacuous Awakenings!]
When achievements came, they came in pairs.

In Noah's case, they came in quick succession as with his body at the very center, a contrasting wonder of black and white erupted to his left and right as it spread out for the diameter of a whole Cosmos.
He looked like he was at the very center of a black and white sun as the Vacuous and Vitalis Hyperversal Authority oscillated around him like endless suns.

At the core of it all, his body was magisterially surrounded by the crimson gold Innate Extremity Superius Aura and 9 Infernal Superius Wheels of Extinction as he truly seemed like an entity entirely out of some fantastical Unrecorded History!
And in the midst of all of this....
[The Eighth Aletheian Haven has been completed.]
[The Ninth Aletheian Haven has begun to be forged!]

His Origin radiated a profound multicolored brilliance as the tower-like structures of the 8 Aletheian Havens oscillated with each other, the final and 9th one beginning to be forged by the residual authority of the Ash Tree of Gradation that was being magnified by the Boundary of Cultivation.
[A Profound Achievement!]
[The Origin you are constructing has not yet been Recorded in History, with the final piece to complete it being extremely hard to accomplish before attaining Extremity!]
The final and last Haven.

Whenever Noah forged this Aletheian Haven to completion, his Quintessential Hyperversal Extremity Meridians would follow the will of his Origin to allow all Concepts with their Sources bound to him to be elevated to Extremity.
Completing it was a Quintessential Achievement.
This was why before the Ninth Aletheian Haven could be completed...
[Your Origin is nearing an Unscalable Wall!]

[At approximately 50% completion of the Ninth Aletheian Haven, your Origin will reach a level of profound saturation as to proceed further and complete its remaining 50%, the Unscalable Wall of the Aspect of the Origin has to be scaled.]
Yes.
This would have been the arduous and backbreaking task Noah had to overcome in order to complete his Aletheian Havens.
Their completion was locked behind scaling an Unscalable Wall!
Yet now...it was simply an inevitability due to the Quintessential Zenith Boundary of Cultivation.
The remnant authority of the Ash Tree of Gradation would do its best to get Noah as far as it could, but thereafter, he would need more Loot.
Thinking of this, Noah clenched his fist while calculating paths and looking at the many wars breaking out across different regions, as well as his enemies.

There was still loot remaining from the eradication of hundreds of Tier 1s and the batch of Avernus Extremities, and he could even use Hyperversal II Assimilation which would undoubtedly be upgraded to Hyperversal III Assimilation after his Third Awakenings to devour treasures directly in the case that cultivating the next Sporos of Extremity would be too arduous, and if he only needed a little more authority to complete the hardest Haven.
It all depended on how far he would get with the current Ash Tree IV of Gradation!
HUUM!
At this moment.
His body that was fully reaping the gains of the Unrecorded Infernal Quintessential Hyperversal Extremity Superius Physiology caused a critical change to his churning Blood.
To his Lineage that was gradually connected to more and more Extremities across the Vitalis Hyperversal Domains.
All of it culminated into a shocking amalgamation of authority that at this moment...
CRACK!
Caused his forehead to split open ever so slightly!

chapters.title: Chapter 2771 Superius! IV
paragraphs: 2771 Superius! IV
His forehead split as tendrils of golden blood flowed.
From the slit, a gorgeous crystalline multicolored nonagonal jewel rose as it pulsed with utterly pristine glory!

The moment it appeared, it pulsed with a hungry light of power as from all around, wisps of Vitalis Hyperversal Authority began to gather and speedily flow into it as if they were flowing in an endless abyss.
At the same time, prompts rose before Noah's eyes.
[The Unrecorded Havenly Quintessential Hyperversal Emperor Lineage has unlocked the Enneagonal Existential Jewel!]
[You have attained the Primogenitor Quintessential Enneagonal Existential Jewel!]
[The Vassals of the Havenly Quintessential Hyperversal Emperor Lineage have attained the Quintessential Enneagonal Existential Jewel.]

[The Enneagonal Existential Jewel is forged for the purpose of bringing Existences closer to Existential Authority. With the Quintessential Enneagonal Existential Jewel, Vassals of your Lineage will passively absorb Existential Authority based on the source of their Existence. If the Vassals of your Lineage have already attained Hyperversal Extremity Authority and stem from the Existential Authority of Vitalis, the newly formed Enneagonal Existential Jewel on their bodies will erupt with a one time Awakening Radiance that absorbs enough Pure Vitalis Hyperversal Authority to allow one to attain their First Vitalis Awakening. If the Vassals have yet to attain Hyperversal Extremity Authority, the Enneagonal Existential Jewel will passively absorb Existential Authority, with their rate of absorption depending on the level of bloodline purity as in an indeterminate period of time, they will also naturally attain their First Vitalis Awakening. The Quintessential Enneagonal Existential Jewel acts as a reservoir for Existential Authority connected to one's Meridians whenever they form, and the jewel allows for Vassals of the Havenly Quintessential Hyperversal Emperor Lineage to recognize each other's signatures and establish a Bloodline Link that will allow them to instantaneously communicate with each other, teleport to each other's positions within the same Existential Domains, and even share authority from one Entity to another. As the Havenly Quintessential Hyperversal Emperor Lineage grows, so will the capabilities of the Enneagonal Existential Jewel...]

A shocking new construct was being formed as after Noah obtained his Primogenitor Quintessential Enneagonal Existential Jewel, his Vassals within the Infinite Hyperversal Haven also had their foreheads split as Quintessential Enneagonal Existential Jewels rose as well!
But theirs shone with a dim white gold radiance as the brighter the golden radiance, the purer their lineage was.

Among all beings far, far below Noah who were relocated due to his drastic increase in size before he reduced, Henry was undoubtedly the one whose jewel shone with the most golden radiance as at this moment, streams of pure Vitalis Hyperversal Authority flowed into it.

The same scene but on a much smaller scale played out for Noah's other Vassals as with utter incredulity, Hyperion in humanoid form and Kazuhiko touched their foreheads that were now drawing in Vitalis Hyperversal Authority!
The Kraken's tendrils of limbs rose to its head to feel a similar jewel and sensation as in amazement, Dr. Hall did the same thing.

"Little Fish, what did you do to my perfect face?!" Meanwhile, Barbatos' small but blessed figure touched her forehead in shock at the appearance of the jewel as a moment later, it turned transparent as if it weren't even there.
And with a blink of her eyes, the jewel reappeared in all of its glory as with it present, she glowed with a magisterial light of grace and power.

Noah gazed at this scene and many more as it wasn't limited to his Vassals here, but every single Entity who had taken his Blood Sources and attained his Lineage were undergoing this phenomenon as it wasn't just in this Infinite Hyperversal Haven!
But this wasn't the most drastic thing.
The most drastic thing was that on the bodies of Xiaomi, Kazuhiko, the Emperor Penguin, Lilith, and all those who had attained Extremity...their newly risen jewels shone with an Awakening Radiance.
The most dreadful and reality shattering capability of the Enneagonal Existential Jewels that had just risen with Noah's Bloodline.
The ability to grant the First Vitalis Awakening to any Entities of this Bloodline that had attained Extremity!
BOOM!
An explosion of Vitalis Hyperversal Authority bloomed far below Noah as his Vassals that he had elevated to Extremity...actually began to under their First Vitalis Awakening.
An awakening that was much, much harder than its Vacuous counterpart!
Within the Vacuous Hyperversal Legions, Noah saw powerful Commanders who had undergone their First Vacuous Awakening in large numbers.
It was easier for them.

But within the Vitalis Hyperversal Domains, there were many Extremities- even within the Supernal Havens of Extremity like Extremity Laeta of the Smilodon Lineage who had yet to undergo Vitalis Awakening!
It was a much more arduous process.
But, there were still proportionally many more Extremities who had undergone their First Vitalis Awakening in the Supernal Havens due to the Four Hyperversal Havenly Extremity Lineages.
Within the Nether Havens, maybe genius Tier 3 Entities and mostly Tier 4 Entities were the ones who had undergone their First Vitalis Awakening.
Yet now...Noah was going to revolutionize all of this.

He was about to change the very landscape and power structure of the Vitalis Hyperversal Domains as any Extremity who held his lineage felt a shocking jewel rising on their forehead at this juncture...before an Awakening Radiance shone from it as a glorious phenomenon befell them!
It was to the extent that not even a second passed that Noah's mind buzzed with a sharp old voice.
[Primogenitor, what did you just do?!]

The voice of the Seer of Sima echoed out as fantastically, away from the Infinite Hyperversal Extremity, and within the Domains of the Sima Clan where Noah's Clone that had sent the trace of his soul into the Chambers of the Senatus was floating next to the Extremity of Foundation and Erikson...

the gaze of this old woman with her cane locked onto him as she repeated the same words while gazing at Erikson and his father whose foreheads had split open just like hers to reveal white gold jewels.
[Primogenitor, what did you just do?]
Right in front of his figure.
While staring at him straight in the eyes.
This was because this cunning woman had caught onto a simple fact in this single second.

While her forehead, Erikson's, and the forehead of the Extremity of Foundation split open to reveal white gold jewels, as streams of Vitalis began to surge towards them, with an Awakening Radiance flashing on the Extremity of Foundation...Noah's Clone had not released any fluctuations.
No jewel had formed on the clone's forehead.
It was...an unexpected oversight due to Absolute Inscrutable II Existence that did not release waves of the shocking transformations Noah's main body was undergoing!

But at this moment, paired with the advent of something even Noah did not foresee, this continued camouflage of his clone while it was next to a particularly inquisitive Entity who was already suspicious of him allowed her mind to buzz and connect many things.

The Noah Osmont who was affirmed to have a strong connection and backing with the Infernal Havenly Commerce wasn't showing the slightest bit of reaction while her and all others of the Havenly Hyperversal Emperor Lineage erupted with such shocking phenomena?
It could only mean a couple of things.
And the already suspicious mind of the Seer arrived to a single possible conclusion as right in front of Noah, she gazed at him again while unabashedly asking whether he was what she believed he was!
And at such a moment, Noah's eyes flashed with brilliance as he smiled.
A small oversight on the part of Absolute Inscrutable II Existence.
A small mistake.
Even he still made them every now and then!
But at this point, it didn't matter too much as he looked into the ancient eyes of this Tier 4 Entity- he gazed into the eyes of Seer of Sima as he replied with a devilish smile.
[What did I do? I merely released the latest round of blessings!]
His body exploded with shocking brilliance and bloodline authority thereafter as the eyes of the Seer of Sima opened wider than ever before.
And off to the side, the jaws of Erikson and his father hung wide open at the surreal reality before them!

But at this moment, paired with the advent of something even Noah did not foresee, this continued camouflage of his clone while it was next to a particularly inquisitive Entity who was already suspicious of him allowed her mind to buzz and connect many things.

The Noah Osmont who was affirmed to have a strong connection and backing with the Infernal Havenly Commerce wasn't showing the slightest bit of reaction while her and all others of the Havenly Hyperversal Emperor Lineage erupted with such shocking phenomena?
It could only mean a couple of things.
And the already suspicious mind of the Seer arrived to a single possible conclusion as right in front of Noah, she gazed at him again while unabashedly asking whether he was what she believed he was!
And at such a moment, Noah's eyes flashed with brilliance as he smiled.
A small oversight on the part of Absolute Inscrutable II Existence.
A small mistake.
Even he still made them every now and then!
But at this point, it didn't matter too much as he looked into the ancient eyes of this Tier 4 Entity- he gazed into the eyes of Seer of Sima as he replied with a devilish smile.
[What did I do?
I merely released the latest round of blessings!]
His body exploded with shocking brilliance and bloodline authority thereafter as the eyes of the Seer of Sima opened wider than ever before.
And off to the side, the jaws of Erikson and his father hung wide open at the surreal reality before them!

chapters.title: Chapter 2772 I greet the Primogenitor! I
paragraphs: 2772 I greet the Primogenitor! I
Pristine liquified waves of purple liquified authority flowed below their feet.
An Aurora of lights swirled above them in this domain of the Sima Clan as Noah's figure radiated the unadulterated Bloodline authority of the Havenly Quintessential Hyperversal Emperor Lineage!

He did this while on his forehead, a glorious Quintessential Primogenitor Enneagonal Existential Jewel blazed with multicolored brilliance, looking much grander and holding much greater weight than the Quintessential Enneagonal Existential Jewels that had risen on the foreheads of the Seer of Sima, the Extremity of Foundation, and Erikson.
Yet all three stared at Noah in a dumbfounded manner at this moment as even the Seer of Sima seemed dazed at her hunch being correct.

Her aged figure that seemed young and in her prime at the same time grasped her cane tightly as it tapped on the liquified authority under their feet and proceeded forward, coming to stand before him as in the next moment...
A shocking action was performed.

The Seer of Sima had her dazed eyes gradually develop a profound sense of calmness as this Tier 4 Hyperversal Extremity appeared in front of Noah...her head tipping down in a bow of respect towards him as her voice serenely echoed out as she closed her eyes and spoke.
[This old one greets the Primogenitor.]
WAA!
An unimaginable action.
This was a Tier 4 Hyperversal Extremity.
This was the Seer of Sima!
For her to bow her head to someone...she wouldn't do so even if she were in front of the current Rhetorician of the Senatus of Extremity!

And yet...she truly bowed her head in recognition and respect as off to the side, Erikson and his father turned towards each other in utter incredulity to make sure they were both watching the same unfolding reality.

Yet a moment later, in her slight bow, the Seer of Sima opened her right eye to see their dazed figures as the cane on her right hand quickly struck out twice to smack the heads of Erikson and the Extremity of Foundation while her sharp voice rang out.
[You buffoons are still just standing there in a daze? Pay the man his respects!]

Both father and son were smacked on the back of their heads with the cane in the hands of the Seer of Sima that was a Low Grade Armament of Extremity, the pain waking them out of all incredulity as much greater strength was placed on the Extremity of Foundation.
He stepped forward, still filled with a sense of incredulity as he dazedly spoke out.
[I...I greet the Primogenitor.]
The words felt foreign and right at the same time as the Jewels on their foreheads shone with majesty.
Besides the Extremity of Foundation, Erikson also stepped forward as his tan skin pulsed with a vibrant radiance.
At this scene, Noah turned towards this confident Scion who always saw him as his peer with a slight smile.
As for Erikson himself, he seemed to barely see this smile as his emotions were tumultuous.
He was a distinguished genius.
He held the capability to alter Probability!
Yet in front of a being such as this...he was coming to realize that they truly were not the same breed of peers!
Maybe they were in the past. Maybe then. But not now.
Erikson shook his head in a daze as the voice of the Seer of Sima rang out again while she observed this scene and Noah's smile.
[Don't make it too hard for them, O Primogenitor. They do not understand things in the same way that I do.]

As she spoke, she raised her head to gaze at Noah fully, especially the dazzling jewel on his forehead as she continued while feeling the immense weight she had to bear just to stare at him currently- a weight that wasn't there before!

[Each of the Seven Clans has a Source of a Primogenitor behind them, with most of them having not appeared before us in the eons that have passed as they all seek grander aspirations of the Gradations of Extremity. Of course, there are Records of other Primogenitors not connected to any Clans or Inheritances as they are even more carefree.]
Her aged figure gazed up as she spoke- as if she could see in immense reality in the far bounds of the unknown.

[The last time a Recorded Primogenitor of the Sima Clan appeared, he just talked with the Sima Extremity Overlord of that time as I barely caught a glimpse of him. He left behind a few Armaments of Extremity and disappeared soon after. You see...Primogenitors don't tend to live and stay among us, much less do they have a Lineage like yours that you are spreading freely.]
Her raised eyes came down again as she tried to lock onto Noah and hold her gaze steady.

[Across the veiled Records, I know of the Primogenitor of Steel, the Primogenitor of the Sword, and Primogenitor of Boxing among a few that have taken their distinctions extremely far in the Gradations of Extremity. I have yet to know of your full distinction...and what your purpose may be among us, Primogenitor.]
The cunning old woman looked at Noah closely as she waited for his reply.
At her words, Noah couldn't help but smile as he thought to himself.
His purpose? His distinction?
His figure shone with a multicolored glow as calmly stood and basked in brilliance, the jewel on his forehead pulsing as it sent information about itself in his soul as Noah spoke calmly.

[Though it's a bit early to say it, but my distinction is one you have heard before. The True Emperor of Quintessence. The Primogenitor of Quintessence! But...I have not arrived at the place where I can comfortably take on this distinction as for now, I am only the True Emperor of Quintessence.]
WAA!
They knew of the distinction of the True Emperor of Quintessence!
But the grander distinction of a Primogenitor of Quintessence...Noah could not take it yet as he had yet to even achieve Extremity in Quintessence.
Not yet, but the time would not be too far away!

chapters.title: Chapter 2773 I greet the Primogenitor! II
paragraphs: 2773 I greet the Primogenitor! II
His words caused the Seer of Sima to open wide with light as he continued with a smile.
[As for my purpose? There isn't any grand design. I am not here to empower others to fight in some holy war between Existential Authority, nor do I seek recognition or veneration.]

[Just like all others before me, I have my gaze on the Gradations of Extremity. I have my eyes on Quintessence...on Infinity, and much more. What I seek the most is to see them at their absolute extremes. Any wars, vassals, allies, or enemies that appear before me on this path are just that, and nothing more.]
As she heard these words, the Seer of Sima became extremely quiet and contemplative.
Noah gazed at her calmly as his mind continued to be fed with bursts of information on his ongoing transformation.
In the surroundings, the effects of his words remained just as potent on the Seer of Sima and others.
He was on his own path!
Any glory, veneration, or alteration of the very reality he was in was merely a consequence that occurred on this path.
A consequence of his existence.
The Vitalis Hyperversal Domains may get stronger due to his Lineage.
But this wasn't his true purpose. What he did, he did for himself. For his own path of Quintessence.
Noah knew this well as he wouldn't think any other way!
But yes. His existence...did have truly terrifying results and consequences on the landscape around him!
Across the Nether Havens of Extremity.
Millions of Awakening Radiances shone as a phenomenon that would go down in History bloomed.
In the Nether Haven of Oceanus.

Before the Havenly Bridge of Oceanus, droves of Hyperversal Savior's Ark entered this domain as Legions of Vacuous Malignancies spread out in large numbers, a grand war being carried out as opposing them- Legions of the Havenly Moon Clan, the Prometheus Clan, and the Ouroboros Clan could be seen.
Hyperversal Extremity Authority burst around in mad wonder as every single Extremity involved showed why the concept they took to Extremity deserved to stand on top.
On the side of the Havenly Moon Clan, the silver glow of the Extremity of the Moon overflowed as like endless meteors, silver moons thundering with power rained down towards the Vitalis Malignancies!
The battle was in a deadlock as supporting both sides were two Tier 4 Hyperversal Extremities, with dozens of Tier 3s and thousands of Tier 2s and 1s battling against each other.
In such a deadlock.
In such a ferocious war...
HUUM!

The bodies of all of the Extremities of the Havenly Moon Clan began to glow with pristine wonder as their foreheads split open, a dazzling Enneagonal Existential Jewel revealing itself as thereafter...
BOOOM!
An explosion of Vitalis Hyperversal Authority bloomed.
[Ah!]
Bellows erupted from the Legions of Vacuous Malignancies before them as many were knocked back as if they were singed by holy flames.

And to the astonishment of the members of the Havenly Moon Clan, they felt their Lineage churn as streams of Vitalis Hyperversal Authority flowed into their existence as they...underwent an Awakening right here and now.
Their First Vitalis Awakening!

The two Tier 4 Vacuous Malignancies were astonished as the Esteemed Havenly Emperors from the Havenly Moon Clan were even more so, but as they affirmed the glow of Vitalis around all of their Extremities...
[Attack!]
WAA!
[Bathe everything under the cataclysmic light of the Havenly Moon!]

They erupted with shocking momentum to command their forces as the hands of the two Tier 4 Havenly Moon Clan entities thundered down, dozens of massive silver moons now painted with a milky white light of Vitalis tumbling down as they were followed by hundreds of smaller moons conjured up from other clansmen.
The domain fields of the nearby Savior's Arks were scorched as with undeniable might and tyranny...
BOOOM!
A cataclysmic attack rained down on the Legion of Vacuous Malignancies that the Havenly Moon Clan faced as 8 Savior's Arks were instantly shattered, hundreds of Vacuous Extremities perishing.
The scene was utterly astonishing as the other sides of the battle paused momentarily.

From the Prometheus Clan and the Ouroboros Clan, a few of their Extremities flowed with the Enneagonal Existential Jewels, but nowhere near the number of the Havenly Moon Clan that had traded even an Armament of Extremity with the Infernal Havenly Commerce to attain large numbers of Blood Sources!

At this moment, their investment showed its results in a terrifying fashion that even surprised them, their Esteemed Havenly Emperors using this momentum as they cut towards the Havenly Bridge of Oceanus carrying Vacuous Legions over.
But at this moment, the very flow of battle had changed as there could only be a single result.
Such a scene occurred in Oceanus.
And also in Helios, Elera, Penumbra...and all locations that held Entities with the Havenly Quintessential Hyperversal Emperor Lineage.
Vitalis Hyperversal Authority bloomed in concentration and number as the effects of this single phenomenon would echo out across Recorded History!
And the cause of it all...was a single entity.
An Entity that had unlocked the Quintessential Enneagonal Existential Jewel for others as for himself...he had attained the Quintessential Primogenitor Enneagonal Existential Jewel!
What did such a thing grant him?
Across eons of Recorded Histories. Within the Record veiled in the Aeonic Annals of Extremity that the Infinite Hyperversal Haven was hidden in.
Noah's main body touched the multicolored jewel on his head as his mind was illuminated by a great deal of information

[Quintessential Primogenitor Enneagonal Existential Jewel]: A construct born from a lineage spearheaded by you- its potential and breadth within the vastness of Extremity still unknown. At its most basic form, this Enneagonal Existential Jewel serves as a reservoir for Vitalis and Vacuous Existential Authority as after a passive and automatic accumulation of these authorities to a sufficient level, you will naturally be capable of expanding Vitalis and Vacuous Existential Authorities towards Extremity- you do not need to wait for your Fourth Awakening before this expansion. In addition to being a reservoir, it also acts as an Existential Engine that cycles and assimilates Existential Authority into your existence at an extremely rapid rate, allowing for your future Awakening to proceed at an even smoother and faster rate. The Primogenitor Enneagonal Existential Jewel is also intricately connected to your Lineage as it allows you to call upon and warp Vassals of this Lineage across any respective Existential Domain, and it can forge a Backup Existential Record for you and any Vassals that will automatically be sacrificed if their True Existential Record is ever about to be erased- granting then another chance at the continuation of their Records. Other features of the Enneagonal Existential Jewel are still unfolding as it stabilizes and entrenches itself onto your lineage....
A simple and yet grand description.
It was also one that paved the pathway for Noah...to be capable of expanding the Concepts of Vitalis and Vacuous towards Extremity!

chapters.title: Chapter 2774 All Three Aspects Scaled! I
paragraphs: 2774 All Three Aspects Scaled! I

From the description of the Quintessential Primogenitor Enneagonal Existential Jewel, it was expressed that Entities had to attain the Fourth Vitalis or Vacuous Awakening before they could even try expanding said concepts towards Extremity.
Noah didn't have to wait for this as even while he was undergoing his Third Awakenings at this very moment, the Fourth ones were far away.

The Enneagonal Existential Jewel stepped in to solve this issue as he could innately feel that within a matter of days, the accumulation of Existential Authority would reach the required level and grant him the right to expand these concepts!
This in itself was a terrifying capability.
Even more terrifying was that in mere days, he had truly progressed from the First Existential Awakenings and he was already on his Third.
Other Entities took thousands or millions of years.
And yet over the past days, he had been bathing in so much Existential Authority as in his point of view- it still seemed like it was taking too long!
In addition to all of this, the Enneagonal Existential Jewel could actually make a backup of his Records and the Records of those within this Lineage.

It meant that for those of the Havenly Quintessential Hyperversal Emperor Lineage...they would always have a safety net at least once in their lives to ensure that their Records would not be entirely eradicated and lost in the eons of History.

His breath was turbid with power as he breathed out Quintessence, taking stock of all that was happening around him as far below him in the Infinite Hyperversal Haven, apart from Xiaomi and other Extremities undergoing their First Vitalis Awakening...there was his son.
The one with the highest level of purity of his Lineage.

His Quintessential Enneagonal Existential Jewel also shone with a profound radiance as even though he didn't grasp Extremity, his bloodline purity allowed his Jewel to amass such a dense concentration of Vitalis Hyperversal Authority that he was currently undergoing his First Vitalis Awakening.
Such a reality meant that his son had successfully accomplished one of the things required if he sought to attain an Extremity Physiology!
But this phenomenon was unique to his son.

No other Entities that had yet to grasp Extremity with his lineage jumped to have their First Awakening yet, and after Noah's will affirmed how things were going with all of his bodies stretched out across Havens- he turned his attention back to himself as he had to hurry.
The period of time that the entities at the Fifth Gradation of Extremity would target him was nearing as yes, it was variable.
They would make a move at the most opportune time, and Noah could act in a way to create such an opportune time.

But he couldn't deviate too much when it came to how the events would have played out as one of the major changes he would make in the future to unfold...were the lives of Ayame and her Grandfather who would inadvertently perish just from being near him!
But even for this...a solution had just risen with his Quintessential Primogenitor Enneagonal Existential Jewel.
Noah smiled at the thought as his mind fully focused on himself.
On his Ninth Aletheian Haven being forged as the millions of branches of the Ash Tree IV of Gradation began to disappear, their authority gradually becoming used up.
And his Origin went ever closer towards completion as with the Boundary of Cultivation, the boons of the Ash Tree had taken the Ninth Aletheian Haven close to 40% completion already!

Then...there were the Innate Vitalis and Vacuous Hyperversal Meridians coursing within Noah's body- constantly dispersing waves of these two Existential Authorities as Noah looked like an entity bathed in white and black.
At certain times, his vibrant form almost disappeared into the flash of black and white as he seemed to be assimilated into Vitalis and Vacuous Hyperversal Authorities!

It was a sign of his Existence getting ever closer to them as in no time, two radiant beams of Vitalis and Vacuous Hyperversal Authorities shot up with Noah at the very center as the heavy swirling of these magisterial authorities came to a stop.
And the prompts washed over Noah's eyes.
[You have completed your Third Vitalis Awakening!]
[You have completed your Third Vacuous Awakening!]
The two Existential Authorities brimmed throughout his existence as their respective Meridians had branches of their vessels entrenched into Noah's body, origin, and soul.

His Soul attained Extremity with the moniker of Havenly as it was more geared towards Vitalis, and his Body attained Extremity with the moniker of Infernal as it was more geared towards Vacuous Hyperversal Authority.
At this moment, he saw that his layers of Aletheian Havens were tightly entrenched in both Vitalis and Vacuous Hyperversal Authorities as their Meridians wrapped around everything.
It foretold...what distinction and side that his Origin may take very soon!
[Your distinction as an Absolute Hyperversal Inscrutable II Existence has been elevated to Absolute Hyperversal Inscrutable III Existence.]

[The discernment of your History, Realm, Authorities, Dynamis, or anything else about you is now veiled and masked against Entities that have only just stepped on the Fifth Gradation of Extremity- Entities whose Existence has only traversed less than a fourth of this Gradation.]
A prompt that revealed a semblance of the shocking power of Tier 5 Entities came.
With the advancement of his distinction as an Inscrutable III Existence, Noah should have been able to veil his Records even against Entities at the Fifth Gradation of Extremity.
And yet...it seemed their might was too astounding.
The breadth of authority they commanded was too vast!

It was to the extent that after going through his dual Awakenings in both Vitalis and Vacuous, he could only mask his records against Entities that had newly been traversing on the Fifth Gradation of Extremity.
But...even this was astonishing of a feat on Noah's end as he had yet to even step on the First Gradation of Extremity, and yet he could veil himself against weak Entities on the Fifth Gradation!
In Recorded History, who else could claim such an achievement?!

sentences.text: 2774 All Three Aspects Scaled!
I

From the description of the Quintessential Primogenitor Enneagonal Existential Jewel, it was expressed that Entities had to attain the Fourth Vitalis or Vacuous Awakening before they could even try expanding said concepts towards Extremity.
Noah didn't have to wait for this as even while he was undergoing his Third Awakenings at this very moment, the Fourth ones were far away.

The Enneagonal Existential Jewel stepped in to solve this issue as he could innately feel that within a matter of days, the accumulation of Existential Authority would reach the required level and grant him the right to expand these concepts!
This in itself was a terrifying capability.
Even more terrifying was that in mere days, he had truly progressed from the First Existential Awakenings and he was already on his Third.
Other Entities took thousands or millions of years.
And yet over the past days, he had been bathing in so much Existential Authority as in his point of view- it still seemed like it was taking too long!
In addition to all of this, the Enneagonal Existential Jewel could actually make a backup of his Records and the Records of those within this Lineage.

It meant that for those of the Havenly Quintessential Hyperversal Emperor Lineage...they would always have a safety net at least once in their lives to ensure that their Records would not be entirely eradicated and lost in the eons of History.

His breath was turbid with power as he breathed out Quintessence, taking stock of all that was happening around him as far below him in the Infinite Hyperversal Haven, apart from Xiaomi and other Extremities undergoing their First Vitalis Awakening...there was his son.
The one with the highest level of purity of his Lineage.

His Quintessential Enneagonal Existential Jewel also shone with a profound radiance as even though he didn't grasp Extremity, his bloodline purity allowed his Jewel to amass such a dense concentration of Vitalis Hyperversal Authority that he was currently undergoing his First Vitalis Awakening.
Such a reality meant that his son had successfully accomplished one of the things required if he sought to attain an Extremity Physiology!
But this phenomenon was unique to his son.

No other Entities that had yet to grasp Extremity with his lineage jumped to have their First Awakening yet, and after Noah's will affirmed how things were going with all of his bodies stretched out across Havens- he turned his attention back to himself as he had to hurry.
The period of time that the entities at the Fifth Gradation of Extremity would target him was nearing as yes, it was variable.
They would make a move at the most opportune time, and Noah could act in a way to create such an opportune time.

But he couldn't deviate too much when it came to how the events would have played out as one of the major changes he would make in the future to unfold...were the lives of Ayame and her Grandfather who would inadvertently perish just from being near him!
But even for this...a solution had just risen with his Quintessential Primogenitor Enneagonal Existential Jewel.
Noah smiled at the thought as his mind fully focused on himself.
On his Ninth Aletheian Haven being forged as the millions of branches of the Ash Tree IV of Gradation began to disappear, their authority gradually becoming used up.
And his Origin went ever closer towards completion as with the Boundary of Cultivation, the boons of the Ash Tree had taken the Ninth Aletheian Haven close to 40% completion already!

Then...there were the Innate Vitalis and Vacuous Hyperversal Meridians coursing within Noah's body- constantly dispersing waves of these two Existential Authorities as Noah looked like an entity bathed in white and black.
At certain times, his vibrant form almost disappeared into the flash of black and white as he seemed to be assimilated into Vitalis and Vacuous Hyperversal Authorities!

It was a sign of his Existence getting ever closer to them as in no time, two radiant beams of Vitalis and Vacuous Hyperversal Authorities shot up with Noah at the very center as the heavy swirling of these magisterial authorities came to a stop.
And the prompts washed over Noah's eyes.
[You have completed your Third Vitalis Awakening!]
[You have completed your Third Vacuous Awakening!]
The two Existential Authorities brimmed throughout his existence as their respective Meridians had branches of their vessels entrenched into Noah's body, origin, and soul.

His Soul attained Extremity with the moniker of Havenly as it was more geared towards Vitalis, and his Body attained Extremity with the moniker of Infernal as it was more geared towards Vacuous Hyperversal Authority.
At this moment, he saw that his layers of Aletheian Havens were tightly entrenched in both Vitalis and Vacuous Hyperversal Authorities as their Meridians wrapped around everything.
It foretold...what distinction and side that his Origin may take very soon!
[Your distinction as an Absolute Hyperversal Inscrutable II Existence has been elevated to Absolute Hyperversal Inscrutable III Existence.]

[The discernment of your History, Realm, Authorities, Dynamis, or anything else about you is now veiled and masked against Entities that have only just stepped on the Fifth Gradation of Extremity- Entities whose Existence has only traversed less than a fourth of this Gradation.]

The breadth of authority they commanded was too vast!

In Recorded History, who else could claim such an achievement?!

chapters.title: Chapter 2775 All Three Aspects Scaled! II
paragraphs: 2775 All Three Aspects Scaled! II

His History was veiled from the eyes of weak Entities in the Fifth Gradation of Extremity. With this reality affirmed, his gaze went on to the other prompts that explained the surging Existential Authority flowing across his body.
[Transformation into the Vitalis Havenly II Entity is now possible!]
[Transformation into the Vacuous Infernal III Entity is now possible!]
[Your Manipulation of Existential Authority has increased substantially.]
[Hyperversal II Assimilation has been elevated to Existential Hyperversal III Assimilation.]

[Existential Hyperversal III Assimilation]:: The Sources and Origins of other Entities containing Existential Authority can now be desired and assimilated while granting 100% more Existential Authority. Furthermore, you can now choose to devour Concepts of Extremity bound to you or others for the purpose of traversing across the Gradations of Extremity at a faster pace. At its current stage, Concepts of Extremity that have only arrived at the Fourth Gradation of Extremity in power and below can be devoured...
His eyes flashed sharply as he saw the description of the newly elevated Hyperversal II Assimilation into Existential Hyperversal III Assimilation.
Theoretically...he could now devour and assimilate the very Concepts of Extremity others held to empower his own.

This was somewhat similar to what the Boundaries of Plagiarism could do once elevated to Extremity- but it only stole the Boundaries of others and granted them to him as they wouldn't be devoured to empower other Boundaries.
These were the gains made from his Third Awakening as his body brimmed with Existential Authority!

One of the heavier gains was the capability of Inscrutable III Existence, and as he gazed at this distinction, Noah also perused through the information of his elevated lineage and its capability of Obfuscation which was another feature that only supplemented his ability to veil himself before others.
His golden blood pulsed across his vessels like thick molten stellar Panaceas of existence as the information bloomed in his mind soon enough.

Havenly Quintessential Obfuscation had been elevated to the extent that now, Noah could erase his existence passively and actively against weaker Entities on the Fifth Gradation of Extremity! It was along the lines of Inscrutable as with Obfuscation, now could not be standing inches away from an Entity that had traversed less than a fourth of the Fifth Gradation of Extremity as they...
would not be able to see him.
They would not be able to even perceive that he was standing right there!
All of these capabilities had set the stage for what was coming up as now...
there was only one critical piece left.
And just as his Soul came to focus on it...
HUUM!
His Origin pulsed with multicolored light as it devoured over 95% of the Authority of the Ash Tree IV of Gradation.

It was the hardest Haven to forge and it only took more and more resources the closer towards completion, but his Boundary of Cultivation truly elevated the authority he obtained to an obscene level as currently, 48% of the Ninth Aletheian Haven was completed!

The illusory branches of the Ash Tree seemed like evaporating rivers of reality as they released every last shred of authority they held, Noah seeing clusters of fantastical royal cosmos of Elera forming as the number jumped from 48% to 49%.
A second passed.
Branches of the illusory Ash Tree of Gradation disappeared one after another as when there were 5 branches left, the rate of completion reached 50%.
HUM!
His Origin pulsed with tense authority as prompts arose.
[You have reached the Unscalable Wall of your Origin!]

As if there was an insurmountable barrier that could never be crossed, the point came where before the completion of the other half of his Ninth Aletheian Haven, Noah would have to exceed the absolute limit of the Aspects of the Origin!
This was the only possible way that the ridiculous capability of taking the Sources of Boundaries linked to his Origin to Extremity could have been achieved.
And yet what should have been an arduous thing before...
[The Boundary of Cultivation flashes with quintessential glory at a barrier that seeks to impede your progress!]
[Your Origin mocks the Unscalable Wall and begins to tear it apart!]
WAA!
His very being was filled with unbound waves of tyranny.
His Origin laughed at the appearance of the Unscalable Wall as it continued to absorb the authority from the Ash Tree of Gradation as if this wall didn't even exist!
And in the span of an instant...
BOOM!
An explosive burst of a storm of authority erupted with Noah at the very center.
The wall demarcating Extremity and Non-Extremity of the Origin was torn down.
The last of the branches of the Ash Tree of Gradation disappeared as a blinding Sporos V of Extremity appeared in their place like a burning multicolored sun!
And Noah's Ninth Aletheian Haven...reached 51% completion.
His Origin began to pulse and oscillate as all his Havens oscillated in a fantastical fashion.
A deep, ancient, and billowing might of Hyperversal Extremity Authority began to rise from the First Aletheian Haven and spread wildly upwards!
[You have gone past the Limitations of the Origin before attaining Extremity within a concept.]
[A Quintessential Achievement!]
[Your Origin is transforming into a uniquetype of Extremity Origin!]
Within his Origin, Quintessence overflowed as Vitalis and Vacuous Hyperversal Authorities began to turn extremely active.
Above him, reality shattered as massive Existential Extremity Rune Scriptures of VACUOUS and VITALIS began to descend!
Just like his Soul and Body, his Origin took the step forward.
And due to this...
HUUM!
Noah found his Origin, Body, and Soul releasing a shocking light of resonance.
He felt his Aspects of Existence resonate and pulse with such a terrifying might that culminated into a terrifying set of prompts.
[All three of your Aspects of Existence have scaled the Unscalable Wall of Extremity before you attained Extremity in any concept!]
[An Achievement Unrecorded in all of History!]
[Your Aspects of Existence are undergoing a Resonance of Extremity as the Boundaries of the Body, Origin, and Soul are at the breadth of Extremity.]
[With your say so, the Boundaries of the Body, Origin, and Soul can be taken to Extremity!]
A phenomenal achievement.
And it came with a phenomenal reward as since his Body, Origin, and Soul had all attained Extremity- why wouldn't the Boundaries associated with them not be capable of taking this step?!
But...
[No.]
HUUM!
Noah's booking voice filled with authority echoed out as the permission was not granted.
He had already made up his mind in the last day when he stopped the advancement of multiple concepts towards Extremity.
His sights were set on a much grander path.
His sights were set on Quintessence as the first!

chapters.title: Chapter 2776 A Moment of Infinity, A Leap of Quintessence! I
paragraphs: 2776 A Moment of Infinity, A Leap of Quintessence! I
His Aspects of Existence all emanated Hyperversal Extremity Authority as Noah could choose to take the Concepts of the Body, Origin, and Soul to Extremity!
But these weren't the options Noah wanted to define himself with as for the most profound glory, it truly had to be Quintessence.
So he denied once more taking a step naturally to achieve Extremity.
And his Origin buzzed as it drank the Existential Authority stemming from the Extremity Rune Scriptures of VITALIS and VACUOUS that were spinning like grand engines up above for the third time.

Vacuous and Vitalis Hyperversal Authority was filling Noah's Origin as all of his Aletheian Havens pulsed and became even more glorious- with the forging of the Ninth Aletheian Haven even being continued as the incoming Existential Authority was used as a fuel!
As all of this occurred, Noah retained his state of Quintessential Unity of Existence as he observed the profundities occurring within and around him.
He came to focus on his Origin that had taken a step forward as he asked himself.
How could he complete his Origin in a truly Quintessential manner?
How could he equalize the Havenly Authorities within and even add more?
The answer to this dazzling question...led Noah to look at the new construct whose backbone was forming in the Infinite Hyperversal Haven.
The answer he currently has in his mind for the equilibrium of his Origin...
was the concept of an Extremity Vein.
Yes.
Something that could bring harmony to the authorities within him as well as provide a path forward after all 9 Aletheian Havens were built!
His will gazed at the current state of the Infinite Hyperversal Haven.

The backbone of the emerging Extremity Vein in the shape of an Infinity symbol as fully entrenched itself within and around Noah's home, with the upper layer of the backbone of the Extremity Vein being far above Noah, and the lower bound being below the Dream Aletheian Haven!
The center point of the symbol of Infinity showed a melding of many different authorities crossing and interacting with each other as they included Decreta, Natural Laws, and Havenly Authorities.
This...was what Noah was thinking of enacting for himself.

This whole time, the Infinite Hyperversal Haven was waiting for Noah to complete his Origin, attain Extremity in the many Natural Laws, Decreta, and Havenly Authorities as after that...the transformation that the Infinite Hyperversal Haven would undergo would be a Quintessential one!
Its Extremity Vein would be distinguished and be fully forged then.
So Noah didn't see why he couldn't enact his own Extremity Vein to circulate and equilibrate all of the Authorities within his Haven.

With such a thought in mind...he guided the ongoing change as the transformation of his Origin now followed his Will- the incoming waves of Vacuous and Vitalis Hyperversal Authority beginning to act as building blocks for a backbone of an illusory Extremity Vein!
And what would fill this not even formed Extremity Vein...would be an overabundance of Quintessence.
[The Quintessential Zenith Boundary of Ascendancy has been triggered.]
HUUM!
His body turned into an abyssal void that devoured all incoming authority as at the same time, Ascendancy was activated!
[Your own will is guiding the attainment of the Unrecorded Quintessential Existential Hyperversal Extremity Superius Origin!]
Not just Havenly.
Not just Infernal.
It was Existential!
It contained both Vacuous and Vitalis as his Origin wasn't isolated to a moniker of Infernal or Havenly!
With such a grand distinction, it began to advance and transform as Noah's stupendous work and plans neared their Culmination.
At the same point in time.
Within the Supernal Haven of Helios.
The eyes of Noah's clone had only become more unfathomable as from the throne borne of Helios below him, his figure rose while staring at the Aurora of crimson gold light all around.
[The time nears.]
His words were simple ones, and yet the expression of Extremity Solarium was filled with a blinding light of authority as the wings on her forehead flapped with glory.

Her figure at the Fifth Gradation of Extremity also rose as behind her, a dazzling Golden pair of wings erupted from her back- their color being many times denser than her skin as they seemed to expand over the horizon!
Her red lips moved with calm as she seemed to sense some fluctuations around Noah's existence that she either could not believe or simply chose not to show anything about it.

[I've looped in the relevant parties- with as little information as possible of course. All they know is to be at a certain location when I give them a signal. They've already come to their own conclusions and are prepared to act at a moment's notice as with this...the risk of the Vacuous Malignancies at the Fifth Gradation of Extremity being alerted is very, very low.]
Yes.
When some beings were sufficiently powerful enough, even uttering their names or discussing their history may turn their gaze towards you as any malicious intent could very quickly be locked onto!
Extremity Solarium knew a lot more information than others as even with all of this, she still held a slight worry for the Entity in front of her.
For everything she had seen from him, his life must be preserved for the eons to come!

[Are you sure that you will still be there when this goes down? You may be underestimating the power that an entity in the Fifth Gradation of Extremity holds. Even if an existence teleports from a location and seconds pass, Entities such as I can easily trace and follow your moving Records across Havens. And we wouldn't even need a millisecond to entirely erase all the Records of even an Entity at the Third Gradation of Extremity. If the enemy gets his hands on you...]
The warning of the Esteemed Havenly Empress in front of Noah was a grave one as she sought to instill caution within him.
And yet at her words, Noah only shook his head with a smile as he thought about what he had planned.
[Even against an Emperor at the Fifth Gradation of Extremity, I can handle myself.]
WAA!
Words of tremendous confidence.
Words that made it clear that Noah was absolutely ready for the shocking play about to unfold!
